lanes.label: TALES
lanes.sub: Tales of the Jedi, the Empire and the Underworld

records.lg: Kai, Lys and Nubs fly to their new temple on Tenoo with young pilot Nash, arriving in time to stop Taborr's pirates from looting a local shop.
Yoda sends the younglings for mystery seeds; they snatch them back from Taborr, but Kai loses his lightsaber saving Nubs and is rewarded with Yoda's childhood blade.
Taking on a training droid meant for older students, Kai, Lys and Nubs pool their Force strength to pin it until Nash and RJ-83 switch it off.
When a tooka kitten in Nash's care escapes its carrier, Lys chases it through the temple's courtyard, dining hall and sleeping quarters before returning it safely.
A playful bird keeps Nubs from a Zeilla flower the temple needs, until Lys sees his lightsaber dazzles it and Nubs rides the bird to the bloom.
Hauling a Jedi holocron home, Nash threads the Firehawk through asteroids and a space slug's jaws to shake Taborr, landing hard at the temple with the prize intact.
Routed by Taborr's gang during a market raid, Kai, Lys and Nubs refuse to quit, chasing the pirates to their ship and Force-pulling the stolen cart back.
In a no-Force river race, Nash and her Jedi crew team up with cheating rival Raena to escape the mud, then ride a geyser past her to victory.
When RJ-83 is swept downriver, Kai leaves Yoda's rock-lifting lesson and, trusting the Force, braces a log at the waterfall's lip so Nash can grab her droid.
A temple-archive tracker leads the younglings to a centuries-lost Jedi ship and its stranded droid pilot, who must face his fear of asteroids to reach Tenoo.
When Nubs falls ill, Kai and Lys fetch healing Yara leaves, learning to temper his haste and her wandering focus to outwit the gangul guarding the plant.
Chasing a junkyard thief, the younglings find Taborr's gang has built a towering droid from stolen scrap, and Kai talks the machine into a better purpose.

records.ti: Lys and the Snowy Mountain Rescue
records.lg: Guiding a wellagrin herd across Andraven, Lys triggers an avalanche with a flute, then uses flute calls to find lost Jam and snatch him from another slide.
records.wp: Lys and the Snowy Mountain Rescue

records.lg: Skipping chores after a failed drill, Kai reprograms the training droids to clean up, and they run amok through the temple until the friends corral them.
Disguised as pirates, Nash and the younglings slip into Yarrum Tower to recover a farmer's stolen jellyfruit harvest, then invite even Taborr's gang to share the festival feast.
On a wildlife-show safari, a toothy bird snatches the droid hosts; Lys stays calm, wins over the mother with shiny berries and names the new species.
Test-flying their new starfighters, Kai strays into an asteroid ring and wakes a space slug that swallows his friends, forcing him to bait the beast into opening wide.
On Federian, the younglings and a band of skriffles make a stand for the last great tree against Raxlo's logging machine, tearing off its saws with the Force.
Stranded in a beast's lair with Master Zia and Ace Kallisto, the thief who took their shuttle, Kai must trust her, and learns wrongdoers can change.
Gruff bounty hunter Ansen Strung is reduced to hunting a runaway pet kibbin, and only catches the skittish creature once he lets the younglings help.
A gargantua bound for a nature preserve escapes at a fuel stop, and the younglings race to find the gentle beast before frightened townsfolk corner it.
On concert night, Nash's favorite band splits over who gets to sing; Lys and Nash save both bandmates from a waterfall and help them hear each other out.
Flying Princess Inaya and a gift for her father, Nash brushes off the royal's engineering know-how, until Inaya's skills ground Taborr's ship and recover the stolen present.
Overslept and left behind, Kai joins Nash on a Tatooine delivery that loses its cargo and RJ-83 to Jawas, and learns to seek the bright side.
When collector Draiven Bosh steals the town's Visitor's Day sculpture, Lys stows aboard his ship and learns that calling Master Zia for help is no failure.
A seed Nubs carries from botany class grows into a rampaging vine that invades the temple, until he studies the plant and smothers its heart in shade.
Tracing Nash's stolen speeder to a gang-ruled town, the younglings help Ori, the boy forced to steal it, rally his neighbors to oust the Ganguls.
While Hap attempts a friend's favorite stew, eggs in his supply crate hatch into hungry tikotiko critters that wreck the café, until he feeds them.
Stranded on a runaway train car, Kai and Taborr must work together to deliver a village's lumber, and Taborr surprises everyone by abandoning his heist.
The younglings and an explorer droid chase thieves who stole an ancient Story Stone, then help one of them, a Tharnakan, return it to his people.
Tracing tremors under Nubs's favorite tree, the friends find Raxlo drilling for sap and persuade him to abandon his haul to restore the balance.
Worried for her missing brother Ansen, trainee bounty hunter Senna enlists the younglings to find him, and the reunited siblings team up to wrangle a farmer's runaway burowga.
When Kai's overeager throw sends Ember the charhound racing into the woods, he and visiting Padawan Bell Zettifar follow her scorched trail and lure off a gangul.
On safari, Lys bonds with a lost baby creature, Diggles, and must give him up when the fearsome beast pursuing them turns out to be his mother.
When Nihil pirates raid Zepher's workshop, Nash leaves her getaway post against Yoda's orders and must steady her nerves to chase down the stolen Vectors.
The Ganguls hijack Taborr's ship with him aboard, so EB-3 and Pord beg the younglings for help, and a stubborn Taborr learns to appreciate his crew.
Miners on Ootoo Prime shun a cave said to hide a shadow monster, until the younglings expose Taborr's scare-and-steal scheme and help the miners conquer their fear.
Paired on a mission with Resmia, who bested him in sparring, Kai lets rivalry cost them a precious beacon stone, and only teamwork gets it back.
Bound for Starlight Beacon, the younglings answer a distress call, mistake reformed pirates for looters, then risk missing their tour to free the crew's mired ship.
Camping out to unmask a creature haunting Marlaa's junkyard, the younglings push past their fears and find an abandoned droid scavenging parts to fix itself.
Ignoring their sky-skimming teacher's advice to ride the wind, the younglings get blown far off course on Kondoraan and must learn patience to glide home.
Helping Omakan farmers with a harvest feast, the younglings find Grandpa Roog feuding with his son over farm droids that soon run amok, and reunite the family.
During Life Day on Kashyyyk, Lys drops a young Wookiee's glowing orb and races to recover it before the lighting ceremony, learning what the orbs truly mean.
Raxlo's mining melts the snow sheltering Andraven's wellagrin eggs on hatching day; the younglings outwit his droids, save the clutch and find him another dig site.
After a groundquake on Vuundalla, sheltered Prince Cyrus sees his people's suffering for the first time and, with Kai's help, defies his indifferent parents to deliver supplies.
Lost firehawk chicks overrun Nash's garage just before a big business visit, so she disguises her ship as a parent bird to lead them away.
Paired for a wilderness exercise, best friends Kai and Nubs bicker over directions and split up, until ganguls corner Kai and Nubs charges to the rescue.
Feeling left out on a farm convoy, Nubs is carried off with the stolen well drill, and Gangul boss Orryak plays on his hurt to recruit him.
Visiting Batuu, the younglings help Padawan Celesta Kami stop developer Ozon Nimbee's droids from felling Black Spire Outpost's rock spires, winning over her new neighbors.
When the grown-up Comet Runners steal the Jedi artifacts Taborr just stole, Kai and his friends team up with Taborr's gang to take them back.
Frustrated that he can't master a move on Batuu, Kai enters a Force cave whose visions of friends, Taborr and Yoda teach him a Jedi needn't be perfect.
Scrapping on Bracca with Eren Kitt, the younglings race rival Pikpik scavengers for power cells to save her failing droid, and she learns trading beats grabbing.
When thief Draiven Bosh steals Uncle Luggs's prized speedster from a starship expo, Nash and the younglings trail it to an asteroid hideout and fly it out.
Covering deliveries for swamped Nash, Kai mixes up every order and crashes the Firehawk before admitting he needs his friends to set things right.
Taborr, secretly Prince Cyrus, tours Starlight Beacon with the unsuspecting younglings while plotting to steal its dedication plaque, until Kai corners the pirate and saves the ceremony.
Hotshot new Padawan Wes Vinik leads the younglings against the Ganguls, who are stealing a village's starships with their new cruiser, and must learn to accept help.
The Ganguls' giant cruiser swoops to seize a friend's ship, so Nash lures the pirates off and ducks the Firehawk into a cave too tight for them.
Overconfident Kai keeps botching new Padawan Wes Vinik's sky-ring flying course, until Wes admits his own mistakes and flies it alongside him.
Sent to fetch a thruster part from the junkyard, RJ-83 and Wes's droid R0-M1 squabble it onto a scrap train, then team up to chase it down.
Guiding three new younglings through the Tenoo forest, Lys must keep her focus when a curious fellwing carries one of them off to its treetop nest.
Finding Taborr hauling parts out of Marlaa's junkyard, Kai assumes the worst and duels him, only to learn the pirate paid for them honestly.
Too eager to impress a visiting Yoda, Nubs stumbles through the temple obstacle course, until the old master helps him find calm through the Force.
Kai chases homesick youngling Bren to Yarrum Tower, where a smooth-talking pirate, Clave Rollek, tempts the boy with a life of stealing and tries to take their ship.
Kai and Bell Zettifar help a blustering mayor recover his town's stolen nerf herd, then discover the rustlers are owed the animals by an old broken promise.
Lys and novice rider Myra track an uncatalogued creature for Aree, tumbling into a flooding sinkhole where they win over the shy leepur.
Stung by the Ganguls' mockery, Taborr captures a wild gangul to impress other pirates, and the younglings must coax him into letting the exhausted beast go home.
Nash helps Princess Inaya fix her secretly built starship in time for a royal ceremony, where Inaya learns her parents always knew about her mechanic's hobby.
Distracted by the ancient Pooba Jedi's lightsaber he found, Nubs lets a comet cripple the Firehawk on the way to Coruscant, and Yoda helps him refocus.
Captured by the Ganguls after picking a fight at Yarrum Tower, Wes Vinik is rescued by the younglings and Chigg, the reformed pirate he refused to trust.
Hoping to be hailed a hero, Nash leads her friends aboard a derelict pirate cruiser to recover the staff of Tenoo's founder, and wakes its vengeful droid captain.
When the Comet Runners raid his village and seize the visiting younglings, Prince Cyrus secretly dons his Taborr armor to rescue them, keeping his double life hidden.
The Ganguls kidnap Hap's musician friends to trade to the Hutt Bulcha, and when the younglings' rescue goes wrong, the nervous café owner finds his own courage.
When a rare barelia flower is dug up the night it should bloom, gardening youngling Linh wins over the reclusive collector who took it and coaxes her outdoors.
At an Ootoo mining celebration, Prince Cyrus's greed for a glittering crystal stirs up gem-eating amberflies, and he must put others first to help drive them off.
Crewing Gumar's sled in an Andraven rite-of-passage race, the younglings help him gather three trial items, and he tames a legendary zaba wolf with a reed flute.
Chasing the kroop birds that raided Fiorna's wild gomgourds before a harvest feast, Nubs befriends them by sharing fruit, and Fiorna learns she took their food.
When web-spinning spiders escape Aree's freighter into the temple, a frightened Kai must lure their king back to its pen, learning Jedi aren't ruled by fear.
The Ganguls scheme to spoil the Wookiees' Life Day, snatching their feast and targeting a sacred tree, until Orryak's nephew Daynaal defies her to help the younglings.
Kaliah Kublop's old journal leads Kai and Resmia to her hidden treehouse base, where they must defend its relics from Captain Blackbolt as Resmia admits a secret fear.
Short on credits, Ansen Strung captures a rare blue aklyrr with the younglings' help, then sets it free when his client, Draiven Bosh, double-crosses him.
Bolter, a Batuu girl, steals Lys's lightsaber to feel brave against a bully, and Lys and Padawan Celesta help her discover that courage doesn't come from a weapon.
When the Ganguls seize Yarrum Tower, the younglings and ex-pirate Chigg must team up with a grudging Taborr to slip out before the gang claims every ship.
Chasing a runaway jetpack through the Tenoo forest with Marlaa and her old adventuring partner Maz Kanata, Kai discovers his junkyard friend has a daring past.
Kai learns Prince Cyrus is Taborr as the Ganguls loot the royal vault, and though the two fight side by side, Cyrus still chooses the pirate's mask.
Running Wes's volatile coaxium delivery, Kai tries too hard to copy his hero, until a Comet Runners ambush teaches him to trust his own style.
When the Ganguls steal Raxlo's new harvester on Andraven, the once-greedy businessman rallies the younglings, local kids and wellagrins in a snowball counterattack to take it back.
A fallen tree traps Nubs and two villagers in a cave, and Kai and Lys coax reluctant Raxlo into a rescue that costs him his harvester.
When her water-scout droid vanishes in a sandstorm, Braygh blames the nomadic Dostans, until Wes brokers a truce and they help pull it from a cave beast's tentacles.
When a rival sabotages her racing hero's droids, Nash becomes Wiston Freng's mid-race engineer, with the younglings in the pit, then steers his monopod to victory.
Minding an empty temple, Kai shelters thief Ace Kallisto and her droid from Bulcha the Hutt, then must defend his home when the gangster lays siege.
Led through thick fog by Draiven Bosh's worried droid, the younglings catch him trying to snatch a firehawk chick, yet Lys still saves him from a deadly fall.
R0-M1 breaks the Firehawk's accelerator, a chop-shop thief pockets it, and the go-it-alone droid must learn teamwork as Nash and Nubs help win it back.
Nubs and Lys help Zeepohz, a grown-up Pooba, haul his crashed ship's cargo to market, and Nubs learns there's no rush to grow up.
Ansen Strung and his old partner Rhugo Tar bicker over methods while hunting a starship thief, until the younglings help the rival bounty hunters work as one.
Bored by the rain, Lys leads Kai and Nubs up the temple's great tree, where they wake the sloth that guards it and must make amends.
Kai catches Taborr robbing a starship factory, but the pirate plays on their old friendship to escape, and Wes assures Kai still hoping for Cyrus is right.
Helping Eren Kitt search Bracca's dianoga-infested Badlands, the younglings find her Pikpik friends captured by Nihil pirates hungry for a navicomputer, and plan a careful rescue.

records.ti: The Search for the Missing Dunnels
records.lg: After Zotti leaves the stables unlocked, bandits make off with the runaway dunnels, and Lys leads him on a chase onto a moving train to reclaim them.
records.wp: The Search for the Missing Dunnels

records.lg: Rushing to help without listening, the younglings load a droid's crate onto a ship bound for Yarrum Tower, and must sneak in to retrieve it from the Ganguls.
Swapped missions leave Kai and Nubs herding banthas and Lys hunting an explorer's journal, each borrowing the other's strengths before Master Zia admits the mix-up was deliberate.
Answering Yoda's distress call from a volcanic world, the younglings brave quakes, beetles and lava to reach him, and learn that even Yoda sometimes needs rescuing.
At an excavation of ancient raka fossils, the younglings and their explorer droid friend stop developer Ozon Nimbee from bulldozing Tenoo's history for a resort.
The younglings protect a memory-scrambled little droid from bandits after his master's gem mines, but must stop bickering over the route to get him home.

records.ti: The Bounty Hunter and the Thief
records.lg: When Tooba Jinx steals the rare squork Ace Kallisto is transporting, the younglings team the thief up with ex-bounty hunter Ansen Strung to chase down the slippery creature.
records.wp: The Bounty Hunter and the Thief

records.lg: When Orryak's pirate alliance seizes the Tenoo temple, Kai's plea for help rallies the friends the younglings have made, and even Taborr joins the fight.
Tracking a stolen droid part to the tinkerer Rek Minuu, the younglings help three mistreated astromechs break free of him and gain new droid companions of their own.
Distracted on Batuu, Kai loses Master Drow's package to a trash hauler, and the younglings and their new droids must save it from the dump's crusher.
Feeling he isn't good enough, the Ku-Bops' droid drummer slips off with droidsmith Rek Minuu for upgrades, and the younglings must rescue him before his big solo.
Chasing a meeka that stole her holocam, Padawan Celesta Kami lands the younglings in a ravine and learns that watching Tenoo's Night Lights beats recording them.

records.ti: Journey to the Bottom of Naboo
records.lg: In a sunken starship beneath a Naboo lake, the younglings race Tooba Jinx for a Jedi star compass, then save the thief from a colo claw fish.
records.wp: Journey to the Bottom of Naboo

records.lg: Testing new speeder bikes from Nash, the younglings help a lost lakeetah cub find his family, and headstrong Kai learns to listen to his droid Beepers.
Scouring Bracca for a vio-harp for her mom's birthday, Nash must learn to let the prize go, and her friends' three other finds become a family trio's instruments.
When a kloo-horn player entrances Bogachi's animals, Ember included, to build a captive audience, Bell distracts him with a musical duel while Kai frees them.
Captured by droid thief Rek Minuu, Cyrus begs the younglings for help, and though he abandons them mid-rescue, he returns to save them, winning back Kai's friendship.
When three bumbling Ugnaught thieves steal their shuttle's power converter, Nubs and Wes give chase, and Nubs learns to keep his cool atop their swerving speeder.
Tracking a stolen power cell, the younglings walk into droidsmith Rek Minuu's trap and face his mighty new droid Apexx, running it ragged until its power gives out.
After selling his old harvester to Bulcha the Hutt, who turns it on the wellagrins' home, timid Raxlo must find the nerve to stand up to the bully.
Apexx hijacks the town's droids to drive the Jedi off Tenoo, so the younglings join his remorseful maker Rek to stop him, and years later reunite as Padawans.
The Brendok night replays from the Jedi's side, revealing that Sol struck down the twins' mother and that the Jedi agreed to blame every death on Mae.
Raised by Force witches on Brendok, young Osha longs to join visiting Jedi, a choice that ends in a fortress fire that tears the twins apart.
Ex-Padawan Osha is arrested for killing Jedi Master Indara, until she convinces her old master Sol that the real assassin is her twin Mae, long believed dead.
Sol's team races to Olega to protect Master Torbin, who instead drinks Mae's poison willingly, and though Sol corners Mae, she escapes toward her next Jedi target.
Sol and Osha track Mae to Kelnacca's refuge on Khofar, where the Wookiee lies dead and a masked stranger with a red lightsaber turns on the Jedi.
The masked Sith, revealed as Qimir, slaughters Sol's team in the Khofar jungle, while Mae overpowers Osha and takes her place at Sol's side.
On a remote island, Qimir nurses Osha and tempts her toward the dark side, while Mae, posing as Osha, fools Sol only until he sees through her.
Learning on Brendok that Sol killed her mother, Osha kills him and joins Qimir, while a memory-wiped Mae is taken in and Vernestra pins everything on Sol.
Rescuing a senator's kidnapped son, Dooku and young Qui-Gon find the kidnappers are the senator's oppressed people, and Dooku's anger drives him to Force-choke the senator.
Street kids Cad Bane and Niro are lured into a Duros gangster's casino heist, and when police catch Niro, young Bane rides off with his new criminal family.
Probing Master Katri's death on Raxus Secundus, Dooku and Mace Windu expose a senator's lies, and Dooku's growing sympathy for the rebels deepens his doubts.
Avenging his gangster mentor, Cad Bane kills the marshal responsible in his old neighborhood, and is arrested by childhood friend Niro after his own partner disarms him.
A sabertooth snatches baby Ahsoka during her mother's hunt on Shili, but the toddler calms the beast and rides it home, revealing her gift in the Force.
Freed from prison, Cad Bane returns to settle his score with Marshal Niro, winning the showdown only to discover the grieving boy Niro raised is his own son.
Protecting Queen Amidala from Naboo's invaders, Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan discover young Anakin on Tatooine, and Naboo is freed at the cost of Qui-Gon, slain by Darth Maul.
records.wp: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

records.lg: Dooku blames his secret master, Darth Sidious, for Qui-Gon's death, and when Master Yaddle uncovers them, he kills her to prove his loyalty to the Sith.
When a sando aqua monster besieges Theed's royal boathouse, Queen Amidala looks past the attack and finds poachers holding its baby captive inside.
Guarding Padmé from assassins, Anakin falls for her while Obi-Wan uncovers a secret clone army, and a rescue on Geonosis ignites war with Dooku's Separatists.
records.wp: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

records.lg: As war engulfs the galaxy, Kenobi is sent to smash the Banking Clan's droid factories on Muunilinst, and Palpatine overrules the Jedi to give Anakin command in space.
Anakin bristles at Obi-Wan's lecture on obedience, then leads the starfighters as the Muunilinst assault begins, while the ARC troopers' gunship is shot down deep in the city.
Stranded in Harnaidan, the ARC troopers fight through droid snipers and a tank, then scale the Banking Clan's giant artillery cannon and rig it to blow.
As panic grips the Banking Clan's headquarters, Durge throttles a carping San Hill, then leads his IG lancer droids to rout the clones outside Harnaidan.
Kit Fisto leads scuba troopers and Mon Calamari Knights to retake Mon Calamari from the Quarren separatists, shoving their crab cannon off an undersea cliff.
Seeking Jango Fett's successor in Rattatak's gladiator pits, Dooku watches a cloaked warrior, Asajj Ventress, defeat every fighter in the arena and claim to be Sith.
Dooku scorns Ventress's Sith claim and beats her in a brutal duel, then Sidious sends her, newly armed, to kill Anakin, caring only that she test him.
Kenobi leads clone swoop riders against Durge's lancer droids in a massive joust, then fights Durge himself, cutting the bounty hunter apart, unaware the Gen'Dai is already regenerating.
Kenobi's ARC troopers storm the Banking Clan's command tower, but a regenerated Durge engulfs Obi-Wan, who bursts him from within with the Force, and San Hill surrenders.
Above Muunilinst, Anakin steers Geonosian fighters into clone missiles and wrecks a gun platform, then vows to take on a lethal new starfighter, unaware Ventress is its pilot.
Anakin chases the mystery fighter through Harnaidan's streets, then defies Obi-Wan's orders and follows it into hyperspace, sensing its pilot is strong in the Force.
On Dantooine, Mace Windu's advance against the droid army is shattered by a Separatist seismic tank, leaving him cut off among super battle droids without his lightsaber.
Stripped of his lightsaber, Mace Windu smashes super battle droids with Force-driven fists, recovers his blade to finish the seismic tank, and accepts water from young Paxi Sylo.
On Ilum, Barriss Offee completes her lightsaber under Luminara Unduli's guidance, but Separatist chameleon droids strike the crystal cave, and a cave-in traps both Jedi.
Yoda mind-tricks Captain Typho into diverting Padmé's yacht to Ilum, a ruse only she notices, then fights through chameleon droids to reach the trapped Jedi.
Heading after Yoda with R2-D2 and C-3PO, Padmé destroys the chameleon droids that ambush her; Yoda returns with the rescued Jedi, and R2 traces the attack to Dooku.
On Yavin 4, a hidden Force user picks off the clones sent after Anakin and blows up his starfighter, then Ventress strides from the flames to face him.
Anakin and Ventress duel through Yavin 4's jungle, hurling trees with the Force and battling up to a Massassi temple roof, where they square off in the rain.
Atop a rain-lashed Massassi temple, Anakin wrests away one of Ventress's lightsabers and, in a fury haunted by visions of his mentors, drives her into a chasm.
As Muunilinst falls and a contrite Anakin returns, a distress call from Hypori heralds General Grievous, who tears through a band of cornered Jedi.
Captain Fordo's ARC troopers snatch Ki-Adi-Mundi and the surviving Jedi from Grievous on Hypori; with the Order stretched thin, the Council knights Anakin, and Padmé gives him R2-D2.
With Bail Organa's troops on Christophsis starving for supplies, Anakin slips a prototype stealth ship through Admiral Trench's blockade and outwits the Separatist admiral.
On Christophsis, a string of Separatist ambushes points to a traitor, and Rex and Cody hunt down the clone selling out his brothers: Sergeant Slick.
Anakin and his new Padawan, Ahsoka, rescue Jabba's kidnapped son to win the Hutts over to the Republic, foiling Dooku's scheme to frame the Jedi.
On Kamino, the squabbling cadets of Domino Squad keep failing their final exercise, until Hevy, Echo, Fives, Cutup and Droidbait learn to fight as one.
Deeming her drills too easy, Anakin makes Ahsoka face Rex's clones and their stun bolts, round after round, training she'll need when the clones turn on her.
While Jedi Ima-Gun Di makes a doomed last stand on Ryloth, Bail Organa and Jar Jar outfox a Separatist envoy to win King Katuunko's secret aid.
Yoda and three clones take on Ventress's droid army on Rugosa to prove to Toydaria's king that the Republic deserves his alliance.
The Separatist warship Malevolence wipes out Plo Koon's fleet with an ion cannon, and Anakin and Ahsoka defy orders to find the Jedi Master and his surviving clones.
Anakin leads Y-wing bombers through a treacherous nebula to ambush the Malevolence before it can destroy a Republic medical station, crippling its giant ion cannon.
When Padmé's ship is drawn aboard the crippled Malevolence, Obi-Wan and Anakin must rescue her and C-3PO from Grievous and send the warship crashing into a moon.
When commando droids overrun a remote listening outpost, Rex and Cody rally its surviving rookies to win it back and warn the fleet before Grievous attacks.
Anakin loses R2-D2, and the secrets in his memory, during a battle, then hunts for him with a bumbling replacement droid, R3-S6, who nearly gets him killed.
Anakin and Ahsoka infiltrate Grievous's secret listening post to rescue R2-D2 and destroy the station, as R2 exposes his replacement R3-S6 as a Separatist saboteur.
On Rodia, Padmé is betrayed to Nute Gunray by her desperate friend Senator Onaconda Farr, and Jar Jar, mistaken for a Jedi, bumbles his way into rescuing her.
Escorting captured Nute Gunray to trial, Ahsoka and Luminara Unduli are betrayed from within as Ventress boards their cruiser to free the viceroy.
Dooku lures Kit Fisto and his hotheaded ex-Padawan Nahdar Vebb into General Grievous's fortress, a test the cyborg passes by killing Nahdar.
Chasing Count Dooku to Vanqor, Obi-Wan and Anakin find that Hondo Ohnaka's pirates have already captured him, and agree to collect the Sith Lord for a ransom.
Double-crossed by Hondo's pirates, Obi-Wan and Anakin end up chained beside Dooku, and while Jar Jar's ransom convoy turns into their rescue, the Count escapes.
With Anakin gravely wounded after a crash on Maridun, Aayla Secura teaches Ahsoka to put the mission above attachment as they seek help among the peaceful Lurmen.
Separatists arrive on Maridun to test a deadly defoliator on the pacifist Lurmen, who must choose whether to take up arms as the Jedi defend their village.
Investigating slain clones on icy Orto Plutonia, Obi-Wan and Anakin discover the native Talz. Pantoran Chairman Cho pushes for war and is killed; Senator Chuchi makes peace.
Dr. Nuvo Vindi captures Padmé and Jar Jar in his secret Naboo lab, where he has revived a long-eradicated plague. The Jedi race to disarm his virus bombs.
When the Blue Shadow Virus escapes, infecting Ahsoka and Padmé, Anakin and Obi-Wan race to Iego for a cure, then must break the energy field trapping every visitor.
Leading her first squadron against Ryloth's blockade, Ahsoka defies Anakin's call to retreat and most of her pilots die. She must regain her nerve for a second strike.
Obi-Wan's clones must take out droid cannons in a Twi'lek town whose people are held as shields. Waxer and Boil befriend Numa, an orphan who knows the tunnels.
To free Ryloth's capital, Mace Windu needs rebel leader Cham Syndulla, who trusts the Republic little more than the droids. Their uneasy alliance storms Lessu, capturing Wat Tambor.
Benched to guard the Archives after a reckless fight, Ahsoka is on watch when Cad Bane and a shapeshifter break into the Temple and escape with a holocron.
Boarding Cad Bane's frigate, Anakin and Ahsoka arrive too late for Master Bolla Ropal, who dies under torture. Bane then threatens Ahsoka until Anakin unlocks the holocron.
Cad Bane uses the stolen holocron to abduct Force-sensitive children for Darth Sidious. The Jedi capture him, extract the children's location and mount a rescue on Mustafar.
Stranded on Felucia, Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka join Sugi's hired bounty hunters in training a farming village to stand against Hondo Ohnaka's pirates.
The Republic's new droid-killing bomb wins a battle on Malastare but awakens the Zillo Beast, a near-indestructible giant. Mace Windu argues to spare it; Palpatine wants it studied.
Brought to Coruscant, the Zillo Beast breaks loose when Palpatine orders it killed, hunts him across the city, and dies of poison. Palpatine quietly orders it cloned.
The Jedi ask Padmé to spy on Rush Clovis, an old flame with Separatist ties. A jealous Anakin shadows her as she exposes his plot on Cato Neimoidia.
The Republic returns to Geonosis to take down Poggle's droid factories. The landing turns into a bloodbath, and Anakin, Obi-Wan, Ahsoka and Ki-Adi-Mundi fight to break the shield.
While Anakin and Luminara draw off Poggle's super-tanks, Padawans Ahsoka and Barriss slip inside the droid foundry to destroy it, and are buried alive when it falls.
Chasing Poggle into an ancient temple, Luminara vanishes. Obi-Wan and Anakin follow her underground and face undead Geonosian warriors in thrall to a hidden queen.
Ferrying medical supplies, Ahsoka and Barriss discover Geonosian brain worms taking over their clone crew, then Barriss herself. Ahsoka must stop the parasites before they reach the front.
Grievous tortures captured Jedi Master Eeth Koth to taunt the Jedi. Obi-Wan, Anakin and Adi Gallia free Koth, but the cyborg general slips away again.
Wounded hunting Grievous on Saleucami, Rex shelters with Cut Lawquane, a clone who deserted to raise a family. After they fight off droids together, Rex keeps his secret.
When a pickpocket lifts Ahsoka's lightsaber on Coruscant, she hides the loss from Anakin and turns to Tera Sinube, an elderly Jedi who teaches her patience.
Investigating a Mandalorian attack, Obi-Wan rejoins his old friend Duchess Satine and learns the Death Watch rebels are led by a trusted governor, Pre Vizsla, backed by Dooku.
Escorting Duchess Satine to Coruscant, Obi-Wan and Anakin foil assassin droids and unmask a traitorous senator aboard her ship, while Anakin learns Obi-Wan once loved her.
The Senate votes to occupy Mandalore on doctored evidence. Blamed for a murder and hunted by Death Watch, Satine and Obi-Wan race to expose the truth.
Disguised as a clone cadet, young Boba Fett boards Mace Windu's cruiser to avenge his father. Aided by Aurra Sing, he sabotages the ship and it crashes.
Boba Fett and Aurra Sing lure Mace and Anakin into a booby-trapped wreck on Vanqor. With both Jedi pinned and hurt, R2-D2 must get word to the Temple.
After Aurra Sing executes Commander Ponds, Plo Koon and Ahsoka trail her and Boba Fett to Hondo's pirate base on Florrum, where the conflicted boy is finally caught.
Visiting war-starved Mandalore, Padmé helps Duchess Satine trace poisoned tea sickening the capital's children to smugglers feeding a black market that corrupt officials protect.
Teaching at Mandalore's academy, Ahsoka helps Satine's nephew Korkie and his classmates prove that Prime Minister Almec runs the black market, even as he moves to silence them.
Haunted by visions of Aurra Sing, whom she believes dead, Ahsoka joins Padmé at a refugee summit on Alderaan and must trust the Force to stop an assassination.
Ventress and Grievous strike Kamino from the sea to wipe out clone production. Rex, Cody, Echo and Fives hold the line, but the fight costs 99 his life.
When his daughters are kidnapped to force Pantora into the Separatists' arms, Chairman Papanoida hunts Greedo on Tatooine while Ahsoka and Senator Chuchi search the Trade Federation blockade.
Sent shopping for Padmé's banquet, C-3PO and R2-D2 are snatched by Cad Bane, who pulls the Senate building's plans from R2 and then wipes their memories.
Cad Bane seizes senators as hostages to force Ziro the Hutt's release, unaware that Anakin is loose in the building without his lightsaber. Palpatine ultimately frees Ziro.
Freed from Hutt captivity by his old flame Sy Snootles, Ziro hunts for his diary of Hutt crimes. Obi-Wan and Quinlan Vos give chase, but Sy kills him.
Struggling to handle two lightsabers, Ahsoka is challenged to a duel by Yoda, who teaches her that the style that makes her unique is also her strength.
Ahsoka is assigned to a mission Anakin hoped to spend alone with Padmé. His impatient shortcut drops all three into a Separatist blockade they must escape together.
Before a delicate negotiation, Ahsoka notices a table set wrong in Padmé's apartment and exposes the handmaiden as Cato Parasitti, a shape-shifting assassin with a hidden bomb.
During a flying lesson, a lurking droid fighter ambushes Ahsoka and Padmé. When Ahsoka is knocked out shielding her friend, Padmé must improvise to win alone.
Hurrying to a Temple ceremony, Ahsoka stops to save an Aleena mother and child from a haywire droid. Yoda rewards her with a longer Padawan braid.
Padmé secretly travels to Raxus with Ahsoka to seek peace with her mentor Mina Bonteri. Ahsoka meets the Separatists as people, while profiteers plot to wreck the talks.
Padmé, Bail and Onaconda Farr fight a bill to deregulate the banks and buy more clones. Hired thugs beat Bail and stalk Padmé, whose speech still sinks it.
When Onaconda Farr, a senator Padmé loves like an uncle, is poisoned at a gathering of colleagues, she finds the killer is his own aide, Lolo Purs.
Ordered by Sidious to be rid of his too-powerful apprentice, Dooku betrays Asajj Ventress. She survives, returns to the Nightsisters of Dathomir and strikes back at her master.
Ventress picks Savage Opress from the Nightbrothers through deadly trials, and Talzin's magic makes him a monster. Given to Dooku as an apprentice, he secretly serves the witches.
Obi-Wan and Anakin trace a Jedi-killer to Dathomir as Savage Opress and Ventress turn on Dooku. When the plot collapses, Talzin sends Savage to find his long-lost brother.
An ancient Jedi signal pulls Obi-Wan, Anakin and Ahsoka to Mortis, where the godlike Father tests whether Anakin is the Chosen One, able to master his warring children.
The Son seizes Ahsoka and corrupts her to lure Anakin. His dagger thrust at the Father strikes the Daughter instead, and she spends her last strength reviving Ahsoka.
Shown his future as Darth Vader, Anakin sides with the Son to avert it. The Father wipes the vision and dies so Anakin can slay the Son.
Smuggled in carbonite, Obi-Wan, Anakin, a clone team and a stowaway Ahsoka break into the Citadel, a prison built for Jedi, to free Even Piell and Captain Tarkin.
Breaking out of the Citadel with the freed prisoners, the Jedi argue tactics as Tarkin sows doubt. Their shuttle is blown apart, and Echo is lost.
Stranded on Lola Sayu, the Jedi march the freed prisoners toward Plo Koon's rescue fleet. Mauled by hunting beasts, Even Piell dies, passing his secret to Ahsoka.
Captured on Felucia, Ahsoka wakes on a Trandoshan hunting moon alongside abducted younglings. She rallies them to fight back, but the struggle claims Kalifa's life.
New captive Chewbacca helps Ahsoka and the younglings rig a transmitter on the Trandoshan hunting moon. It summons Tarfful's Wookiee warriors, who help them overthrow the hunters.
Mon Cala's king is murdered and the Quarren revolt. As Padmé's peace talks fail, Riff Tamson's Separatist army strikes, and untested Prince Lee-Char must survive to lead.
With the Republic force routed beneath Mon Cala's seas, Ahsoka guards Prince Lee-Char as the Gungan army arrives to help. Tamson's whirlpools sweep the allies into captivity.
Captured by Riff Tamson, the Jedi endure interrogation as Prince Lee-Char and Ahsoka rally the prisoners. The Quarren switch sides, and Lee-Char slays Tamson and is crowned.
Jar Jar, a dead ringer for the wounded Boss Lyonie, poses as the Gungan leader and helps capture Grievous, until Dooku seizes Anakin and forces a prisoner swap.
After quakes batter the planet Aleen, C-3PO and R2 tumble into a strange realm beneath the surface and learn only droids can seal the breach behind the tremors.
Escaping Grievous aboard a Y-wing, R2 and C-3PO wander from world to world, meeting tiny Patitites and the people of Balnab before landing in a pirate gladiator pit.
When Anakin is recalled from the Umbara campaign, Jedi General Pong Krell takes the 501st. His ruthless orders cost Rex's men dearly in the push toward the capital.
Pong Krell sends Rex's men up a narrow gorge to take an Umbaran airbase, brushing off every objection. Casualties mount until Fives and Hardcase commandeer enemy fighters.
Defying Krell's orders, Fives, Jesse and Hardcase steal Umbaran starfighters to destroy an enemy supply ship. Hardcase gives his life, and Krell orders the survivors court-martialed.
Krell orders Fives and Jesse shot, then tricks two clone battalions into firing on each other. Rex's men realize their general is a traitor, and Dogma ends him.
Arriving to defend the Togruta colony on Kiros, Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka find it empty. Dooku has handed the colonists to Zygerrian slavers, who leave bombs behind.
Posing as a slaver on Zygerria to find the missing Togruta, Anakin is ordered to whip Obi-Wan. Their escape fails, and Queen Miraj keeps Anakin as her slave.
Anakin warns Queen Miraj she is Dooku's pawn, and Dooku kills her. On Kadavo, Obi-Wan nears despair in a slave camp until Anakin and Ahsoka free the colonists.
Lux Bonteri storms a peace summit to accuse Dooku of his mother's murder, then seeks revenge through Death Watch. Ahsoka follows and witnesses his new allies' brutality.
Obi-Wan fakes his death and wears his assassin's face to infiltrate a plot against Palpatine from a cell beside Cad Bane. Anakin, kept in the dark, grieves.
Escaping with Cad Bane and the scheming Moralo Eval, the disguised Obi-Wan keeps his cover while Anakin, blind to the ruse, hunts his master's supposed killer.
Still disguised, Obi-Wan competes with Cad Bane in Dooku's lethal trial on Serenno, the Box, where only five bounty hunters win places in the kidnapping plot.
At Naboo's Festival of Light, Dooku's hired hunters, with Obi-Wan still undercover among them, move to seize Palpatine. Anakin, now in on the secret, races to stop them.
Dooku sends Grievous to destroy the Nightsisters for their betrayal. Ventress and Mother Talzin lead the witches' defense of Dathomir, but the droid army wipes out their clan.
Young Morgan Elsbeth survives Grievous's massacre of the Nightsisters and shelters with the peaceful Mountain Clan, until her thirst for revenge endangers their young and leaves her alone.
Adrift, Ventress joins Boba Fett's bounty hunters guarding a chest on Quarzite. The cargo is an unwilling bride, so Ventress swaps in a bound Boba and frees her.
Savage Opress tracks his long-lost brother to the junk world of Lotho Minor and finds Maul alive, half-mad and scuttling on spider-like legs.
Restored by Mother Talzin, Maul massacres a village to lure Obi-Wan into a trap. Facing both brothers, Obi-Wan survives by teaming up with Ventress, who wants Savage's bounty.
The Jedi secretly train rebels on Separatist-held Onderon, among them Lux Bonteri and siblings Steela and Saw Gerrera, to retake their capital from a puppet king.
The Onderon rebels strike across Iziz but struggle to win over the people. Steela Gerrera is chosen to lead over her brother Saw, and only Ahsoka stays behind.
The rebels try to stop King Dendup's execution and are caught. General Tandin turns on the puppet king to free them, and Ahsoka breaks her orders to help.
Onderon rises against the droids, and Hondo's smuggled rockets turn the fight. Victory restores King Dendup, but Steela falls to her death when Ahsoka's Force grip breaks.
Ahsoka takes six younglings to Ilum's ice caves, where each must overcome a personal flaw to claim a lightsaber crystal before the entrance freezes over.
Heading home from Ilum, the younglings are building their lightsabers with the droid Huyang when Hondo's pirates board to steal their crystals. Ahsoka is captured holding them off.
With Ahsoka held for sale on Florrum, the younglings sneak into Hondo's base disguised as acrobats in a traveling troupe and free her.
Grievous storms Hondo's Florrum stronghold, forcing Ahsoka and the captured younglings into an alliance with the pirates to repel the droids and escape.
Colonel Gascon, a strategist with no field experience, leads R2-D2 and a droid squad aboard a Separatist dreadnought to steal a decoding module, and learns to trust them.

records.ti: A Sunny Day in the Void
records.lg: Downed by a comet storm, D-Squad crash-lands on Abafar, a featureless desert. As power and tempers run low, the droids and Colonel Gascon must cross the Void together.
records.wp: A Sunny Day in the Void

records.lg: Stranded in a dusty Abafar town, D-Squad finds Gregor, an amnesiac clone commando washing dishes. As his training returns, he stays behind to cover their escape.
D-Squad's ride home is a droid-hijacked cruiser packed with explosives, aimed at a Republic summit. M5-BZ and R2-D2 sacrifice themselves to stop it, though R2 is later rebuilt.
records.wp: Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)

records.lg: Maul and Savage Opress plunder the Outer Rim and seize Hondo's pirates to build a following. Obi-Wan and Adi Gallia track them down, and Savage kills Adi.
After a run of victories, Obi-Wan and Anakin follow a report of Grievous to icebound Nelvaan, where Anakin kills a horax and enrages the natives.
Rescued adrift by Death Watch, Maul and Savage ally with Pre Vizsla and force Black Sun, the Pykes and the Hutts into a criminal army aimed at Mandalore.
Maul's criminals stage chaos in Sundari so Death Watch can play saviors and topple Satine. Betrayed by Pre Vizsla, Maul kills him in a duel and takes Mandalore.
Obi-Wan slips onto Mandalore alone to rescue Satine, but Maul captures him and kills her before his eyes. Darth Sidious arrives to punish his former apprentice, killing Savage.
A bomb rips through the Jedi Temple, and Anakin and Ahsoka trace it to Letta Turmond, who turned her husband into a walking weapon with nano-droids.

records.ti: The Jedi Who Knew Too Much
records.lg: Summoned by bomber Letta Turmond, Ahsoka finds her strangled by someone using the Force. Framed for the murder and clashing with Admiral Tarkin, she breaks out of custody.
records.wp: The Jedi Who Knew Too Much

records.lg: In Coruscant's underworld, Ahsoka teams up with an unlikely ally, Asajj Ventress, as Anakin hunts her. A friend's tip leads her to hidden explosives, and into a trap.
Expelled by the Jedi and tried for murder, Ahsoka is saved when Anakin unmasks the real bomber, her friend Barriss Offee. Invited back, Ahsoka walks away.
At Ringo Vinda, trooper Tup kills a Jedi Master and can't explain why. Escorting him to Kamino, Anakin and Fives fend off a Separatist bid to seize him.
Quarantined on Kamino, Fives and droid AZI-3 dig into why Tup killed a Jedi and find a strange growth in his brain. Removing it costs Tup his life.
Facing a memory wipe, Fives escapes the Kaminoans and, with AZI-3, finds the same organic chip in every clone's brain. He has his own cut out.
Taking his findings to Palpatine, Fives is framed for attacking the Chancellor and hunted across Coruscant. He reaches Rex and Anakin just before Commander Fox shoots him.
Seeking a loan on Scipio, Padmé learns from Rush Clovis that the Banking Clan's leaders are looting it. With Anakin's help, they flee the bounty hunter Embo.
A Separatist armada storms Coruscant and Grievous bursts in on Palpatine, while on Nelvaan a shaman hails Anakin as a prophesied savior and sends him on a trial.
Clovis exposes the Banking Clan's corrupt leaders and is installed to run it, secretly thanks to Dooku. Anakin's jealousy of Clovis pushes his marriage to the brink.
Shaak Ti's Jedi rush Palpatine across Coruscant with Grievous in pursuit; on Nelvaan, Anakin glimpses his dark future in cave pictograms and finds captive warriors being mutated.
Anakin frees Nelvaan's mutated warriors and destroys the machine freezing their world, while Grievous cuts down Palpatine's guards, seizes the Chancellor, and flees, his chest crushed by Windu.
Clovis's deal with Dooku comes due as droids occupy Scipio. The Republic invades; Clovis falls to his death to spare Padmé, and Palpatine gains control of the banks.
When Bardotta's Force-attuned mystics start vanishing, Queen Julia will trust only Jar Jar. Mace Windu comes along, and the pair uncover a cult that abducts the queen.
Mace and Jar Jar chase the kidnapped Queen Julia to Zardossa Stix, where a cult drains the Force from its victims. Its hidden leader is Mother Talzin.
Sifo-Dyas's long-lost lightsaber sends Obi-Wan and Anakin digging into his death and the clone army's origins. The trail runs through the Pykes to Dooku himself.
Yoda hears the voice of long-dead Qui-Gon Jinn. With the Council fearing the dark side at work, he slips away from the Temple to follow it to Dagobah.
Guided by Qui-Gon, Yoda reaches the planet at the Force's source, where five Priestesses test him against his own dark side and a tempting vision of peace.
On Moraband, the Sith homeworld, Yoda faces a final test as Darth Sidious tries to snare him in a vision. Yoda holds firm, earning the path beyond death.
Investigating a Jedi Master's death on Utapau, Obi-Wan and Anakin uncover a black-market deal to sell the Separatists a weapon of frightening power.
Tracking the arms dealers across Utapau, Obi-Wan and Anakin let themselves be captured to reach their prize, a giant kyber crystal. Anakin also vents about Ahsoka's departure.
Obi-Wan and Anakin haul a giant kyber crystal across Utapau with Grievous on their heels, until a treacherous governor hands it to the Separatists.
Aboard Grievous's warship with the kyber crystal, Obi-Wan and Anakin turn its power on the droids, then overload it, wrecking the ship and much of the Separatist fleet.
Newly on her own, Ahsoka crashes into Coruscant's underworld and befriends the pilot Trace Martez. She must keep her Jedi skills quiet when a rogue droid runs amok.
Rafa books a smuggling run on Trace's new ship. Learning the cargo is Pyke spice, Trace dumps it, leaving the sisters and Ahsoka owing a deadly syndicate.
Held by the Pykes on Oba Diah, Ahsoka and the bickering Martez sisters attempt a breakout but are shot down and recaptured, as hidden Mandalorians watch Ahsoka.
Ahsoka stays as the Pykes' hostage while the Martez sisters fetch replacement spice, and discovers the syndicate answers to Maul. Then Bo-Katan asks her help against him.
Facing droids that predict his every tactic on Anaxes, Rex joins Clone Force 99, a squad of mutant clones, and finds signs that Echo may be alive.
Anakin, Rex and Clone Force 99 raid a Techno Union fortress on Skako Minor and find Echo alive, wired into machines that turn his mind against the Republic.
Freed but frail, Echo escapes Wat Tambor's fortress with Anakin, Rex and Clone Force 99 on tamed keeradaks, then helps defend the local Poletec village from Tambor's droids.
With Echo's knowledge, Anakin, Rex and Clone Force 99 infiltrate Admiral Trench's dreadnought to feed the droids false plans. Anakin ends Trench, and Echo joins his new squad.
Ahsoka and Bo-Katan seek the Republic's help to free Mandalore from Maul. Called away to Coruscant, Anakin returns Ahsoka's lightsabers and lends her Rex's troops.
Tempted by Palpatine's promise to save Padmé, Anakin becomes Darth Vader as the Jedi are wiped out, the Empire rises and Padmé dies delivering twins.
records.wp: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

records.lg: Hunting a Jedi with the Fourth Sister, Barriss Offee watches her partner massacre villagers and strike down a surrendering fugitive, turns on her, and sheds her Inquisitor helmet.
Maul warns Ahsoka that Sidious is poised to seize the galaxy, with Anakin as his prize. Refusing to join him, she duels Maul across Sundari and captures him.
Taking the captured Maul to Coruscant, Ahsoka is aboard a cruiser full of clones when Order 66 comes. Rex, fighting his programming, warns her just in time.
Order 66 fails to sway most of Clone Force 99, and the Empire turns on them. They flee Kamino with young Omega as a reprogrammed Crosshair stays behind.
Hunted aboard a cruiser of clones obeying Order 66, Rex and Ahsoka fight their way out as Maul wrecks the ship. They bury the fallen and disappear.
Imprisoned as the Jedi fall, Barriss Offee accepts an offer to join the Inquisitors. Trained by the Grand Inquisitor, she earns her place by killing a rival recruit.
After Padmé's funeral, Ahsoka hides among farmers under a false name. When an Inquisitor burns their village, she kills him and calls Bail Organa, ready to fight again.
Hunter hopes to leave Omega with deserter Cut Lawquane's family on Saleucami. When the Empire's new chain codes force the Lawquanes to flee, Omega chooses the squad instead.
Stranded on a barren moon, Omega helps Hunter track a power-eating dragon that stole a vital part. Elsewhere, Crosshair leads the Empire's new enlisted squad against Saw Gerrera.
A supply stop on Pantora goes wrong when bounty hunter Fennec Shand comes for Omega, chasing her and Hunter across the moon's city streets.
To learn who hired the bounty hunter chasing Omega, the squad takes a job from Ord Mantell fixer Cid: rescue a young rancor, Muchi, from Zygerrian slavers.
Sent to steal a tactical droid's head from a Corellian scrapping plant, the squad clashes with Rafa and Trace Martez, thieves quietly working for an anti-Imperial movement.
Rex tracks down the Batch and leads them to a derelict Jedi cruiser to remove their inhibitor chips, but Wrecker's chip activates first, turning him against Omega.
Still aboard a derelict cruiser on Bracca, the Batch are cornered by Crosshair and his troopers. They fight their way out, only for Cad Bane to snatch Omega.
Cad Bane delivers Omega to a Kaminoan handoff on Bora Vio as the Batch learn she is an unaltered Jango Fett clone. Fennec Shand's ambush lets her escape.
Hired to spring former Separatist senator Avi Singh from Imperial arrest on Raxus, the Batch find their old enemy is now standing up to the Empire.
Hera Syndulla is swept into Ryloth's resistance to the Empire. Her parents rescue her from an Imperial convoy, but Rampart has Crosshair wound Senator Taa and blames them.
Young Hera Syndulla enlists Hunter's squad to free her parents from Imperial custody in Lessu, and clone Captain Howzer must choose between orders and conscience.
When a gangster, Roland Durand, seizes Cid's parlor as a front for Pyke spice, the Batch and Cid steal his shipment through bug-infested tunnels to break his deal.
Rex sends the squad to rescue his friend Gregor from a hidden Imperial base on Daro, where non-clone recruits are training. Hunter is captured covering their escape.
Crosshair lures his old squad to Kamino using the captured Hunter. Abandoned by the Empire, he reveals his chip is long gone, and Imperial ships bombard Tipoca City.
As Tipoca City sinks, the Batch and Omega struggle to escape with the unconscious Crosshair. He helps save AZI-3 but still refuses to leave with them.
Cid offers the Batch a job that could clear their debts: stealing Count Dooku's war chest from Imperial-held Serenno. The heist goes wrong and splits the squad.
Stranded on Serenno with Tech hurt, Omega and Echo shelter with Romar, a survivor of the Imperial bombing, until Omega sneaks off after the war chest.
Crosshair and Commander Cody move against a Separatist holdout on Desix. When Crosshair executes its surrendered governor on Imperial orders, Cody questions their choices and deserts.
When Cid loses a bet on Safa Toma, crime boss Millegi holds her as collateral. Omega bargains for one more race, and Tech drives to win her back.
Omega's junkyard relic leads the Batch and treasure hunter Phee Genoa to an uncharted world, where the fabled vault turns out to be an ancient war machine.
Omega frees Gungi, a young Wookiee Jedi held by smugglers, and the Batch take him home to Kashyyyk, where Trandoshans with Imperial tanks are burning Wookiee villages.
Riyo Chuchi finds a clone who can expose the truth about Kamino's destruction, but an assassin silences him. Rex rescues Chuchi; the killer dies rather than talk.
The Batch help Rex steal proof of Rampart's attack on Kamino, and Chuchi exposes him. Palpatine turns the scandal into a law replacing clones; Echo leaves with Rex.
Revived by Mother Talzin at a steep price, Ventress hides as a spaceport guard until a Jedi boy, Lyco Strata, draws her into a fight with an Inquisitor.
Ventress and Lyco help Latts Razzi rob an Imperial shipyard in return for the Hidden Path's location. Razzi betrays them to sell Lyco; Ventress turns the tables.
Seeking the Hidden Path, Ventress and Lyco end a Separatist veteran's water war with local raiders. Then Lyco passes up his escape to stay with Ventress.
A thief steals the Marauder while the Batch mine volatile ipsium for Cid on a stormy world. Trapped by a cave-in and missing Echo, Omega and Tech reconcile.
Tracking Gonky's signal, the Batch catch Baro, the young thief who took their ship, and make him guide them to Mokko, a boss who cheats his own miners.
Probing a crashed Imperial science ship, the Batch discover a cloned Zillo Beast. As commandos reclaim it, Tech concludes Kamino was razed so the Empire could seize cloning.
Posted to an icy depot on Barton IV, Crosshair bonds with veteran clone Mayday. When Lieutenant Nolan lets Mayday die, Crosshair kills Nolan and wakes in a lab.
Phee Genoa brings the Batch to Pabu, a hidden island sanctuary for refugees. When a tsunami hits, the clones help evacuate its people and stay on to rebuild.
Echo and Gregor free dissident clones from a transport bound for Dr. Hemlock's science division, and the Batch learn Crosshair is Hemlock's prisoner and may be signaling them.
The Batch sneak into Tarkin's summit on Eriadu to track Hemlock, whose base holds Crosshair, and run into Saw Gerrera's plot to bomb it. Their escape stalls midair.
Tech gives his life so the Batch can escape Eriadu. Then Cid sells them out to Hemlock, who carries Omega off to his lab, where Crosshair is held.
A prisoner on Wayland, Omega works in Hemlock's lab beside her clone sister, Emerie Karr, and befriends a lurca hound, Batcher, whom she sets free.
Following a lead to Setron, Hunter and Wrecker find Hemlock's old lab bombed flat and three abandoned clone cadets surviving among engineered killer vines.
As the Emperor tours Tantiss, Omega seizes her chance, frees Crosshair and escapes with him and Batcher. Hemlock learns her blood holds the key to his secret project.
Crash-landed on Lau, Omega and Crosshair must outwit a corrupt Imperial captain to get off-world with Batcher. Omega then reunites with Hunter and Wrecker, Crosshair in tow.
Echo rejoins the squad as they take Nala Se's broken datapad to a snowy Imperial depot, where a burrowing wyrm forces Hunter and Crosshair to reconcile.
Rex foils a clone assassin's attack on a secret senators' meeting and summons the Batch to his Teth hideout, but a second elite assassin tracks Omega there.
Wolffe's commandos and a Clone X killer chase the fugitives through Teth's jungle, until Rex talks his old comrade Wolffe into letting them go.
To learn what the M-count means, Hunter and Wrecker team up with Fennec Shand on a bounty hunt, only for her to stall on her promise.
Asajj Ventress arrives as Fennec's contact, gauges Omega's Force potential during a sea-monster scrape, downplays what she finds, and warns the clones to leave Pabu.
Promoted by Hemlock, Emerie Karr enters the Tantiss vault, meets the kidnapped Force-sensitive children held there, and begins to question the work.
CX-2 traces Phee's navigation logs to Pabu; as Imperial troops storm the island, Omega surrenders to spare its people, and Crosshair's tracker shot misses.
records.wp: Point of No Return (The Bad Batch)

records.lg: While Hemlock seals Omega in the Tantiss vault, her brothers hijack the turbo tank carrying Rampart from a prison mine, betting he can lead them to the base.
Inside the vault, Omega befriends the captive children and plots an escape, while her brothers and Rampart latch a stolen shuttle onto a Tantiss-bound science vessel.
Shot down over Wayland's jungle, the clones push toward Tantiss, while Echo slips inside in stormtrooper armor and finds an unexpected ally in Emerie Karr.
Omega and Echo rally Tantiss's prisoners to rescue the captured Batch as Hemlock's project collapses. Years later, a grown Omega leaves Pabu to join the Rebellion.
On Janix, Maul provokes a deadly gang war, then raids the police precinct to seize crime lord Looti Vario and finds a jailed Padawan, Devon Izara.
Maul escapes Daki and the police with his captives, tempts Devon toward a darker path, and raids a Pyke shipment, as Lawson learns of the Shadow Collective.
Devon spurns Maul's offer to train her and fights her way out as he stokes her anger, while Vario is forced to bait the Pyke boss.
Maul kills Pyke boss Marg Krim, ambushes the police when Lawson spurns a truce, and duels Daki and Devon; then an Imperial Star Destroyer arrives.
The Empire locks down Janix and the Inquisitor Marrok interrogates Lawson, while Daki and Devon, unable to escape the city, turn up at Lawson's home.
Marrok's raid turns Lawson, his son and the two Jedi into fugitives; when the Inquisitor corners Devon on a train, Maul arrives to fight at her side.
Devon breaks with Maul as stormtroopers seize Rylee; at a forest waterfall, two Inquisitors kill Scorn and corner Maul, who brings a cave down around them.
Crippled and alone underground, Maul wrestles with visions of his past, while Two Boots frees Rylee and Rheena Sul wrecks an Imperial ambush set for Lawson's group.
Promised passage by Dryden Vos, Maul teams with Lawson and the Jedi to flee Janix; Spybot and Icarus fall, and Darth Vader waits in the fog.
Darth Vader kills Daki after Maul abandons him, and Lawson makes a last stand so Rylee can escape. Grieving, Devon agrees to become Maul's apprentice.
Dumped on Ingo, R2-D2 and C-3PO join racers Thall Joben and Jord Dusat, then help snatch Jord from gangster Tig Fromm's base aboard the speeder White Witch.
Sheltering with Rebel Kea Moll on Annoo, Thall, Jord, and the droids dodge a Fromm assassin droid, then steal the gang's weapons satellite, the Trigon One.
The Fromms seize Kea's mother and reclaim the Trigon One, but Thall, Kea, and the droids escape Sise Fromm's fortress as the satellite plunges into it.
Hunted by Boba Fett for the vengeful Fromms, Thall's team wins the Boonta Speeder Race and a job offer, but the droids leave so their friends can accept.
Miner Jann Tosh takes in the droids and a supposed android he names Kez-Iban, really the lost Prince Mon Julpa, and they escape crime lord Kleb Zellock's mines.
Jann, the droids, and pilot Jessica Meade escort Mon Julpa home to Tammuz-an, where they foil the scheming Vizier Zatec-Cha and see the prince crowned king.
Pirate Kybo Ren captures Jann, Jessica, and the droids on a fuel run; they escape his Tarnoonga lair and help Mon Julpa's navy beat his stolen Star Destroyer.
Kybo Ren escapes and kidnaps Lord Toda's daughter Gerin; Jann and the droids stall the pirates while Toda's hidden warriors spring a trap, sealing peace with Mon Julpa.
Escorting Prince Coby to the Imperial Academy, the droids help him chase poachers who stole his pet Ingey, and with the Fuzzums they free a captive menagerie.
On Biitu, Artoo and Threepio join their new master Mungo Baobab against the Great Heep, a colossal droid sucking the planet dry, and destroy its moisture eater.
Chasing a map to the fabled Roon system, Mungo and the droids are captured at Governor Koong's pirate station, then escape Screed as it smashes into an asteroid.
Downed on Roon, Mungo and the droids join Auren Yomm's team at the Roon Games and, with C-3PO braving the Drainsweeper Race, beat Governor Koong's cheating squad.
Mungo's dying great-uncle Oggem bequeaths him six bags of Roonstones, but after escaping Koong's slave galley, Mungo must sacrifice them to clear a whirlpool.
Koong looses the Rooze plague on Umboo; Mungo, the Yomms, and the droids grab a cure from his volcano fortress as it freezes over, ending his reign.
On Ord Mantell, Hondo and IG-88 catch Qi'ra, but she turns her captors against each other and marches both off to collect their bounties.
Young Han flees Corellia, joins Chewbacca in a coaxium heist on Kessel, and loses his first love Qi'ra to Crimson Dawn but wins the Falcon from Lando.
Rebuffed by the Empire and reviled by her Corvus townsfolk, Morgan Elsbeth survives a Noghri assassin's test and wins Thrawn's backing by admitting her motive, revenge.
Obi-Wan lives in hiding on Tatooine, watching young Luke from afar, until Bail Organa begs him to rescue a kidnapped ten-year-old Leia.
On Daiyu, Obi-Wan snatches Leia back from her kidnappers while the Inquisitor Reva hunts them, declares Anakin alive, and stabs her own superior.
Obi-Wan meets Vader for the first time since Mustafar and is dragged through fire until Tala intervenes, while Reva closes in on Leia.
Obi-Wan and Tala infiltrate the Inquisitors' fortress on Nur to free Leia from Reva's interrogation; they escape, unaware that Reva has planted a tracker on them.
Vader besieges the refugees on Jabiim and Tala sacrifices herself; Reva, a Temple massacre survivor, strikes at Vader, is left for dead, and learns of Luke.
Obi-Wan lures Vader away from the fleeing refugees and defeats him, accepting that Anakin is gone, while Reva finds she cannot kill young Luke on Tatooine.
Searching for his long-lost sister, Cassian kills two corporate security officers outside a Morlana One brothel and slips back to Ferrix to cover his tracks.
As Syril Karn closes in, Cassian waits on Bix's buyer for a stolen Imperial part, unaware that her jealous partner Timm has tipped off the authorities.
Luthen Rael comes to buy the stolen Starpath unit as Syril's botched raid hits Ferrix, and Cassian escapes with Luthen, who offers him far more than money.
Luthen places Cassian with Vel's rebels on Aldhani, who plan to steal an Imperial garrison's payroll, as Mon Mothma and Dedra Meero maneuver on Coruscant.
As Vel's crew drills for the Aldhani raid, Cassian's mercenary motives spark mistrust, while Dedra Meero spots a pattern in scattered thefts of Imperial gear.
Under cover of the Eye meteor shower, the crew robs the Aldhani garrison of its payroll at a deadly cost, and Cassian walks away with his share.
The Empire answers Aldhani with harsher sentencing laws, and Cassian, laying low on Niamos, is caught in a pointless arrest and sentenced to six years.
Cassian is shipped to Narkina 5, a prison factory run on electrified floors, as Dedra Meero tightens her grip on Ferrix and Luthen woos Saw Gerrera.
In Narkina 5, Cassian learns no prisoner is ever released and draws Kino Loy toward revolt, while Dedra Meero has Bix tortured to find Cassian's buyer.
Cassian and Kino Loy lead the Narkina 5 prisoners in a breakout, while Luthen tells a mole in the ISB what his crusade has cost him.
Cassian escapes Narkina 5 only to learn Maarva has died; Luthen narrowly evades an Imperial cruiser, and news of the funeral draws a fixated Syril Karn's interest.
Maarva's recorded speech sparks a riot at her funeral; Cassian frees Bix in the chaos, then confronts Luthen with a choice: recruit him or kill him.
Chased by TIE fighters after a convoy raid, Hera and Kanan bicker through Chopper over repairs, until the fed-up droid shoots down the last fighter himself.
Sabine slips onto an Imperial airfield, tags a parked TIE fighter with her signature art, and blows it up as a diversion so the Ghost can escape.
On Lothal, Zeb saves a street vendor from stormtroopers and brawls his way through their reinforcements around a parked TIE fighter, which ends up exploding.
Ezra frees Baron Valen Rudor from his downed TIE fighter, and when the ungrateful pilot scolds him, Ezra strips the ship for parts and takes his helmet.

records.ti: Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion
records.lg: Lothal street thief Ezra Bridger crashes the Ghost crew's heist, helps them rescue enslaved Wookiees, and learns that Kanan is a Jedi willing to train him.
records.wp: Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion

records.lg: Stealing Imperial weapons for Vizago, the crew runs into R2-D2 and C-3PO and discovers the cargo is banned disruptor rifles, too deadly to hand over.
Sent to fetch meiloorun fruit, bickering bunkmates Zeb and Ezra draw Imperial attention, hijack a TIE fighter, and learn to work as a team.
Struggling to train Ezra, Kanan leads a rescue of Jedi Master Luminara Unduli from an Imperial prison, only to find her long dead and the Inquisitor waiting.
Posing as a cadet at Lothal's Imperial Academy, Ezra steals a decoder with Zare Leonis's help and smuggles out Jai Kell before the Inquisitor claims him.
Resentful of Hera's secrets, Sabine is stranded with her at an abandoned asteroid fort, where light-shy fyrnocks attack and the two relearn to trust each other.
On his birthday, Empire Day, Ezra revisits his family's old home as the crew smuggles out Tseebo, an Imperial defector with a head full of secrets.
Kanan and Ezra lure the Inquisitor to a fyrnock nest so Tseebo can reach Fulcrum, and Ezra, desperate to save his master, draws on the dark side.
Kanan brings Ezra to a hidden Lothal Jedi Temple, where Ezra confronts his fears, hears Yoda's guidance, and wins the crystal for his own lightsaber.
After Zeb loses Chopper to Lando at sabacc, the crew must help Lando smuggle a puffer pig past Azmorigan and the Empire to win the droid back.
Trusting a Force vision, Ezra leads the crew to meet dissident Senator Gall Trayvis, who turns out to be an Imperial plant luring them into Kallus's trap.
Grand Moff Tarkin arrives to crush the Lothal rebels; they seize the Imperial comm tower so Ezra can broadcast a call to resist, but Kanan is captured.
Defying Hera, Ezra wins Vizago's help with a show of Force power, and Chopper poses as an Imperial courier droid to learn Kanan is bound for Mustafar.
The crew storms Tarkin's Star Destroyer over Mustafar to rescue Kanan, who defeats the Inquisitor; a rebel fleet arrives, and Fulcrum is revealed as Ahsoka Tano.
A year on, Cassian steals a prototype TIE fighter and lands among feuding rebels, while Krennic secretly briefs the ISB on a plan for Ghorman.
Trapped in a rebel feud, Cassian escapes in his stolen TIE, as Dedra reluctantly takes on Ghorman and an Imperial officer's attentions put Bix in danger.
On Mina-Rau, Bix kills an Imperial officer who assaults her; Cassian arrives to fly the exiles out, but Brasso is killed, as Mon Mothma's daughter weds.
Lured back to Lothal to extract a defecting minister, the crew barely survives Darth Vader, who frames them for her death and discovers Ahsoka is alive.
Sent by Ahsoka to find an old friend, the crew meets Rex and fellow clone veterans Wolffe and Gregor on Seelos, reopening Kanan's wounds from Order 66.
Wolffe's suspicions bring Agent Kallus to Seelos, where rebels and old clones fight his walkers side by side, and Rex rejoins Ahsoka.
Raiding a derelict Republic medical station for supplies, Ezra, Zeb, Sabine and Chopper run into two new Inquisitors, the Fifth Brother and the Seventh Sister.
Ducking chores, Ezra answers a distress call from the pirate Hondo Ohnaka, gets swept into his schemes, and realizes he no longer wants to go it alone.
Hera seeks out reclusive engineer Quarrie and flies his untested B-wing prototype through an Imperial blockade to save starving Ibaar, earning the title Phoenix Leader.
Picking up a secret courier droid, Sabine runs into Ketsu Onyo, her old partner turned bounty hunter, and the estranged friends end up fighting side by side.
When an Interdictor's gravity well snares Ezra and Commander Sato, Kanan and Rex bury their mistrust, sneak aboard, and turn the ship's weapon against it.
On Garel, Jyn Erso snatches back a girl's pet tooka from bullying stormtroopers, outwits them in the back alleys, and returns the cat to its owner.
Ahsoka tosses away the crystal from Ezra's new lightsaber and presses him with her blade, teaching him to trust the Force rather than his weapon.
Ahsoka and the crew rescue Force-sensitive infants from the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister, but a probe droid uncovers the rebels' hideout on Garel.
Cassian and a traumatized Bix hide in Luthen's Coruscant safehouse, while Syril goes undercover among Ghorman dissidents for the ISB and Wilmon falls in with Saw Gerrera.
Disguised as a fashion designer, Cassian sizes up the Ghorman Front's heist plans, while Kleya's listening bug risks discovery and Wilmon joins Saw's Partisans.
Cinta is killed by a stray shot during a Ghorman heist the ISB is watching, while Bix, with Cassian's help, takes revenge on her torturer.
A vision of his parents draws Ezra back to Lothal, where ex-governor Ryder Azadi reveals they died in a prison breakout sparked by Ezra's own broadcast.
Princess Leia brings three cruisers to Lothal for the rebels to steal, sparing Alderaan suspicion, and improvises with Ezra and Kanan when Imperial security tightens.
After Mandalorian Protectors ambush Hera's squadron and injure her, Kanan and Sabine confront their leader, Fenn Rau, and capture him to secure safe passage.
Rescued from the Empire, two Lasat survivors convince a doubting Zeb he's their prophesied guide, and he leads them through a stellar maelstrom to their lost homeworld.
Running on empty, the crew raids a Mining Guild refinery, where Ezra bonds with the vast space whales called purrgil, who help turn the fight.
Sabine stages Princess Leia's kidnapping to collect secret Imperial base locations, and the two turn Leia's own guards against the bounty droid IG-88 to escape.
Hera joins her estranged father, Twi'lek freedom fighter Cham Syndulla, to steal an Imperial carrier over Ryloth; his hunger for vengeance nearly derails the job.
Marooned on a frozen moon of Geonosis, Zeb and his old enemy Kallus must work together to survive, and the Lasat's mercy leaves Kallus shaken.
At Lothal's Jedi Temple, Kanan is knighted after facing a spectral Temple Guard, Ezra is pointed to Malachor by Yoda, and Ahsoka learns what became of Anakin.
Marooned aboard an Imperial transport after stealing a new leg, Chopper befriends fussy inventory droid AP-5, who defects and points the rebels to a new base.
Setting up a new base on remote Atollon, the rebels discover giant krykna spiders nearby, while Hera dreads Kanan and Ezra's coming journey to Malachor.
Raiding an Imperial warehouse for food, Sabine and Ketsu find a Chadra-Fan boy in a crate, and saving him wins Ketsu over to the rebels.
Sabine reluctantly lends her freshly painted speeder bike to reckless Ketsu for a courier run, and when only a handlebar returns, she forgives her friend.
On Malachor, Ezra, Kanan and Ahsoka meet Maul, who betrays them and blinds Kanan, while Ahsoka faces her former master, Vader, as the Sith temple collapses.
Rushing a medkit heist, Sabine and Hera take off in the wrong shuttle, full of stormtroopers, and must leap mid-flight to the one Chopper is flying.
Jyn Erso picks up a holo-map Sabine dropped and gets chased as the thief; Sabine saves her and talks the loner into handing it over.
Emboldened by the Sith holocron, Ezra leads a reckless Y-wing heist, while the blinded Kanan seeks out the Bendu and returns in time to save him.
Maul holds the Ghost crew hostage so Ezra will join him in fusing their Jedi and Sith holocrons; they glimpse twin suns before Kanan pulls Ezra away.
Undercover at an Imperial flight academy, Sabine helps star cadets Wedge Antilles and Hobbie defect to the rebellion, springing free of a trap on the way.
Hera sneaks into her family's occupied Ryloth home to reclaim her mother's kalikori; she and Ezra are captured and escape, but Thrawn keeps the heirloom.
Salvaging a wrecked Separatist supply ship, Rex and the rebels meet battle droids still at war, replay the old fight, then join forces against the Empire.
Checking on silent Concord Dawn, Sabine, Ezra and captive Fenn Rau find his Protectors slaughtered by Gar Saxon's Imperial Super Commandos, and Rau joins the rebellion.
On Mykapo, the crew meets Iron Squadron, three teen rebels led by Sato's nephew Mart Mattin, and must rescue Mart when an Imperial trap closes.
Hondo enlists the crew to loot proton bombs from an Imperial freighter sinking into Wynkahthu's atmosphere, where sentry droids and Hondo's greed nearly doom the job.
Slipping into Lothal's Imperial factory in disguise, Kanan and Ezra steal plans as Thrawn exposes a saboteur, and learn the rebel informant Fulcrum is Agent Kallus.
To break Maul's hold on his mind, Ezra, Kanan and Sabine join Maul on Dathomir; there Maul learns Kenobi is alive, and Sabine takes the Darksaber.
Sent after Saw Gerrera's vanished squad, the crew finds Geonosis emptied by the Empire, save one Geonosian guarding an egg, and clashes with Saw's ruthless methods.
A stray droid Zeb brings home is an armed Imperial infiltrator; the rebels send it back to destroy its fellow spies, but Thrawn still narrows his search.
Kanan trains Sabine with the Darksaber so she can unite Mandalore, forcing her to confront the weapon she once built for the Empire and her estranged family.
Sabine brings the Darksaber home to Krownest, where her mother betrays her to Gar Saxon; Sabine defeats him, and Clan Wren turns on the Empire.
When stormtroopers build an outpost onto the old statue of their forebear Tarre Vizsla, Sabine persuades her brother Tristan to help her tear it down.
With the rebel base on Yavin growing, Cassian defies orders and slips off with Wilmon to Ghorman, as Imperial troops mass there, to assassinate Dedra Meero.
An Imperial false-flag shot turns Ghorman's protest into a massacre; Syril, stumbling on Cassian aiming at Dedra, attacks him and is killed by a Ghorman rebel.
Ezra sneaks aboard Thrawn's flagship to extract Kallus, but the spy chooses to stay, framing another officer, unaware Thrawn has already unmasked him.
Mon Mothma denounces the Ghorman massacre on the Senate floor and escapes Coruscant with Cassian's help; afterward, Bix leaves him, and a reprogrammed K-2SO powers up.
The Ghost crew and Gold Squadron sneak fugitive Senator Mon Mothma past Thrawn's fleet, and her broadcast unites scattered rebel cells into one Alliance.
Stealing Imperial clearance codes with Wedge and AP-5, Chopper is hacked by an Imperial controller and hijacks the Ghost, locking the crew in the cargo bay.
Ezra slips off to Tatooine to find Obi-Wan Kenobi and unwittingly leads Maul there; in a swift final duel, Kenobi strikes Maul down.
Thrawn unmasks Kallus and besieges Chopper Base; Commander Sato gives his life to break the blockade, and Mandalorian allies and the Bendu's fury help the rebels escape.
Sabine rescues her imprisoned father, destroys the Duchess, the armor-targeting superweapon she once designed, and passes the Darksaber to Bo-Katan.

records.ti: In the Name of the Rebellion
records.lg: Ezra and Sabine join Saw Gerrera on an Imperial freighter hauling a giant kyber crystal; when Saw turns reckless, they destroy it and free the prisoners aboard.
records.wp: In the Name of the Rebellion

records.lg: Back on Lothal at Ryder Azadi's call, Ezra and the crew find a planet crushed under Imperial occupation and learn of Thrawn's deadly new TIE Defender.
Ezra and Sabine steal a prototype TIE Defender Elite and crash it on Lothal, and a Loth-wolf carries them to safety, leaving Ezra a cryptic word.
Hunted by Thrawn's assassin Rukh, the rebels get Hera off Lothal with the Defender's flight data, while Loth-wolves lead the others through secret passages.
To get a message to Hera past Imperial jamming, the Lothal rebels commandeer a giant ore crawler, freeing its enslaved workers, among them an old acquaintance, Vizago.
Hera's rebel strike punches through Thrawn's blockade over Lothal, but a second wave of TIEs overwhelms her squadron, and Hera crash-lands and is captured.
Kanan leads a glider raid to rescue Hera from Governor Pryce, then holds back a fuel depot's inferno so his friends can escape, sacrificing himself.
As the crew mourns Kanan, Sabine and Zeb find his sacrifice crippled the TIE Defender factory, and the Loth-wolf Dume steers Ezra toward the Jedi Temple.
Loth-wolves carry Ezra and Sabine to the Jedi Temple, where Imperials are digging; Sabine decodes an ancient mural, and Ezra leaps through a hidden portal.
In a realm beyond time, Ezra snatches Ahsoka from her duel with Vader and must resist rescuing Kanan as the Emperor tries to seize the gateway.
Ryder feigns betrayal to lure Governor Pryce into attacking the Lothal rebels' camp, and when Hera arrives with old allies, the tables turn and Pryce is captured.
Lothal is freed as Ezra spurns the Emperor and sends purrgil to drag Thrawn's flagship, and himself, into hyperspace; Sabine and Ahsoka later go after him.
Barriss, now a healer, helps a Force-sensitive child escape the Fourth Sister, who accidentally stabs her, then renounces the Inquisitors and carries her to safety.
On Ord Mantell, a Chadra-Fan pickpocket grabs Jyn's kyber pendant; she chases him across rooftops, recovers it, and, seeing he's starving, hands him her fruit.
Dedra Meero corners Luthen, who stabs himself rather than talk; Kleya slips into the hospital to end his life, while the ISB arrests Dedra.
With Luthen dead and Dedra jailed, the ISB hunts Kleya and her terrible secret, and Cassian defies orders to extract her from Coruscant before the net closes.
K-2SO rescues Cassian and Kleya from the ISB; on Yavin, Luthen's final intel on an Imperial superweapon stuns the rebels, and Cassian is sent to Kafrene.
