events.summary: Secretly steered by Darth Sidious, the Federation throws a blockade around Naboo over the tax, tries to kill the Jedi envoys sent to negotiate, and lands a droid army that takes Theed. Queen Amidala will not sign a treaty making the occupation legal.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Anakin wins the Boonta Eve Classic
events.summary: Stranded on Tatooine with the Queen, Qui-Gon Jinn meets the slave boy Anakin Skywalker and senses his enormous Force potential. Anakin wins the Boonta Eve podrace, earning parts for the Queen's ship and his own freedom, and leaves his mother to become a Jedi.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: The Sith reveal themselves on Tatooine
events.summary: Tracking the Queen's ship, Darth Maul ambushes Qui-Gon Jinn in the desert outside Mos Espa. Qui-Gon escapes aboard the departing starship and reports the first Sith warrior seen by the Jedi in about a thousand years.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Amidala topples Chancellor Valorum
events.summary: With her appeal lost in Senate procedure, Queen Amidala takes Senator Palpatine's advice and moves to oust Chancellor Valorum through a no-confidence vote. Valorum falls, and Amidala leaves Coruscant resolved to free Naboo herself.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Dooku erases Kamino from the Archives
events.summary: Visiting the Jedi Temple as Qui-Gon reports his clash with a Sith, Dooku slips into the Archives and uses Sifo-Dyas's clearance to scrub Kamino's star system from the records, keeping the Jedi ignorant of the clone army.

events.title: Palpatine elected Supreme Chancellor
events.note: Elected while Amidala returns to Naboo; he arrives there as Chancellor after the battle.
events.summary: Buoyed by sympathy for his occupied homeworld, Senator Palpatine of Naboo wins the Senate's backing to replace Valorum at the head of the Republic. No one suspects that its new leader is the Sith Lord who engineered the crisis that raised him.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Battle of Naboo
events.summary: Now allied with the Gungans, Amidala strikes back: the Gungan army draws the droids onto the grasslands, the Queen captures Viceroy Gunray in the palace, and young Anakin destroys the droid control ship, shutting down the invasion army.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Maul kills Qui-Gon Jinn
events.summary: Deep in Theed's power generator, Darth Maul runs Qui-Gon Jinn through. Obi-Wan Kenobi avenges him, cutting Maul in two and sending him down a reactor shaft. Presumed dead, Maul survives and later hides on the junk world Lotho Minor.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Obi-Wan knighted and takes Anakin as Padawan
events.summary: The Council raises Obi-Wan Kenobi to Knight and, honoring Qui-Gon's last wish, lets him train Anakin Skywalker despite Yoda's doubts. Qui-Gon is cremated on Naboo, and a parade in Theed celebrates the new peace between Naboo's humans and Gungans.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

events.title: Dooku kills Yaddle and becomes Tyranus
events.summary: Shaken by Qui-Gon's death, Dooku meets Darth Sidious in secret. Master Yaddle follows him and confronts them both; at Sidious's urging Dooku kills her, completing his fall. He is reborn as Darth Tyranus, Sidious's new apprentice.

events.title: Sifo-Dyas murdered on Tyranus's orders
events.summary: Pushed off the Council for warning of war, Sifo-Dyas has gone in secret to Oba Diah with Silman, Valorum's personal aide, to bargain with the Pykes. On Tyranus's orders the Pykes shoot down his shuttle, and Silman is held as a hostage.

events.title: Tyranus recruits Jango Fett as clone template
events.summary: As Tyranus, Dooku recruits the renowned bounty hunter Jango Fett, whose DNA will be copied for the entire Kaminoan army. Under Sith direction, every clone is also fitted with a behavioral chip that will compel obedience to Order 66.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Boba Fett is born on Kamino
events.summary: As part of his fee, Jango Fett takes an unaltered clone to raise as his son, Boba. A near-identical female clone, later called Omega, stays on Kamino as assistant to the scientist Nala Se.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Secret orders for a clone war fleet
events.summary: An unnamed buyer places vast orders for weapons and warships with Kuat Drive Yards, whose subsidiary Rothana Heavy Engineering quietly designs Acclamator-class assault ships to carry the clone army growing on Kamino.

events.title: Sidious begins his Jakku observatory
events.summary: Darth Sidious starts building a secret observatory on the desert world Jakku. By 25 BBY his adviser Yupe Tashu has droids digging into the Plaintive Hand plateau, guarded by the orphan Gallius Rax, newly taken into Sidious's service.

events.title: Obi-Wan and Anakin on Carnelion IV
events.summary: Answering a distress call, Obi-Wan and his twelve-year-old Padawan find Carnelion IV torn apart by the Open–Closed War, and a Republic fleet arrives to enforce a ceasefire. Meanwhile Chancellor Palpatine cultivates Anakin, even touring Coruscant's lower levels with him incognito.

events.title: Padmé Amidala becomes Senator of Naboo
events.summary: After two terms, Padmé Amidala leaves the throne. Her successor, Queen Réillata, asks her to represent Naboo in the Galactic Senate, where she soon campaigns for relief to the quake-stricken world Bromlarch alongside Senator Rush Clovis.

events.title: Cliegg Lars frees and marries Shmi
events.summary: Tatooine farmer Cliegg Lars purchases Shmi Skywalker's freedom from Watto and marries her, taking her to his homestead. Anakin, far away in Jedi training, does not learn of it until years later.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Thrawn breaks the Vagaari; Thrass dies
events.summary: Senior Captain Thrawn leads the Chiss to a crushing win over the Vagaari pirates, but a ship from outside Chiss space, caught up in the fighting, crashes and kills his adoptive brother, Syndic Thrass. The Ascendancy's rulers blame Thrawn and take his cruiser Springhawk.

events.title: Tyranus arms the coming war on Sullust
events.summary: On Sidious's orders, Tyranus reaches a deal on Sullust with the Kaldana Syndicate of arms dealers while, as Count Dooku, he signs a trade pact between Serenno and SoroSuub. When the Jedi Jak'zin comes to investigate, Dooku kills him.

events.title: Galen and Lyra Erso marry
events.summary: The scientist Galen Erso marries Lyra, whom he met on Espinar, in a ceremony on Coruscant. Galen's work on crystal-based energy will draw the attention of his old friend Orson Krennic and, through him, the Republic's hidden weapons program.
events.wp: Wedding of Lyra and Galen Erso
sources: Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide

events.title: Dooku's Raxus Address launches the Separatists
events.summary: Count Dooku denounces a corrupt Republic in the Raxus Address and founds the Separatist Confederacy. Thousands of star systems secede and form their own Separatist Senate, opening the Separatist Crisis that will end in open war.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
events.conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline dates the Confederacy's founding both to this address in 24 BBY (Rise of the Separatists, Star Wars: Timelines) and to the Geonosian accord of 22 BBY, when its corporate backers formally join (Attack of the Clones).

events.title: Emergency Powers Act keeps Palpatine in office
events.summary: As systems secede, the Senate amends the constitution so Chancellor Palpatine can stay in office past his term limits while the crisis lasts. Palpatine gathers trusted senators, Padmé Amidala among them, into a Loyalist Committee.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: The Andors take Kassa from Kenari
events.summary: Children of Kenari's Alpha tribe explore a crashed transport bearing the new Separatist emblem, and a surviving officer kills their leader. The boy Kassa stays behind in the wreck, where the salvagers Maarva and Clem Andor find him and take him off-world as Cassian.
events.wp: Exploratory mission to investigate a downed craft

events.title: Amidala fights the Military Creation Act
events.summary: The Military Creation Act, a bill to raise an army against the Separatists, has been debated since the secessions began. Although she sits on Palpatine's Loyalist Committee, Senator Amidala leads the resistance to it, and her stand makes her a target.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Assassins target Senator Amidala
events.summary: Separatist leaders hire Jango Fett to silence Senator Amidala before the army vote. A bomb on her landing platform kills her decoy and poisonous kouhuns fail to finish the job; when his agent Zam Wesell is caught, Jango kills her before she can talk.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Obi-Wan discovers the clone army
events.summary: Following a poisoned dart to Kamino, a planet absent from the Jedi records, Obi-Wan Kenobi finds a vast clone army supposedly commissioned by the dead Sifo-Dyas and grown from Jango Fett. He trails Jango to Geonosis, where the Separatists are massing droids.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Shmi dies; Anakin slaughters the Tuskens
events.summary: Haunted by nightmares, Anakin returns to Tatooine and finds his mother, seized weeks earlier by Tusken Raiders, dying in their camp. When she dies he massacres the whole camp, then confesses his rage to Padmé.
events.wp: Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Senate grants war powers; clone army activated
events.summary: With Separatist droid armies revealed on Geonosis, Representative Jar Jar Binks moves to give Chancellor Palpatine emergency powers. The Senate agrees, and Palpatine's first act is to commission the Kaminoan clones as the Republic's Grand Army.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: The Clone Wars
events.summary: For three years, clone troopers led by Jedi generals battle the Separatist droid armies across the galaxy. Darth Sidious secretly steers both sides, and when the fighting stops the Jedi Order lies in ruins and the Republic has become his Empire.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: First Battle of Geonosis opens the war
events.summary: Some two hundred Jedi storm the Geonosis arena to save Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé, and most die before Yoda arrives with the clones. Jango Fett falls to Mace Windu, and Dooku maims Anakin before escaping with plans for a battle station.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Anakin and Padmé marry in secret
events.summary: Defying the Jedi rule against attachment, Anakin and Padmé wed in secret at the lake retreat of Varykino on Naboo, with only C-3PO and the astromech R2-D2 as witnesses.
events.wp: Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones

events.title: Bombing of Zarra on Cato Neimoidia
events.summary: A blast tears a district of the bridge city Zarra from its moorings, killing thousands on Cato Neimoidia. Obi-Wan and a Neimoidian guard, Ruug Quarnom, find a third party behind it, and the newly knighted Anakin defies orders to save his master from Ventress's frame-up.

events.title: Battle of Christophsis
events.summary: General Loathsom's droids besiege the crystal world Christophsis behind Admiral Trench's blockade. Anakin breaks the blockade in a stealth ship, Rex and Cody unmask the traitor clone Slick, and after a long siege the Republic drives the droid army off.

events.title: Ahsoka Tano becomes Anakin's Padawan
events.summary: Yoda assigns the fourteen-year-old Togruta Ahsoka Tano to Anakin Skywalker, who never asked for a Padawan. She arrives mid-battle on Christophsis and helps him wreck the droids' shield generator, beginning the partnership that anchors the Clone Wars.

events.title: Rescue of Jabba's son wins the Hutts
events.summary: Dooku has Ventress kidnap Jabba the Hutt's infant son Rotta to turn the Hutts against the Republic. Anakin and Ahsoka storm the monastery on Teth and return Rotta, winning the Republic use of Hutt space, while Padmé exposes Ziro the Hutt's part.

events.title: Battle of Ryloth
events.summary: Separatist forces occupy the Twi'lek homeworld. Bail Organa and Jar Jar Binks win Toydaria's help with relief, and in 21 BBY the Republic breaks the blockade, frees the hostage city of Nabat and, with Cham Syndulla's resistance, liberates Ryloth.

events.title: Yoda's stand on Rugosa
events.summary: To win over King Katuunko of Toydaria, Yoda accepts Ventress's challenge on the coral moon Rugosa. With just three clone troopers he defeats her droid army, and Katuunko pledges his world's support to the Republic.

events.title: Onderon's civil war
events.note: The end is dated to 20 BBY; the start follows from the war lasting two years.
events.summary: Onderon's Separatist-backed court faces a rebel insurgency. In 20 BBY rebels trained by Jedi and by Captain Rex overthrow King Sanjay Rash and restore King Dendup, but their leader Steela Gerrera dies, leaving her brother Saw to fight on.

events.title: Hunt for the Malevolence
events.summary: Grievous's giant warship Malevolence cripples Republic fleets with its ion cannon, destroying Plo Koon's fleet at Abregado and a medical convoy. Its strike on the Kaliida Nebula medical station fails, and Anakin's forces later destroy it.

events.title: Rookies hold Rishi Station
events.summary: Commando droids overrun a listening post on the Rishi Moon. A few surviving rookies, among them Echo and Fives, fight back with Rex and Cody and blow up the outpost, cutting the false all-clear that masked a fleet bound for Kamino.

events.title: R2-D2 lost at Bothawui and rescued
events.summary: Grievous uses the Skytop Station listening post to strike Republic targets. At Bothawui Anakin outfights him but loses R2-D2, whose memory holds Republic secrets; he and Ahsoka trace the droid to Skytop, rescue him and destroy the station.

events.title: Pirates capture Count Dooku
events.summary: After a failed Jedi attempt to seize him near Vanqor, Count Dooku is captured by Hondo Ohnaka's pirates, who soon hold Obi-Wan and Anakin too and demand a ransom from the Republic. Jar Jar and a clone escort free the Jedi, but Dooku escapes.

events.title: Blue Shadow Virus plot on Naboo
events.summary: The Separatist scientist Nuvo Vindi revives the extinct Blue Shadow Virus in a lab hidden beneath Naboo, meaning to loose it on the galaxy. Padmé and Jar Jar expose him, and after Padmé and Ahsoka are infected, Obi-Wan and Anakin bring a cure from Iego.

events.title: Cad Bane steals the Jedi's list of children
events.summary: Working for Darth Sidious, Cad Bane steals a holocron out of the Jedi Temple's vault and tortures Master Bolla Ropal for a kyber crystal listing Force-sensitive infants. Bane abducts several children before Anakin and Ahsoka free them from a facility on Mustafar.

events.title: Zillo Beast rampages across Coruscant
events.summary: An experimental bomb that halts a droid army on Malastare also wakes a Zillo Beast, thought extinct. Palpatine has it shipped to Coruscant to study its near-invulnerable hide; it breaks loose, tears through the city and is finally killed with poison gas.

events.title: Second Battle of Geonosis
events.summary: Learning that Poggle the Lesser has restarted the droid foundries of Geonosis, the Republic invades again. Its forces destroy the main factory, kill Karina the Great, queen of the hives, beneath the Progate Temple, and take Poggle prisoner.

events.title: Work begins on a secret battle station
events.summary: Palpatine hands the Geonosian battle-station plans that Dooku brought him to a secret Republic body, the Strategic Advisory Cell. Fearing the Separatists are building such a weapon, it funds the project in secret, and by year's end construction is under way above Geonosis.
sources: Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide

events.title: Jyn Erso is born on Vallt
events.summary: Galen and Lyra Erso's daughter Jyn is born on Vallt, where Separatist sympathizers soon detain the family. Orson Krennic arranges their rescue and brings them to Coruscant, drawing Galen into his secret weapons research.

events.title: Death Watch's plot against Mandalore exposed
events.summary: Sent to learn whether neutral Mandalore has joined the Separatists, Obi-Wan finds Duchess Satine under attack by Death Watch bombers. On Concordia its leader proves to be the moon's governor, Pre Vizsla, backed by Dooku; Satine then defends her world's neutrality before the Senate.

events.title: Boba Fett's revenge on Mace Windu
events.summary: Posing as a clone cadet, Boba Fett sabotages the Star Destroyer Endurance to kill Mace Windu, his father's killer. Windu survives the crash on Vanqor, and Plo Koon and Ahsoka later free Boba's hostages and arrest him on Florrum.

events.title: Battle of Kamino
events.summary: Grievous and Ventress assault Tipoca City to destroy the clone factories at their source. Clone troopers under Rex and Cody, with Echo and Fives among them, fight alongside Obi-Wan and Anakin to repel the raid, which shows that no Republic world is safe.

events.title: Cad Bane takes the Senate hostage
events.summary: Hired by the Hutts, bounty hunters under Cad Bane seize the Senate Building and hold senators and Chancellor Palpatine until the Republic frees Ziro the Hutt. Bane escapes with Ziro, who is later killed on Teth by the singer Sy Snootles on Jabba's orders.

events.title: Peace initiative wrecked by a bombing
events.summary: Padmé and Mina Bonteri, a Separatist senator and her old mentor, steer their senates toward talks, but a bombing of Coruscant's power grid ordered by Dooku turns opinion against peace. Bonteri is later murdered, and Dooku withdraws the Separatist offer.
events.wp: Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid

events.title: Dooku casts off Ventress
events.summary: Ordered by Sidious to prove his loyalty, Dooku has Ventress's ship shot down at Sullust. She survives and returns to the Nightsisters on Dathomir, and Mother Talzin sends her with her sisters to assassinate Dooku, a strike that fails.

events.title: Savage Opress unleashed
events.summary: Talzin remakes the Nightbrother Savage Opress with dark magick and plants him with Dooku as a new apprentice. He slaughters Jedi at a temple on Devaron, then turns on Dooku alongside Ventress, and flees when their attack fails.

events.title: Anakin tested as the Chosen One on Mortis
events.summary: Lured by an ancient signal, Ahsoka, Anakin and Obi-Wan reach Mortis, home of three godlike Force wielders. The Father confirms Anakin's status as the Chosen One, but by the end all three wielders are dead, and Anakin's glimpse of his dark future is wiped away.

events.title: Breakout from the Citadel
events.summary: A Jedi strike team slips into the Citadel, the Separatists' prison fortress on Lola Sayu, to rescue Master Even Piell along with Captain Wilhuff Tarkin, as each knows half of a vital hyperspace route. Piell dies, but Tarkin carries the secret home.

events.title: Ahsoka hunted on Wasskah
events.summary: Captured on Felucia, Ahsoka is dropped on the moon Wasskah, where Trandoshans hunt Jedi younglings for sport. She rallies the surviving captives and, joined by the Wookiee Chewbacca and his kin, turns the hunt back on the hunters.

events.title: Battle of Mon Cala
events.summary: After their king's death, Separatist-backed Quarren under Riff Tamson rise against the young heir, Prince Lee-Char. Clones, Jedi and a Gungan army join the defense; Tamson is killed and Lee-Char is crowned over a reunited Mon Cala.

events.title: Battle of Umbara
events.summary: When Umbara defects, Jedi Master Pong Krell takes over the 501st and spends clone lives recklessly, even tricking two units into firing on each other. Rex's troopers uncover his treachery; Krell, who hoped to become Dooku's apprentice, is shot by a clone.

events.title: Togruta colonists freed from slavers
events.summary: Zygerrian slavers allied with Dooku empty Kiros, a Togruta colony. Anakin, Ahsoka and Obi-Wan go undercover on Zygerria, and after Obi-Wan and Rex fall captive, Republic forces storm the Kadavo processing center and free the survivors.

events.title: Obi-Wan fakes his death to save Palpatine
events.summary: The Council stages Obi-Wan's apparent murder so he can take the identity of Rako Hardeen, a hired gun, hiding the ruse even from Anakin. Undercover, he joins Moralo Eval's scheme to kidnap Palpatine and helps foil it at Naboo's Festival of Light.

events.title: Grievous annihilates the Nightsisters
events.summary: In reprisal for Talzin's plots against Dooku, Grievous leads a droid army to Dathomir. For all Talzin's magick and her undead warriors, the Nightsister clan is nearly wiped out; Ventress survives alone and turns to bounty hunting.

events.title: Savage finds Maul alive
events.summary: Guided by Talzin, Savage Opress finds his brother Maul on the junk world Lotho Minor, half-mad and walking on spider-like mechanical legs. Talzin restores his mind and body, and Maul sets out with Savage to take revenge on Obi-Wan Kenobi.

events.title: Maul and Savage strike on Florrum
events.summary: Maul and Savage Opress, now roving pirates, besiege Hondo Ohnaka's base on Florrum. Obi-Wan and Adi Gallia come to Hondo's aid; Savage kills Gallia, and the brothers barely escape Obi-Wan.

events.title: Maul forges the Shadow Collective
events.summary: Maul unites Death Watch with the Black Sun and Pyke syndicates and forces the Hutts into line, creating a criminal army called the Shadow Collective. Its first prize is Mandalore, still ruled by the pacifist Duchess Satine.

events.title: Maul seizes Mandalore; Satine killed
events.summary: Staging crimes that Death Watch then stops, the Shadow Collective topples Satine's government. Maul kills Pre Vizsla to claim the Darksaber and rules through a puppet, then murders Satine before Obi-Wan's eyes; Bo-Katan's loyalists free Obi-Wan.

events.title: Sidious kills Savage and takes Maul
events.summary: Seeing his former apprentice as a rival, Darth Sidious comes to Mandalore in person, kills Savage Opress in a duel with both brothers, and carries off the beaten Maul to serve his own ends.

events.title: Ahsoka framed and leaves the Jedi Order
events.summary: A bombing at the Temple's hangar kills Jedi and clones, and Ahsoka is framed for it. Expelled and tried by a Republic court, she is cleared when Anakin unmasks Barriss Offee as the bomber, yet she declines to rejoin the Order.
events.wp: Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar
sources: The Jedi Who Knew Too Much

events.title: Fives uncovers the clones' inhibitor chips
events.summary: At Ringo Vinda the clone Tup suddenly kills his Jedi general, Tiplar. Investigating, ARC trooper Fives finds a chip in Tup's brain that drove the act, but Palpatine has him framed as an assassin, and Fives is shot before anyone listens.

events.title: Thrawn fights alongside Anakin on Mokivj
events.summary: On Batuu, Anakin meets the Chiss officer Thrawn, who is searching the wider galaxy for help against the Nikardun threat. With Padmé they wreck a Separatist factory building cortosis-armored droids on Mokivj, though the fight ruins much of the planet's farmland.

events.title: Jedi learn Tyranus's role in the clone army
events.summary: A lightsaber found on a moon of Oba Diah leads Obi-Wan and Anakin to the Pykes, who admit killing Sifo-Dyas for a Sith Lord named Tyranus. Dooku arrives to silence them, and the Jedi realize the Sith had a hand in creating their army.

events.title: Yoda's trials on Moraband
events.summary: Guided by the voice of the late Qui-Gon Jinn, Yoda seeks the secret of keeping one's identity after death. His quest ends on the Sith world Moraband, where he withstands illusions of Darth Bane and an assault by Sidious, and proves ready to learn it.

events.title: The Outer Rim Sieges
events.summary: With the Separatists pushed back to the galaxy's outer reaches, the Republic besieges their strongholds in the war's last campaign. Grievous counterattacks hard, and Jedi generals are spread across worlds such as Mygeeto, Saleucami and Felucia.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Battle of Anaxes and Echo's rescue
events.summary: Admiral Trench strikes at the vital shipyards of Anaxes. The experimental squad Clone Force 99 finds the enemy using a captured clone's mind to predict Republic moves, and helps Anakin and Rex rescue Echo from Skako Minor before Trench falls.

events.title: Talzin dies in a Sith showdown on Dathomir
events.summary: Escaping Sidious's prison, Maul captures Dooku and Grievous at Ord Mantell and brings Dooku to Mother Talzin, who needs his life force to regain her body. Sidious and Grievous arrive; in the fight Grievous kills Talzin, and Maul flees.
sources: Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir

events.title: Ventress and Quinlan Vos hunt Dooku
events.summary: The Council secretly teams Asajj Ventress with Quinlan Vos, a Jedi Master, to assassinate Dooku. The pair fall in love, but Vos is captured and turned by Dooku; Ventress dies shielding him from the Count's lightning, and her sacrifice redeems him.

events.title: Siege of Mandalore; Maul captured
events.summary: At Bo-Katan's request, Ahsoka and Rex lead a detachment of the 501st to free Mandalore from Maul's puppet regime. Ahsoka defeats and captures Maul, who warns her that Anakin is being groomed as Sidious's next apprentice.

events.title: Battle of Coruscant; Dooku executed
events.summary: Grievous's fleet strikes the capital and abducts the Chancellor. Aboard the flagship Invisible Hand, Anakin defeats Dooku and, urged on by Palpatine, beheads the disarmed Count, then crash-lands the burning ship with Obi-Wan.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Delegation of 2,000 challenges Palpatine
events.summary: Alarmed by the Chancellor's swelling authority, senators meet in secret at Bail Organa's Cantham House. Padmé Amidala, Mon Mothma and others help frame a formal petition from two thousand senators urging Palpatine to surrender his emergency powers, an early seed of the Rebellion.

events.title: Obi-Wan kills Grievous on Utapau
events.summary: Tipped off that Grievous is hiding on Utapau, the Republic sends Obi-Wan with the 7th Sky Corps. Obi-Wan duels the cyborg general, chases him through the sinkhole city and kills him with a blaster, and the Separatist command collapses.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Mace Windu confronts Darth Sidious
events.summary: Told by Anakin that Palpatine is secretly Sidious, Windu and three fellow Masters try to arrest him; Sidious cuts the others down at once. Windu disarms him, but as he moves to strike, Anakin severs his hand and Sidious hurls him to his death.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Anakin Skywalker becomes Darth Vader
events.summary: Convinced that only Sidious's dark arts can keep Padmé from the death he has foreseen, Anakin Skywalker pledges himself to the Sith Lord and is named Darth Vader. His first task is to lead clones against the Jedi Temple.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Order 66: the clones turn on the Jedi
events.summary: Branding the Jedi traitors, Palpatine issues Order 66, and the clones' chips drive them to kill their generals across the galaxy. Ki-Adi-Mundi, Aayla Secura, Plo Koon and many more die; Yoda, Obi-Wan, Ahsoka and a scattered few escape.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Ahsoka and Rex survive Order 66
events.summary: Aboard the Star Destroyer Tribunal, Rex warns Ahsoka to find Fives before his chip takes over. She frees Maul as a diversion, removes Rex's chip, and the two escape as the ship crashes onto a moon, then bury the clones who died there.

events.title: Vader leads the assault on the Jedi Temple
events.summary: Darth Vader and the 501st Legion storm the Jedi Temple, killing Jedi and younglings alike. A few slip away, Kelleran Beq carrying the young Grogu among them, while Bail Organa, turned back at the gates, sees clones gun down a fleeing Padawan.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Palpatine proclaims the Galactic Empire
events.summary: Palpatine tells an emergency Senate session that the Jedi tried to overthrow him, turns the Republic into an Empire with himself as Emperor, and wins thunderous applause from most senators.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Ezra Bridger born on Lothal
events.summary: Mira and Ephraim Bridger's son Ezra arrives on Lothal the very day the Empire is proclaimed, so his birthday will always fall on Empire Day.
sources: Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide

events.title: Kenobi and Yoda reverse the Temple beacon
events.summary: Slipping into the ransacked Jedi Temple, Kenobi and Yoda recode the recall signal so it tells surviving Jedi to stay clear of Coruscant, then find security footage showing Anakin Skywalker serving Sidious.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Vader wipes out the Separatist Council
events.summary: On Mustafar, the newly named Darth Vader cuts down the Separatist leaders sheltering there and has their droid armies switched off. The Confederacy collapses into scattered holdouts and the Clone Wars end.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Kenobi defeats Vader on Mustafar
events.summary: Obi-Wan Kenobi fights his former apprentice beside Mustafar's lava rivers and leaves him maimed and burning. Palpatine recovers Vader, who is rebuilt inside the black life-support armor he will wear from then on.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Yoda duels Sidious in the Senate
events.summary: Yoda confronts the new Emperor in his office and then among the Senate chamber's floating pods. Neither can finish the other; Yoda withdraws, escapes with Bail Organa's help, and chooses exile.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Luke and Leia born; Padmé dies
events.summary: On Polis Massa, Padmé Amidala gives birth to twins and dies soon after. To hide them from Vader and the Emperor, Leia goes to Bail and Breha Organa on Alderaan and Luke to his relatives on Tatooine.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Kenobi and Yoda go into exile
events.summary: After Padmé's funeral on Naboo, the two surviving masters part ways: Kenobi settles in Tatooine's desert to watch over young Luke from afar, while Yoda withdraws to the swamps of Dagobah.
sources: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

events.title: Clone Force 99 deserts the new Empire
events.summary: Ordered to crush Saw Gerrera's refugees on Onderon, Clone Force 99 lets them go. Back on Kamino, Hunter's squad leaves with the young clone Omega, abandoning Crosshair, whose inhibitor chip now binds him to the Empire.

events.title: Vader claims a Jedi's kyber crystal
events.summary: Hunting Jedi for the Emperor, Vader tracks Master Kirak Infil'a to the river moon Al'doleem and kills him. He takes the Jedi's lightsaber and bleeds its crystal red to build his own Sith blade.

events.title: Grand Inquisitor and Vader hunt Jocasta Nu
events.summary: Palpatine sends his Grand Inquisitor, with Vader, after Jedi archivist Jocasta Nu, who has returned to the Temple for a crystal listing Force-sensitive children. Vader kills her, then secretly destroys the list so his master cannot raise new Sith.

events.title: Tarkin's cruiser crushes Ghorman protesters
events.note: Dated from an Andor line placing it sixteen years before 3 BBY.
events.summary: When protesters in Palmo, Ghorman's capital, try to block his landing, Moff Tarkin brings his cruiser down on the crowded plaza anyway. Five hundred unarmed people die, and the outcry dogs his career.

events.title: Bad Batch returns Gungi to Kashyyyk
events.summary: On occupied Kashyyyk, where Imperial clones help Trandoshan hunters prey on Wookiees, Clone Force 99 wrecks a slaving convoy and brings the Wookiee Jedi youngling Gungi home to his people.

events.title: Syndullas rescued as Ryloth resists
events.summary: Admiral Rampart frames Cham Syndulla for a plot against Senator Orn Free Taa. His daughter Hera, the Bad Batch and clone captain Howzer, defying orders, free Cham and Eleni Syndulla; the clan begins organizing resistance.

events.title: Empire levels Tipoca City, ending clone production
events.summary: The Empire cancels its Kaminoan contracts, takes scientist Nala Se prisoner and, on Tarkin's orders, has Admiral Rampart bomb Tipoca City into the ocean. The Bad Batch, reunited with a repentant Crosshair, barely escape.

events.title: Senate passes the Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill
events.summary: Admiral Rampart is exposed and arrested over the ruin of Kamino, yet at the Emperor's urging senators pass his bill anyway, formally trading the aging clone army for enlisted stormtrooper recruits.

events.title: Mon Mothma starts building 'the Alliance'
events.note: Star Wars Insider 203 places it eighteen years before A New Hope.
events.summary: After a secret meeting on Phothrell where she, Bail Organa and Saw Gerrera agree to resist Palpatine together, Senator Mon Mothma quietly begins recruiting soldiers, spies and ships into a network she names the Alliance.
sources: Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear

events.title: Empire invades and subjugates Mon Cala
events.summary: When an ex-Padawan's influence stalls talks with King Lee-Char, Vader, three Inquisitors and Tarkin's fleet descend on Mon Cala. The king is captured and jailed, cities are bombarded, and many Mon Calamari flee in ships disguised as buildings.

events.title: Raada uprising draws Ahsoka into the rebellion
events.summary: Hiding as a farmhand on the moon Raada, Ahsoka Tano trains locals against an Imperial crop scheme. The revolt is crushed, but she kills the Sixth Brother, helps evacuate the moon, and joins Bail Organa's secret network as Fulcrum.

events.title: Tarkin's Antar Atrocity
events.summary: To punish Antar 4 for backing the Confederacy in the Clone Wars, Wilhuff Tarkin's forces round up, execute and slaughter its people; newsfeeds come to call the purge the Antar Atrocity.

events.title: Caleb Dume becomes Kanan Jarrus
events.summary: Hunted since Order 66, former Padawan Caleb Dume is pulled from Imperial hands by the smuggler Janus Kasmir and ex-Separatist general Kleeve. He sheds his old name and starts drifting the galaxy as Kanan Jarrus.

events.title: Chiss exile Thrawn after defeating the Grysks
events.summary: Thrawn lures the Grysk agent Jixtus's fleet into a trap at Sunrise and foils a plot to set the Chiss families against each other. Because he struck first, the Syndicure strips his rank and exiles him, quietly tasked with contacting the Empire.
events.wp: Grysk plot to engineer a Chiss civil war

events.title: Tech dies after the raid on Raven's Peak
events.summary: While Tarkin hosts a secret summit of Imperial strategists on Eriadu, Saw Gerrera's Partisans try to kill him and the Bad Batch hunts for clues to the captive Crosshair. Tarkin survives, and Tech falls to his death covering the squad's escape.

events.title: Bad Batch storms Mount Tantiss
events.summary: Hunter, Wrecker, Crosshair and Echo storm the Empire's secret cloning lab under Mount Tantiss on Wayland to free Omega. Dr. Hemlock dies, the imprisoned clone children go free, the research is destroyed and Tarkin shutters the site.

events.title: The Erso family flees Coruscant
events.summary: Galen Erso learns Orson Krennic is turning his kyber energy research into a weapon. Amid the crowds of All-Species Week, he, Lyra and young Jyn slip off Coruscant with help from Saw Gerrera and the smuggler Has Obitt.

events.title: Vader finds Ahsoka's abandoned lightsaber
events.summary: On a snowy moon, Vader's troops reach the wreck of the Star Destroyer Tribunal and the graves of the clones Ahsoka Tano buried there. Vader picks up the blade she abandoned, then turns away.

events.title: Maul claims a Jedi apprentice on Janix
events.summary: Rebuilding his criminal empire on Janix, Maul draws Inquisitors and then Vader himself. Vader kills the Jedi Eeko-Dio Daki, and Maul spirits Daki's Padawan Devon Izara offworld as his apprentice with help from Crimson Dawn's Dryden Vos.

events.title: Kenobi and Owen fight off raiders
events.summary: Mercenaries raid the Lars moisture farm while little Luke plays outside. Obi-Wan and Owen drive them off together, but Owen then punches Kenobi and warns him to keep away from the boy.
sources: From a Certain Point of View

events.title: Luthen Rael's Axis network takes shape
events.note: Dated as a decade before Andor's first season (5 BBY).
events.summary: Luthen Rael, known to the ISB only as Axis, starts assembling a hidden web of cells, informants and financiers that will quietly fund and steer much of the early rebellion.

events.title: Thrawn joins the Imperial military
events.note: Derived: the novel places Pryce's 11 BBY governorship about four years after it opens.
events.summary: An Imperial ship finds a lone Chiss warrior on his supposed exile world. Brought before Palpatine, Thrawn offers his service, enters the Imperial Academy and begins a rapid rise with the young cadet Eli Vanto at his side.

events.title: Berch Teller's cell steals the Carrion Spike
events.summary: Ex-Republic intelligence officer Berch Teller's cell hijacks Tarkin's personal corvette on Murkhana and uses it to strike Imperial targets across the Outer Rim. Tarkin and Vader break the cell at a Death Star supply convoy, though Teller escapes.

events.title: Twi'lek rebels ambush the Emperor and Vader
events.summary: Using intelligence from a traitor within the Empire, Cham Syndulla's Twi'lek fighters strike during the Emperor's visit to Ryloth, stranding him and Vader in the jungle. The Sith fight free; the traitor Belkor Dray and fighter Isval die.

events.title: Tarkin becomes Grand Moff and states his doctrine
events.summary: Rewarded for crushing Teller's cell, Tarkin becomes the first Grand Moff, with authority over the Outer Rim and oversight of the battle station project. He argues the Empire should rule through fear of its power rather than its constant use.

events.title: Cal Kestis chooses to destroy the Jedi holocron
events.summary: Forced out of hiding on Bracca, former Padawan Cal Kestis joins Cere Junda to recover a holocron listing Force-sensitive children. After storming the Inquisitors' fortress on Nur, where the Second Sister dies, he destroys it rather than risk exposing them.
events.wp: Secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order

events.title: Krennic takes Galen Erso from Lah'mu
events.summary: Orson Krennic finds the hiding Ersos on Lah'mu and forces Galen back to perfect the battle station's weapon. Lyra is shot resisting, and young Jyn, hidden in a cave, is found and raised by Saw Gerrera.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

events.title: Han flees Corellia and enlists as 'Solo'
events.summary: Street thief Han escapes Corellia's White Worms gang, but his partner Qi'ra is caught at the checkpoint. With no family name, he is dubbed 'Solo' by an Imperial recruiter and joins up hoping to become a pilot.

events.title: Fortress Vader rises on Mustafar
events.summary: The dark-side artist Momin raises Vader's castle on Mustafar above a cave steeped in the dark side; Vader kills him after fending off Mustafarians angered by the work. Entering the cave's portal to reach Padmé, he loses her again and wrecks it in rage.

events.title: Ezra Bridger's parents are arrested
events.summary: Mira and Ephraim Bridger, whose pirate broadcasts urge Lothal to resist, are seized by the Empire and vanish into prison. Their seven-year-old son Ezra is left alone, surviving by his wits.

events.title: Sith cultists create Dathan on Exegol
events.summary: Hidden on Exegol, Sidious's followers grow a strandcast from his genetic template. The boy, later called Dathan, lacks real Force strength and is scorned as a failure; he will one day flee Exegol and father Rey.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker

events.title: Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus join forces
events.summary: On Gorse's mining moon Cynda, rebel agent Hera Syndulla recruits drifting ex-Padawan Kanan Jarrus and a few locals to stop Count Vidian from blowing up the moon for its thorilide. Vidian dies, and their partnership begins.

events.title: Thrawn outwits Nightswan over Umbara
events.summary: Serving in Admiral Gendling's task force, Captain Thrawn breaks the droid fighters of the insurgent tactician Nightswan by timing fire around the Star Destroyers' transmission shadows. Umbara loses what autonomy it still had.

events.title: Arihnda Pryce becomes Governor of Lothal
events.note: Star Wars: Timelines dates the appointment to 11 BBY; the timeline lists the spy operation under 11-9 BBY.
events.summary: Lothal expatriate Arihnda Pryce, acting as a double agent for Thrawn and the ISB's Colonel Yularen, helps unmask a Coruscant spy ring feeding the insurgent Nevil Cygni. Tarkin rewards her with the governorship of her homeworld.

events.title: Han meets Chewbacca on Mimban
events.summary: Kicked out of flight school for insubordination, Han slogs through the Empire's trench war on Mimban. He tries to join Tobias Beckett's crew of thieves, is thrown to a captive Wookiee, and instead escapes with him: Chewbacca.

events.title: Coaxium heist on Vandor goes wrong
events.summary: Beckett's gang tries to rob an Imperial conveyex train of its coaxium on Vandor to settle a debt with Crimson Dawn. Enfys Nest's Cloud-Riders intervene, Rio and Val die, and the fuel is lost in a huge explosion.

events.title: Han makes the Kessel Run
events.summary: To make up the loss, the crew raids the Pyke-run spice mines of Kessel for raw coaxium, sparking a slave revolt led by L3-37. Han flies Lando's Millennium Falcon out through the Maelstrom in a record run he later rounds down to twelve parsecs.

events.title: Qi'ra kills Dryden Vos on Savareen
events.summary: Amid a web of double-crosses on Savareen, Qi'ra kills Dryden Vos and Han shoots Beckett. Han lets Enfys Nest's rebels keep the coaxium, while Qi'ra takes Vos's place and reports to Crimson Dawn's hidden master, Maul.

events.title: Han wins the Millennium Falcon
events.summary: In a sabacc rematch on Numidian Prime, Han beats Lando Calrissian, having pocketed the card Lando kept up his sleeve, and takes the Millennium Falcon as his prize.

events.title: Death Star construction moves to Scarif
events.note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists the move under 10/9 BBY.
events.summary: With Saw Gerrera's raids coming too close to the secret over Geonosis, the Empire shifts the battle station's final assembly to Scarif, a shielded world whose citadel archive also holds the project's plans.
sources: Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide
Star Wars: Rogue One: Secret Mission
events.conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline, summarizing the novel Tarkin, has the station leave Geonosis orbit for deep space in 14 BBY, while Rogue One reference material, per the DS-1 article, keeps it at Geonosis until the move to Scarif around 9 BBY.

events.title: Empire exterminates the Geonosians
events.note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists it under 10/9 BBY.
events.summary: To bury the secret of the station built above their world, the Empire poisons Geonosis and wipes out its hive species. Years later, rebels find a lone survivor, Klik-Klak, tending a queen's egg in the tunnels.

events.title: Cal Kestis finds a haven on Tanalorr
events.summary: Now fighting alongside Saw's rebels, Cal Kestis finds Dagan Gera, a centuries-old Jedi fallen to darkness, on Koboh and must kill him. Bode Akuna betrays the crew, Vader kills Cere Junda on Jedha, and Cal and Merrin claim hidden Tanalorr as a refuge.

events.title: Leia kidnapped; Kenobi leaves exile
events.summary: Bounty hunters hired by the Inquisitor Reva snatch Leia Organa, aged ten, on Alderaan to lure out Obi-Wan Kenobi. Bail flies to Tatooine to beg his old friend for help, and Kenobi reluctantly digs up his lightsaber.

events.title: Morgan Elsbeth wins Thrawn's test on Corvus
events.summary: In Calodan on Corvus, the Nightsister and Imperial industrialist Morgan Elsbeth beats off a night attack by the Noghri Rukh. It is a trial staged by Admiral Thrawn, who, drawn by her rejected TIE Defender design, takes her under his wing.

events.title: Vader catches Kenobi on Mapuzo
events.summary: Shaken to learn on Daiyu that Anakin survived, Kenobi flees with Leia to the mining world Mapuzo. Vader tracks him there and drags him through flames until Leia and the undercover officer Tala Durith create a diversion.

events.title: Kenobi rescues Leia from Fortress Inquisitorius
events.summary: Kenobi and Tala infiltrate the Inquisitorius's underwater stronghold on Nur, where Reva, the Third Sister, is interrogating Leia. They free her and escape with help from the Path, an underground network smuggling Jedi to safety.

events.title: Vader besieges the Path's hideout on Jabiim
events.summary: Vader's forces trap the Path and its refugees on Jabiim. Tala sacrifices herself at the door, the refugees get away by ship, and Reva is revealed as a youngling who survived Vader's Temple massacre; her attempt on him fails.

events.title: Kenobi defeats Vader on a barren moon
events.summary: Drawing Vader away from the fleeing refugees, Obi-Wan faces his former apprentice among rocky spires on a lifeless moon and cracks open his mask. Accepting that his friend Anakin is gone, Kenobi leaves Vader behind.

events.title: Reva spares Luke; Kenobi sees Qui-Gon
events.summary: Reva tracks Luke to the Lars homestead but, faced with her own past, cannot kill the boy; Kenobi brings him home and makes peace with Owen. At last at peace himself, Obi-Wan sees Qui-Gon Jinn's spirit.

events.title: Kenobi secretly saves young Luke in the drought
events.note: Timeline lists it as 9/8 BBY, after the Kenobi series; placed at the later year.
events.summary: As Jabba's 'water tax' squeezes Tatooine's farmers through a punishing drought, young Luke stands up to the Hutt's enforcers and is knocked out. Kenobi quietly deals with the thugs, carries the boy home and slips away unseen.

events.title: Empire devastates Lasan
events.summary: Putting down unrest on Lasan, ISB officer Alexsandr Kallus leads an assault with T-7 ion disruptors that leaves the Lasat nearly extinct; Wookiee fighters die trying to stop it. Honor Guard captain Zeb Orrelios survives, haunted.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire

events.title: Cadet Sabine Wren's weapon is turned on Mandalorians
events.summary: At the Imperial Academy, cadet Sabine Wren designs a device that superheats beskar and kills whoever wears it. When the Empire uses it on her own people, she deserts with Ketsu Onyo and becomes estranged from her family.

events.title: Gar Saxon made Imperial ruler of Mandalore
events.summary: Former Death Watch warrior and one-time Maul loyalist Gar Saxon becomes the Empire's governor on Mandalore and commander of its Mandalorian super commandos, keeping his people in line for the Emperor.

events.title: Imperial troops massacre protesters on Lothal
events.summary: Near Capital City, soldiers commanded by Lieutenant Piers Roddance open fire on a peaceful protest in Lothal's Westhills. The killings push young Lothalites such as Beck Ollet into sabotage cells.
sources: Servants of the Empire: Edge of the Galaxy

events.title: Saw's Partisans massacre a festival on Inusagi
events.summary: Using invitations forged by teenage Jyn Erso, Saw Gerrera's Partisans and allied fighters slip into a blossom festival on Inusagi and kill every guest with flechette launchers.

events.title: Cassian Andor kills two corporate guards
events.summary: Searching for his lost sister Kerri, Cassian Andor visits a brothel on the corporate-run world Morlana One and kills two Preox-Morlana security officers who shake him down, setting a manhunt in motion.

events.title: Luthen Rael pulls Cassian out of Ferrix
events.summary: Deputy Inspector Syril Karn's corporate squads raid Ferrix to arrest Cassian, but rebel recruiter Luthen Rael fights him free and the townsfolk wreck the police. The fiasco leads the Empire to absorb the sector and garrison Ferrix.

events.title: Rebels rob the Imperial payroll on Aldhani
events.summary: Posing as troopers during the Eye of Aldhani meteor shower, Vel Sartha's cell, with Cassian as a hired hand, empties an Imperial garrison vault of a quarter's payroll for the whole sector. The daring theft rattles the Empire into a crackdown.

events.title: Empire imposes the Public Order Resentencing Directive
events.summary: Stung by Aldhani, Palpatine hardens the law: sentences for anti-Imperial crimes are doubled or reviewed, systems sheltering rebels owe heavy tribute, prison oversight is dropped, and the ISB may call on army and navy resources.

events.title: Prisoners break out of Narkina 5
events.summary: Swept up on Niamos and given six years under the new directive, Cassian lands in a factory prison on Narkina 5. When inmates learn release is a lie, he and floor manager Kino Loy lead a mass breakout.

events.title: Luthen lets Kreegyr's cell walk into a trap
events.summary: Warned by his mole Lonni Jung that the ISB knows of Anto Kreegyr's planned strike on a Spellhaus power station, Luthen stays silent to protect his source. Kreegyr's fighters are wiped out in the ambush.

events.title: Saw Gerrera leaves Jyn behind on Tamsye Prime
events.summary: A scouting raid on an old munitions factory on Tamsye Prime goes wrong when a Partisan betrays them, suspecting who Jyn's father is. Saw hides teenage Jyn in a bunker and never comes back for her.

events.title: Atrivis Liberators seize and lose Mantooine
events.summary: In the Atrivis sector an armed group calling itself the Liberators seizes Mantooine's Imperial garrison, only to be routed when the navy strikes back. Their Atrivis Resistance Group later joins the Rebel Alliance.

events.title: Maarva's funeral sparks the Ferrix riot
events.summary: At Maarva Andor's funeral procession, her recorded farewell calls on Ferrix to resist the Empire. The crowd turns on the garrison, troops fire into it, and in the chaos Cassian frees Bix, then offers Luthen his life or his service.

events.title: Ezra Bridger joins the Ghost crew
events.note: The timeline gives no firm order between Andor's and Rebels' 5 BBY events; placed after Andor's, as listed.
events.summary: Lothal street kid Ezra Bridger stumbles into a raid by the Ghost's rebel crew and ends up helping them free Wookiee slaves from Kessel. Sensing Ezra's Force talent, the hidden Jedi Kanan Jarrus offers to train him.
sources: Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion

events.title: The Grand Inquisitor springs a trap on Stygeon
events.summary: Hearing that Luminara Unduli survived the Purge and is held in the Spire, the Ghost crew mounts a rescue, but it is bait: she died years ago. The Grand Inquisitor duels Kanan, and the rebels barely escape.

events.title: Spectres bomb Lothal's Empire Day parade
events.summary: During Lothal's Empire Day celebration, which is also Ezra's birthday, the Spectres blow up a new experimental TIE fighter on display and rescue a defector, and the Empire answers by tightening its grip on the planet.
events.wp: Bombing at the Empire Day parade

events.title: Ezra's broadcast calls the galaxy to resist
events.summary: Grand Moff Tarkin arrives to stamp out Lothal's rebels. While the Spectres seize the communications tower, Ezra transmits a call to resist across nearby systems, and Kanan lets himself be captured so the others can escape.

events.title: Kanan rescued at Mustafar; Grand Inquisitor dies
events.summary: The Spectres cripple Tarkin's Star Destroyer above Mustafar and free Kanan, who defeats the Grand Inquisitor; the Inquisitor lets himself fall rather than face his masters. Saved by the Phoenix fleet, the crew meets Fulcrum: Ahsoka Tano.

events.title: Vader arrives at Lothal; Phoenix Home falls
events.summary: Sent by the Emperor, Vader locks down Lothal, has the refugee settlement Tarkintown burned and hunts the rebels to their fleet, destroying the command ship Phoenix Home. Ahsoka is overwhelmed by what she senses in him.

events.title: Captain Rex joins the rebels
events.summary: Ahsoka sends the Ghost crew to find the old clone captain Rex, living with Wolffe and Gregor in a converted walker on Seelos. After fighting off an Imperial attack together, Rex joins the Phoenix rebels.

events.title: Cassian steals a TIE Avenger prototype
events.summary: Cassian steals a prototype TIE Avenger from a Sienar test base and lands on Yavin 4, where survivors of the ambushed Maya Pei Brigade take him prisoner before falling into a deadly feud among themselves. He escapes in the fighter.

events.title: Krennic plans the ruin of Ghorman
events.summary: At a secret meeting on Maltheen Divide, Director Krennic tells ISB and military officials that the Emperor needs Ghorman's kalkite for an 'energy' program that is really the Death Star; a smear campaign will justify seizing it.

events.title: Bix and the Ferrix exiles flee Mina-Rau
events.summary: Hiding among undocumented farmworkers on Mina-Rau, Bix Caleen kills an Imperial officer who assaults her during a supply census. Cassian arrives in his stolen TIE to extract Bix, Wilmon and B2EMO, but Brasso is killed escaping.

events.title: Ezra's parents die leading a prison revolt
events.summary: Stirred by hearing their son's rebel broadcast, Ezra's imprisoned parents lead a breakout from their Lothal prison. Dozens escape, including ex-governor Ryder Azadi, but Mira and Ephraim Bridger are killed.

events.title: Kallus and Zeb stranded on Bahryn
events.summary: Boarding an Imperial construction module above Geonosis, the rebels walk into Agent Kallus's trap; Zeb and Kallus end up stranded together on Bahryn, a frozen moon, and must cooperate to survive. The ordeal plants doubts that turn Kallus into a rebel informant.
events.wp: Ambush on an Imperial construction module

events.title: Leia claims her place as Alderaan's heir
events.summary: At sixteen, Leia Organa performs the Day of Demand, formally asserting her right to Alderaan's throne. Taking on challenges of body, mind and heart, she discovers her parents' secret rebel work and insists on joining it.

events.title: Partisan bomb kills Moff Panaka
events.summary: Saw Gerrera's Partisans bomb Moff Quarsh Panaka's retreat on Onoam, a moon of Naboo, minutes after Leia and Queen Dalné leave. His death buries his suspicion that the adopted princess is Padmé Amidala's daughter.

events.title: Phoenix Cell settles Chopper Base on Atollon
events.summary: Warned off an Imperial trap by Chopper and the droid AP-5, the Phoenix fleet settles on remote Atollon and builds a hidden headquarters, Chopper Base, where Rex and the Spectres clear out the giant krykna spiders.

events.title: Ahsoka faces Vader on Malachor
events.summary: Seeking Sith knowledge on Malachor, Kanan, Ezra and Ahsoka fight Inquisitors beside Maul, who blinds Kanan. Ahsoka confronts Vader, now certain he was Anakin, inside the collapsing temple and vanishes. Three Inquisitors die there.

events.title: ISB plants agents among Ghorman's rebels
events.summary: Dedra Meero's ISB team pours propaganda against Ghorman while her partner Syril Karn, posted there as a standards official, spies on the local resistance, the Ghorman Front. Luthen sends Cassian to judge whether the group is worth backing.

events.title: Cinta Kaz killed in the Ghorman weapons heist
events.summary: Unhappy with Cassian's assessment, Luthen sends Vel and Cinta to help the Ghorman Front instead. Their raid on an Imperial arms shipment succeeds, but a jittery recruit's blunder gets Cinta killed.

events.title: Thrawn crushes Nightswan's Batonn insurgency
events.summary: Admiral Thrawn retakes Scrim Island and besieges Nightswan's rebels in a Batonn mining complex. Governor Pryce blows up the site to hide her killing of an ISB agent, ending the revolt at a heavy civilian cost.

events.title: Grand Admiral Thrawn takes on the rebels
events.summary: Backed by Governor Pryce, Thrawn is raised to Grand Admiral and handed the Seventh Fleet, while his aide Eli Vanto is sent to serve the Chiss. Pryce then summons him to Lothal to lead the fight against Phoenix Cell.

events.title: Wedge Antilles defects from Skystrike Academy
events.summary: With covert help from Agent Kallus, now feeding the rebels as Fulcrum, Sabine Wren goes undercover at Skystrike Academy and brings out Wedge Antilles and Hobbie Klivian, who join Phoenix Squadron.

events.title: Rex and Separatist droids fight the Empire
events.summary: Searching Agamar for old Separatist supplies, Rex and the Spectres are captured by battle droids still serving the Confederacy. When Imperial troops attack, clone, droid and rebel fight side by side, and the droid general Kalani accepts the war is over.

events.title: Sabine Wren claims the Darksaber
events.summary: Maul's bond with Ezra leads the Spectres to Dathomir, where they break a Nightsister spell and fend him off. In Maul's lair Sabine finds the Darksaber, the old blade of Mandalore's rulers, and Kanan trains her to wield it.

events.title: Gar Saxon dies on Krownest
events.summary: Sabine returns to her estranged Clan Wren on Krownest to recruit them. When Viceroy Gar Saxon attacks, she beats him in single combat and spares him; he draws on her and her mother Ursa shoots him. Mandalore slides into civil war.

events.title: Vader and Thrawn probe a disturbance on Batuu
events.summary: Dispatched by the Emperor to find the source of a ripple in the Force near the Unknown Regions, Vader and Thrawn uncover Grysk agents on Batuu, the start of the Empire's clash with the Grysk Hegemony.

events.title: The Ghorman Massacre
events.summary: Imperial troops fire on a peaceful protest in Palmo's plaza, a slaughter the ISB has engineered to complete the Empire's takeover of Ghorman and strip-mine its kalkite. Syril Karn dies in the chaos, and Cassian escapes with a wrecked Imperial droid.

events.title: Mon Mothma denounces the Emperor and flees
events.summary: After Ghorman's senator is arrested for disputing the official story, Mon Mothma tells the Senate the massacre was genocide and calls the Emperor a monster. With a warrant out, Luthen's network and Cassian spirit her off Coruscant.

events.title: Mon Mothma declares the Rebel Alliance
events.summary: Escorted by Hera Syndulla's crew through the dangerous Archeon Nebula, Mon Mothma reaches Dantooine and broadcasts a call uniting scattered rebel cells into a single Rebel Alliance. Open civil war begins.

events.title: Kenobi strikes down Maul on Tatooine
events.summary: Maul tricks Ezra into leading him across Tatooine's desert to his old enemy. After a brief exchange of blows, Obi-Wan cuts Maul down, and the dying Zabrak asks whether the boy Kenobi guards is the Chosen One.

events.title: Thrawn smashes Chopper Base at Atollon
events.summary: Thrawn's Seventh Fleet blockades Atollon and bombards the rebel base. Commander Sato dies ramming an Interdictor, Kallus defects, and the enigmatic Bendu turns on both sides before the survivors break out and regroup on Yavin 4.

events.title: Alliance High Command moves to Yavin 4
events.summary: After the losses at Atollon, the Alliance's leaders set up their headquarters in the ancient Massassi temples on the jungle moon Yavin 4, home of General Dodonna's Massassi Group.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

events.title: Sabine passes the Darksaber to Bo-Katan
events.summary: The Spectres help Sabine free her father from an Imperial prison and rally Mandalore's clans. Together they destroy Governor Tiber Saxon and his rebuilt Duchess weapon, and Sabine hands Bo-Katan Kryze the Darksaber to lead them.

events.title: Saw destroys a giant kyber crystal
events.summary: Saw Gerrera drags Ezra and Sabine aboard a disguised Imperial freighter at Faos Station, where they find kidnapped power engineers and a huge kyber crystal. Saw rigs the crystal to blow, taking the ship and a Star Destroyer with it.
sources: In the Name of the Rebellion

events.title: Kanan Jarrus dies saving his friends
events.summary: After Thrawn shatters a rebel air strike on Lothal and Hera is captured, the Spectres break her out. Pryce fires on the fuel depot, and Kanan holds back the blast with the Force until the others escape, dying in the fire.

events.title: Ezra pulls Ahsoka out of Malachor
events.summary: Beneath Lothal's Jedi Temple, Ezra finds a portal to a realm outside time that links moments across history. He snatches Ahsoka away from Vader's blade on Malachor, and the pair escape as Palpatine tries to seize the realm.

events.title: Ezra and Thrawn vanish as Lothal is freed
events.summary: Rebels and Lothal's people destroy the Imperial complex, and Governor Pryce dies. Ezra calls in purrgil that drag Thrawn's Chimaera into hyperspace with both of them aboard, leaving the planet free and their fates unknown.

events.title: Jacen Syndulla born on Lothal
events.summary: Hera Syndulla gives birth to Jacen, her son with Kanan Jarrus, on Lothal after Kanan's death.

events.title: Luthen Rael falls; the Death Star secret leaks
events.summary: Mole Lonni Jung passes Luthen word of a planet-killing station. Dedra Meero corners Luthen, who survives a suicide attempt until Kleya Marki kills him in hospital. Cassian then rescues Kleya and brings her story to Yavin 4.
events.wp: Raid on the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest

events.title: Rebels free Jyn Erso from Wobani
events.summary: Word that an Imperial pilot has defected with a message from Galen Erso sends Cassian to Kafrene. To reach Saw Gerrera, who holds the defector Bodhi Rook, the Alliance springs Galen's daughter Jyn from an Imperial work camp on Wobani.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

events.title: Death Star test destroys Jedha City
events.summary: Jyn and Cassian find Saw in Jedha's catacombs and see Galen's message revealing a flaw built into the Death Star. The station then test-fires on Jedha City, wiping it out; Saw stays behind to die as the rebels flee.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

events.title: Galen Erso killed on Eadu
events.summary: Sent to Eadu with secret orders to assassinate Galen Erso, Cassian cannot pull the trigger. Krennic executes Galen's engineers, and a rebel bombing raid ordered by General Draven fatally wounds Galen in front of his daughter.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

events.title: Battle of Scarif: the plans are stolen
events.summary: Rogue One, a volunteer squad led by Jyn Erso, lifts the battle station's schematics from Scarif's citadel while the Alliance fleet breaks the planetary shield. The team dies as the station fires on the base, but the plans reach Princess Leia's ship.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
events.conflict: Star Wars: Galactic Atlas dated Rogue One and the pre-battle events of A New Hope to 0 BBY; Star Wars: Timelines, which Wookieepedia now follows, puts them in 1 BBY and treats the Battle of Yavin itself as year zero.

events.title: Vader captures the Tantive IV above Tatooine
events.summary: Pursued from Scarif, Leia's corvette is caught by Vader's Star Destroyer over Tatooine. Before she is taken prisoner, Leia hides the plans and a plea for Obi-Wan Kenobi inside R2-D2, who escapes to the surface with C-3PO.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

events.title: The Emperor dissolves the Imperial Senate
events.summary: Palpatine disbands the Imperial Senate for good. Regional governors take direct control of their territories, leaning on terror of the new battle station to keep star systems obedient.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

events.title: Owen and Beru killed; Luke leaves Tatooine
events.summary: Stormtroopers hunting the droids burn the Lars homestead, killing Owen and Beru. Luke, who has just received his father's lightsaber from Obi-Wan Kenobi, leaves with him and hires Han Solo and Chewbacca in Mos Eisley.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

events.title: The Death Star destroys Alderaan
events.summary: To break Princess Leia and show the galaxy its new power, Grand Moff Tarkin fires the Death Star on peaceful Alderaan even after she names a false rebel base. The planet and its billions are annihilated.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
events.conflict: Star Wars: Galactic Atlas dated Rogue One and the pre-battle events of A New Hope to 0 BBY; Star Wars: Timelines, which Wookieepedia now follows, puts them in 1 BBY and treats the Battle of Yavin itself as year zero.

events.title: Leia rescued; Kenobi falls to Vader
events.summary: Pulled aboard the Death Star, the Falcon's crew frees Leia from the detention level while Obi-Wan switches off the tractor beam. Kenobi lets Vader strike him down so the others can escape, and the Falcon flees with the plans, unknowingly tracked.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

events.title: Battle of Yavin: the Death Star destroyed
events.note: The zero mark of the BBY/ABY reckoning: Lucasfilm now treats the battle as year 0, the months before it as 1 BBY and the year after it as 0 ABY.
events.summary: Rebel starfighters attack the Death Star as it closes on their hidden base at Yavin 4. Luke Skywalker, trusting the Force and covered by Han Solo, fires the torpedoes that destroy it. Tarkin dies aboard; Vader spins away.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
events.conflict: Star Wars: Galactic Atlas (2016) dated the battle and the events just before it to 0 BBY; Star Wars: Timelines and Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition drop 0 BBY, putting the pre-battle events in 1 BBY and the battle itself at 0.

events.title: Heroes of Yavin receive medals
events.summary: At dawn after the battle, Princess Leia decorates Luke and Han for bravery, Chewbacca beside them, in Yavin 4's Great Temple. The gathering also mourns the people lost with Alderaan.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

events.title: Rebels abandon their Yavin 4 base
events.summary: With their hideout exposed and reprisals expected, the Alliance clears out of its Massassi temple base within days of the battle. The search for a safe new headquarters shapes its next three years.

events.title: Leia gathers Alderaan's scattered survivors
events.summary: Against orders, Leia and pilot Evaan Verlaine slip away to find Alderaanians who were offworld when their planet died. Hunted by the Empire, they fight off attacks at Sullust and form a refugee fleet, which chooses Evaan as its princess.
events.wp: Mission to rescue the survivors of Alderaan

events.title: Luke frees a codebreaker on Denon
events.summary: Weeks after Yavin, Luke and pilot Nakari Kelen sneak onto the city-planet Denon and extract Drusil Bephorin, a Givin cryptographer forced to work for the Empire. Between missions Luke practices moving objects with the Force.

events.title: Han runs the Dragon Void race
events.summary: Leia talks Han into entering the deadly Dragon Void race as cover for collecting rebel spies who are being picked off by a traitor. He unmasks the mole, outruns Imperial attacks and comes out of it committed to the Rebellion for good.

events.title: Inferno Squad eliminates the Dreamers
events.summary: The Empire's new commando unit Inferno Squad, led by Iden Versio, goes undercover inside the Dreamers, a cell of Saw Gerrera's Partisans holding dangerous Imperial secrets, and wipes the group out from within.

events.title: Rebels raid Weapons Factory Alpha
events.summary: Posing as Jabba's envoys, Han, Luke and Leia infiltrate a major Imperial arms plant on Cymoon 1, free its slaves and rig its reactor. Vader arrives and overpowers Luke, but the rebels break out in a hijacked AT-AT as the factory blows.

events.title: Vader recruits Doctor Aphra
events.summary: Rebuked by the Emperor after Yavin and watched by rivals, Vader secretly hires rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra and the murderous droids Triple-Zero and BeeTee. Together they seize a Geonosian droid factory to build an army loyal to him alone.

events.title: Luke's first lightsaber duel on Devaron
events.summary: Stranded on Devaron for ship repairs, Luke seeks out the ancient Temple of Eedit, trains there with Anakin's old weapon, and fends off the scavenger Sarco Plank in his first real lightsaber fight.
events.wp: Skirmish in the Temple of Eedit
sources: The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure

events.title: Vader learns his son's name
events.summary: Vader quietly hires Boba Fett to find the pilot responsible for the Death Star's destruction. Fett corners Luke at Obi-Wan's old home on Tatooine and loses him, but brings Vader a name, Skywalker, and Vader understands he has a son.

events.title: Vader brought down at Vrogas Vas
events.summary: Acting on Aphra's tip, Vader flies alone to Vrogas Vas to seize Luke and is rammed down onto the planet. He cuts through the rebel defenders, kills the rival Imperial commander Karbin and clashes with Luke before the rebels scatter.

events.title: Rebel plot against Palpatine backfires
events.summary: Eneb Ray, a rebel agent on Coruscant, leads a raid to free condemned senators from an Imperial prison and ambush the visiting Emperor. The target is a body double: the trap kills every spy and senator except Ray.

events.title: Vader crushes the Shu-Torun uprising
events.summary: After a failed royal plot against him, Vader has Shu-Torun's king killed and crowns the youngest heir, Trios, queen of the ore-rich world. When its dukes revolt, Imperial forces grind them down, leaving Trios in full control and bound to Vader.

events.title: Vader becomes Supreme Commander
events.summary: Doctor Cylo, who has been building cyborg candidates to replace Vader, tries to steal the unfinished Star Dreadnought Executor at Kuat. Vader kills him, Supreme Commander Cassio Tagge is executed, and Vader takes Tagge's post.

events.title: Rebels rejoin the Partisans on Jedha
events.summary: Back on the ruined moon of Jedha, the heroes of Yavin restore ties with Saw Gerrera's surviving Partisans under Benthic. Together they wreck the Imperial dig, run with Queen Trios' miners, that is stripping the moon of its kyber.

events.title: Rebels scout Crait as a base
events.note: Star Wars Insider 203 sets The Storms of Crait one year after A New Hope.
events.summary: Still hunting for a home, the Alliance sends Leia and Luke to the salt-crusted mining world Crait to survey an abandoned outpost. Imperials attack, but the site becomes the refuge the Resistance will defend three decades later.
sources: The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait 1

events.title: Mon Cala fleet mutinies for the Alliance
events.summary: Leia's team tries to free Mon Cala's imprisoned King Lee-Char, but he is shot during the rescue. His recorded last words move the Mon Calamari crews to seize their mercantile fleet and escape with Ackbar, giving the Alliance heavy cruisers.

events.title: Alliance opens the Mid Rim Offensive
events.note: Twilight Company puts the start eighteen months before its 3 ABY main events; Star Wars: Timelines says around 1 ABY.
events.summary: Emboldened by Yavin, the Alliance pushes into the Mid Rim with hundreds of battle groups in one of its largest campaigns. Nine months in, an overstretched fleet and poorly coordinated ground commanders bring it to a halt.

events.title: Rebel fleet ambushed at Mako-Ta
events.summary: Betrayed by Queen Trios, the refitting rebel fleet is caught at its Mako-Ta dockyard with its ships locked down. Vader's Death Squadron destroys over half the new Mon Cala cruisers and most rebel fighters; Dodonna and Draven die covering the escape.

events.title: Luke founds Rogue Squadron
events.summary: Forcing open the jammed hangar doors at Mako-Ta, Luke leads the trapped X-wings into the fight. When Wedge Antilles asks for a call sign, Luke names the new unit Rogue Squadron to honor Jyn Erso and Rogue One.

events.title: Rebels build Echo Base on Hoth
events.note: Start estimated from Complete Locations' two-year building span ending at the Battle of Hoth.
events.summary: The Alliance carves Echo Base into a mountain on the remote ice planet Hoth, slowly drawing its scattered forces there. The hidden base serves as rebel headquarters until the Empire finds it.
events.conflict: Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016) says Echo Base took about two years to build before the Battle of Hoth, while Star Wars: Galactic Atlas says it was constructed in 3 ABY.

events.title: Leia topples Queen Trios
events.summary: Seeking payback for Mako-Ta, Leia leads rebels and Partisans to Shu-Torun to wreck the Spike, the heart of the planet's Empire-supplying industry. Queen Trios is killed fighting Leia as the Spike falls.

events.title: Aphra exposes a plot against Palpatine
events.summary: Imperial propaganda minister Pitina Voor quietly sets up a chain of events meant to end with the Emperor's death. Doctor Aphra uncovers the scheme and makes it public, and Vader beheads Voor.

events.title: Mid Rim Offensive collapses into retreat
events.summary: The Mid Rim campaign breaks down at key points and High Command pulls rebel forces off six worlds as the Empire retakes lost ground. The fighting withdrawal, covered by units such as Twilight Company, drags on into 3 ABY.

events.title: Poe Dameron is born
events.summary: Poe Dameron is born on Yavin 4. His mother Shara Bey flies for the Rebellion and his father Kes Dameron serves with the Pathfinders; raised mostly by his grandfather, Poe will grow up to be the Resistance's finest pilot.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

events.title: Governor Everi Chalis defects
events.summary: Covering the Mid Rim withdrawal, Twilight Company storms Haidoral Prime, where Imperial governor Everi Chalis, held under house arrest, asks to defect. Her insider knowledge later shapes the company's campaign against Kuat.

events.title: Battle of Hoth: Echo Base falls
events.summary: An Imperial probe droid finds Echo Base. General Veers' walkers brush past Luke's snowspeeders to knock out the shield generator, and Vader's troops storm the base as rebel transports flee, scattering the fleet in a crushing defeat.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

events.title: Luke trains with Yoda on Dagobah
events.summary: Sent by Obi-Wan's spirit, Luke lands on the swamp world Dagobah and finds the exiled Master Yoda, who reluctantly trains him. A premonition of his friends suffering pulls Luke away before his training is complete.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

events.title: Han frozen in carbonite at Cloud City
events.summary: Fleeing Hoth, the Falcon reaches Cloud City, where Lando Calrissian has been forced to hand his friends to Vader. Han is frozen in carbonite and given to Boba Fett for Jabba; Lando turns on the Empire and helps the others escape.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

events.title: Vader reveals he is Luke's father
events.summary: Luke abandons his training to face Vader on Cloud City. Vader cuts off his hand, reveals that he is Luke's father and invites him to rule at his side. Luke refuses, drops into the city's depths and is plucked to safety by Leia.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

events.title: Vader hunts the truth of Padmé's death
events.summary: Hunting whoever concealed his son, Vader returns to Naboo, where Padmé's former handmaiden Sabé and other loyalists try to stop him at her tomb. On Polis Massa he finds a record of Padmé's last words: she believed good remained in him.

events.title: Operation Starlight regathers the rebel fleet
events.summary: With the Empire reading rebel codes and ambushing survivors at their rendezvous points, the Fourth Division launches Operation Starlight. Starlight Squadron slips past Commander Zahra's hunters to reconnect the scattered divisions, which finally reassemble at Sullust.

events.title: Vader confronts Palpatine on Exegol
events.summary: Punished on Mustafar for mourning Padmé, Vader follows a Sith wayfinder to hidden Exegol, taming a colossal space beast on the way. He challenges his master there but is overwhelmed and yields; the Sith cult keeps building its fleet.

events.title: Starlight Squadron saves Mothma at Ab Dalis
events.summary: The Imperial warship Ultima II pins down the rebel Eleventh Division, with Mon Mothma and Admiral Ackbar, on Ab Dalis and flattens its ground defenses. Starlight Squadron destroys the ship by setting off the volcano beneath it.

events.title: Crimson Dawn auctions Han Solo
events.summary: Qi'ra's revived Crimson Dawn steals the frozen Han from Boba Fett on Nar Shaddaa and auctions him to the galaxy's powers on Jekara. Jabba outbids everyone, but Vader crashes the sale and duels Qi'ra as rival hunters chase the prize.

events.title: Boba Fett delivers Han to Jabba
events.summary: Boba Fett snatches Han back from aboard the Executor and finally hands the carbonite slab to Jabba on Tatooine. At Palpatine's order Vader kills the Hutt Council members who tried to grab Han, leaving Jabba the unchallenged Hutt leader.

events.title: Qi'ra launches the Syndicate War
events.note: Follows War of the Bounty Hunters, which Star Wars: Timelines dates to 3 ABY.
events.summary: Declaring that her dawn has come, Qi'ra aims Crimson Dawn at the Sith themselves. Her agents set the great crime syndicates against each other and stir chaos inside the Empire, until Palpatine orders the underworld to unite against her.

events.title: Leia defeats Zahra at Panisia
events.note: Mentioned as a recent event in Star Wars Outlaws, which Lucasfilm sets in 3 ABY.
events.summary: Commander Zahra's Star Destroyer Tarkin's Will wipes out the rebel Second Division's base on Panisia. Pathfinders aboard free the captive Shara Bey and destroy the ship, while Leia bests Zahra in a duel and leaves her stranded on the planet.

events.title: Kay Vess pulls the Canto Bight heist
events.note: Lucasfilm placed the game three years after the Battle of Yavin (San Diego Comic-Con 2024).
events.summary: Scoundrel Kay Vess plays the Pykes, Hutts, Crimson Dawn and Ashiga Clan off each other to crew a vault job on Canto Bight. Betrayed by her employer, she learns the vault's owner runs an ISB front, and the reckoning ends over Akiva.

events.title: Operation Ringbreaker ends at Sullust
events.summary: Twilight Company carries out Everi Chalis's plan to weaken Kuat's shipyards by hitting softer Imperial targets. The campaign ends at Sullust, where the rebels take and hold Inyusu Tor but lose their ship Thunderstrike, and the plan is abandoned.

events.title: Rebels learn of a second Death Star
events.note: Wookieepedia derives the date from Star Wars (2020) 50, about twenty-two years after Palpatine became Emperor.
