levents.summary: Taking up the mask of Mandalore, Canderous Ordo rallies the scattered clans at a camp on Onderon's moon Dxun and sets about restoring their strength. His warriors fight beside the Exile against the Sith.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords

levents.title: The Exile destroys the Sith Triumvirate
levents.summary: Meetra Surik, the Jedi Exile, regains the Force and hunts the Triumvirate. She kills Darth Nihilus above Telos IV, then defeats Darth Sion and her own mentor Kreia, Darth Traya, as Malachor V is destroyed, ending the Purge and the Old Sith Wars.
sources: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords

levents.title: Revan and the Exile confront the Sith Emperor
levents.summary: Revan and Meetra Surik infiltrate the Emperor's citadel on Dromund Kaas, aided by the Sith Lord Scourge. Scourge betrays them, stabbing Surik from behind, and the Emperor overpowers Revan and holds him captive for some three centuries.

levents.title: Grizmallt colonists settle Naboo
levents.summary: Grizmallt's Queen Elsinoré den Tasia sends out three colony ships that vanish from contact, then turn up on Naboo. Their human settlers take the plains and hills, living uneasily beside the native Gungans, and become the people later called the Naboo.

levents.title: Freia Kallea blazes the Hydian Way
levents.summary: The Brentaal explorer Freia Kallea stitches existing routes into one hyperlane running from the galaxy's north to its southern rim, surviving six years stranded on Nuvar along the way. Christened in 3693 BBY, the Hydian Way becomes a great trade artery.
levents.conflict: Older works, Imperial Double-Cross among them, put Kallea's voyage near 3000 BBY; The Essential Atlas moved it earlier, ahead of the setting of The Old Republic.

levents.title: The Great Galactic War
levents.summary: Emerging from the Unknown Regions, the Emperor's Sith Empire destroys a Republic convoy in the Tingel Arm, then retakes Korriban. Twenty-eight years of war follow, from a Sith blockade of the Rimma route to battles at Bothawui, Alderaan and Hoth.
sources: The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)
Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace

levents.title: Coruscant sacked; Treaty of Coruscant signed
levents.summary: While Republic envoys discuss peace on Alderaan, Darth Malgus storms Coruscant, wrecking the Jedi Temple and killing Chancellor Berooken and Grand Master Zym. With its capital held hostage, the Republic signs the Treaty of Coruscant, ceding worlds for an uneasy Cold War.
sources: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant

levents.title: Satele Shan leads the Jedi back to Tython
levents.summary: With their Coruscant temple in ruins, the Jedi follow Satele Shan to Tython, the long-forbidden cradle of their Order, which she has rediscovered. They resettle it and raise a new temple, finished by 3647 BBY; Shan later becomes Grand Master.
sources: The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)

levents.title: Cold War collapses into open Galactic War
levents.summary: Years of proxy fights, from Ord Mantell's separatist war to Alderaan's civil war and Darth Angral's private vendetta, finally wreck the Treaty of Coruscant. Republic and Empire return to open war across the galaxy.
levents.conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline dates the outbreak to 3642 BBY; its Cold War and Galactic War articles, following The Old Republic's own dating, give 3641 BBY.

levents.title: Hero of Tython strikes down the Sith Emperor
levents.summary: While Satele Shan's fleet engages the Imperial home guard, a Jedi strike team under the Hero of Tython confronts the Emperor in his Dromund Kaas stronghold and halts a ritual meant to feed on all the galaxy's life. His body seems destroyed, but he survives.

levents.title: Revan's last stand on Yavin 4
levents.summary: Escaped at last from the Emperor's prison, Revan gathers followers into the Order of Revan, scheming to revive Vitiate so he can destroy him for good. A joint Republic and Imperial coalition defeats him on Yavin 4, and Revan's spirit finally passes on.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan

levents.title: Vitiate devours all life on Ziost
levents.summary: Revived by Revan's scheme, Vitiate seizes the minds of Ziost's people and sets Imperial and Republic troops against each other there. He then kills everything alive on the ancient Sith world and vanishes, leaving a gray, dead planet.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan
levents.conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline places this in 3637 BBY; its Ziost and Invasion of Ziost articles give 3636 BBY, following The Old Republic's update dating.

levents.title: Zakuul's Eternal Empire conquers the known galaxy
levents.summary: From Wild Space, Zakuul's Eternal Fleet sweeps into the Core and overwhelms Republic and Empire alike, forcing each to pay tribute. Its new ruler Arcann, whose father Valkorion is secretly Vitiate, freezes the Outlander in carbonite.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire

levents.title: The Alliance ends Vitiate for good
levents.summary: Thawed from carbonite, the Outlander builds the Eternal Alliance on Odessen and takes the war to Zakuul. The Alliance topples Empress Vaylin and at last destroys Vitiate's spirit, ending the Sith who had bent the galaxy to his will for nearly fifteen centuries.
sources: Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire
Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne

levents.title: Darth Ruin's schism opens the New Sith Wars
levents.summary: Jedi Master Phanius quits the Order, taking fifty followers with him, and renames himself Darth Ruin, creating the New Sith. This Fourth Great Schism starts a thousand-year struggle between Jedi and Sith that bleeds the Republic white.
sources: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side
levents.conflict: The Phantom Menace novelization credits this rogue Jedi with founding the Sith itself "almost two thousand years ago", which contradicts Tales of the Jedi; in 2000 The Essential Chronology recast him as founder of a successor order, the New Sith.

levents.title: Republic army routed at Mizra
levents.summary: A Sith sniper kills the Jedi coordinator whose battle meditation is holding a huge Republic army together. The force collapses into a rout: over half a million soldiers die, hundreds of Jedi are captured, and the Republic nears defeat.
sources: The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)

levents.title: Belia Darzu's technobeasts: the Sictis Wars
levents.summary: The shape-shifting Dark Lord Belia Darzu uses the Sith art of mechu-deru to turn victims into mechanical technobeasts, breeding an army in her fortress on Tython. Twenty years later the Mecrosa Order and her own followers assassinate her.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Droids

levents.title: The Republic Dark Age
levents.summary: Through the last century of Jedi-Sith warfare, the Republic fragments so badly that later historians count it as dissolved. Sith empires and Jedi Lords with private armies carve up the galaxy while Coruscant's government shrinks to a shadow.

levents.title: Mandalore the Uniter rebuilds Mandalorian Space
levents.summary: Coming home to find his clan nearly wiped out by the Candorian plague, the mercenary Aga Awaud rallies Mandalorians against raiders. Hailed as Mandalore the Uniter in 1051 BBY, he turns Mandalorian Space into a strong regional power in industry and war.

levents.title: Dessel, the future Darth Bane, is born
levents.note: Worked out by Wookieepedia: The Essential Reader's Companion starts Path of Destruction in 1003 BBY, and the novel fixes Dessel's age at his father's death five years earlier.
levents.summary: Dessel is born on Apatros, a bleak cortosis-mining world in the Outer Rim. Brutalized by his miner father, he grows up strong and bitter, unaware that his rage is feeding on the Force's dark side.

levents.title: Kaan's Brotherhood faces Hoth's Army of Light
levents.summary: Jedi Master Skere Kaan defects with like-minded Jedi and forges the Brotherhood of Darkness, a Sith order whose Lords claim to be equals. In answer, Lord Hoth unites the Jedi baronies into the Army of Light to carry the war to the Sith.

levents.title: The Ruusan campaign begins
levents.summary: Hoth's Army of Light meets Kaan's Brotherhood of Darkness on Ruusan, beginning two years of ground and orbital fighting. Seven major battles scar the planet as both sides pour their strength into the decisive front.

levents.title: Dessel takes the name Darth Bane
levents.note: Not on Wookieepedia's timeline; its Darth Bane article gives 1001–1000 BBY for his years as a Brotherhood Dark Lord and dates the duel on Lehon to 1000 BBY.
levents.summary: Trained at the reopened Sith academy on Korriban, Dessel outgrows his masters, renames himself Darth Bane and rejects Kaan's rule of equals. On Lehon he studies Darth Revan's holocron and resolves that the Sith should number just two, master and apprentice.

levents.title: Thought bomb ends the Battle of Ruusan
levents.summary: Goaded by Darth Bane, the cornered Lord Kaan unleashes the thought bomb in Ruusan's caves. It annihilates Kaan's Sith Lords along with Lord Hoth and ninety-nine Jedi. Bane, who stayed away, survives and takes the young Zannah as his apprentice, ending the New Sith Wars.

levents.title: Bane's Rule of Two remakes the Sith
levents.summary: With Kaan's Brotherhood gone, Bane rebuilds the Sith in hiding under the Rule of Two: one master and one apprentice, who proves worthy by killing the master and then trains a successor. His Order of the Sith Lords will wait a thousand years for revenge.

levents.title: The Ruusan Reformation disarms the Republic
levents.summary: After Ruusan, Chancellor Tarsus Valorum's reforms disband the Republic's standing military, leaving each system to defend itself. The Jedi give up their armies and ranks and answer to the Chancellor, and the Senate's millions of sectors merge into 1,024, each with one Senator.

levents.title: Othone raises the Valley of the Jedi
levents.summary: Defying the Jedi Council, Lord Hoth's former Padawan Johun Othone, backed by Chancellor Valorum, raises a memorial in the Ruusan cavern where the thought bomb fell. The souls it trapped stay bound there, a nexus of Force power, until Kyle Katarn frees them.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II

levents.title: Jedi slay a decoy, believing the Sith gone
levents.summary: Seeking Belia Darzu's holocron on Tython, Bane and Zannah kill a Jedi strike team, but Bane is badly hurt. On Ambria, Zannah breaks her cousin Darovit's mind and leaves him for the Jedi, who kill him as the last Sith Lord and stop looking.

levents.title: Zannah defeats Bane and becomes Dark Lord
levents.summary: Suspecting Zannah is waiting for his body to fail, Bane seeks Darth Andeddu's secret of moving into a new body. They duel on Ambria; beaten, Bane tries to seize Zannah's body, but her will drives him out. She makes the Iktotchi Cognus her apprentice.

levents.title: The Chiss outlaw the first strike
levents.note: Worked out by Wookieepedia: Survivor's Quest calls the law a thousand years old, and The Essential Reader's Companion sets that novel in 22 ABY.
levents.summary: The Chiss Ascendancy makes pre-emptive attack a crime punishable by exile: its forces may fight only once struck. The doctrine governs Chiss policy for more than a thousand years, and breaking it will cost the young commander Thrawn his place among his people.

levents.title: The Republic lays waste to Mandalorian Space
levents.summary: Alarmed by the rearmed Mandalorians, who refuse to join the Republic after Ruusan, the Jedi lead Judicial Forces in a pre-emptive strike. Bombardment cripples Mandalore, Concord Dawn and other worlds, leaving deserts for centuries; Mandalorians remember it as the Dral'Han, the Annihilation.
sources: The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett

levents.title: Exiled Jedi Allya founds Dathomir's witch clans
levents.summary: Rather than execute the fallen Jedi Knight Allya, the Republic exiles her to Dathomir's prison colony. She teaches the colony's women to draw on the Force, founding the rancor-riding Witches of Dathomir, and late in life writes the Book of Law to temper their magic.

levents.title: Alkhara's betrayal starts the Tusken blood feud
levents.note: Wookieepedia's timeline sets the massacre in 550 BBY, the year Alkhara reached Tatooine; the Hutt Jabba drove him from the monastery in 516 BBY.
levents.summary: Alkhara, a researcher turned bandit, joins Tatooine's Sand People to wipe out a police garrison, then massacres them. The killings start a feud between Tuskens and settlers that lasts centuries; his gang holes up in a B'omarr monastery that later becomes Jabba's palace.

levents.title: Darth Gean kills the faltering Darth Gravid
levents.note: Worked out by Wookieepedia: Darth Plagueis says Gravid's reign ended some five centuries before a scene it sets just after Padmé Amidala turns thirteen, in 33 BBY.
levents.summary: Drawn toward the Jedi's altruism, Dark Lord Darth Gravid loses his sanity and sets out to destroy the Sith's lore. His apprentice Darth Gean storms his bastion on Jaguada and kills him, but most of the teachings are already gone, a loss felt for generations.

levents.title: The Republic sets aside the Corporate Sector
levents.summary: To end feuds between lawmakers and the galaxy's biggest companies, the Republic hands corporations a few hundred lifeless systems in the Tingel Arm to exploit under its supervision. Under the Empire the Corporate Sector swells to some 30,000 systems, run by the Corporate Sector Authority.
sources: Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook

levents.title: Corellia tries to leave the Republic
levents.summary: Corellia bids for independence under Contemplanys Hermi, an obscure constitutional clause that lets the sector recall its Senators and close its borders. The bid fails and the clause is forgotten until Senator Garm Bel Iblis invokes it against the Military Creation Act in 22 BBY.

levents.title: Keiran Halcyon breaks the Afarathu cult
levents.summary: The Corellian Jedi Knight Keiran Halcyon breaks the Afarathu, a sect of Selonian extremists terrorizing the Corellian system. His bloodline of Corellian Jedi runs down to the Clone Wars hero Nejaa Halcyon and the pilot Corran Horn, who will briefly borrow Keiran's name.

levents.title: The Trade Federation is chartered
levents.summary: The Republic charters the Trade Federation to referee disputes among shipping firms, as giant haulers lock rivals out of Outer Rim spaceports and hoard navigation data. Within a century it becomes a shipping cartel and Senate lobby, later dominated by the Neimoidians.
sources: The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)
Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections

levents.title: Jedi academy ship Chu'unthor crashes on Dathomir
levents.summary: The Chu'unthor, a Jedi academy starship, crashes on Dathomir. Yoda and other Jedi come for its crew but are driven off by the witches and their rancors; after Yoda saves a young witch, Rell, a truce lets them go, leaving the wreck and its library.
levents.conflict: The New Essential Chronology dates the crash to 340 BBY, as Wookieepedia's timeline and its Dathomir article do; the Chu'unthor article itself gives 230 BBY without citing a source.

levents.title: Jedi Council expels the Potentium heretics
levents.summary: Leor Hal's Potentium teaches that the Force has no dark side, only a single whole to explore. It draws Padawans from Coruscant's and Alderaan's great families until the Council expels its followers. Some later settle the living world Zonama Sekot, which takes up their creed.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)

levents.title: Corporations win their own seats in the Senate
levents.summary: Two linked Senate laws make the Outer Rim a tax-free trade zone and count guilds and corporations as functional constituencies entitled to Senators. The Trade Federation gains a seat, and the combines that later back the Separatists win a direct voice in lawmaking.

levents.title: The protocol droid C-3PO is activated on Affa
levents.summary: Cybot Galactica starts turning out 3PO protocol droids, and one, later known as C-3PO, is activated on Affa. After decades serving diplomats, among them the emissary of the Manakron system, he ends up gutted and dumped on Tatooine, where the slave boy Anakin Skywalker rebuilds him.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
The New Essential Guide to Droids

levents.title: The Dowager Queen crashes on Tatooine
levents.summary: Taking Tatooine for an empty world, the colony ship Dowager Queen from Bestine IV tries to land and is wrecked by a sandstorm. Its survivors found Bestine, and the town that later grows up around the stripped hulk becomes Mos Eisley.

levents.title: Plagueis kills his master, Darth Tenebrous
levents.summary: Darth Tenebrous, a Bith known publicly as the starship designer Rugess Nome, contains the blast of a sabotaged mining probe on Bal'demnic. His Muun apprentice Plagueis seizes the moment, breaks his neck and studies his midi-chlorians as he dies, becoming Dark Lord of the Sith.

levents.title: Palpatine murders his family and becomes Sidious
levents.summary: The Muun financier Hego Damask, secretly Darth Plagueis, takes an interest in Palpatine, a young Naboo noble at odds with his father. When Cosinga Palpatine tries to send him away, Palpatine kills his whole family in a dark-side rage, and Plagueis names him Darth Sidious.

levents.title: The Hutts take control of Tatooine
levents.summary: The Hutts take over Tatooine, prizing the backwater desert world as a transfer point for smuggled goods between the Corellian Run and the Triellus Trade Route. Hutt clans, Jabba's Desilijic among them, rule its underworld for the next seventy years.

levents.title: Jaster Mereel's code splits the Mandalorians
levents.summary: Jaster Mereel becomes Mandalore and lays down the Supercommando Codex: Mandalorians should fight only as honorable mercenaries. Tor Vizsla's Death Watch breaks away to return to raiding, and civil war follows. In 58 BBY Jaster adopts Jango Fett, a farm boy orphaned by Death Watch.
sources: Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons

levents.title: Qui-Gon's apprentice Xanatos turns to the dark
levents.summary: Sent to Telos IV for his final trial, Qui-Gon's Padawan Xanatos falls under his father Crion's sway. When Qui-Gon is forced to kill Crion, Xanatos quits the Order as a Dark Jedi; nine years later, cornered on Telos, he leaps into acid rather than surrender.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side
Jedi Apprentice: The Day of Reckoning

levents.title: Jaster Mereel falls; Jango Fett becomes Mandalore
levents.summary: Hired for what looks like easy work on Korda Six, the True Mandalorians walk into a Death Watch ambush. Betrayed by his second-in-command Montross, Jaster Mereel is killed by Tor Vizsla. Jango Fett carries his body back, exposes Montross and succeeds him as Mandalore.
sources: Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons

levents.title: Renegade scientists rise on Arkania
levents.summary: Arkanian scientists who object to the Dominion's genetic tinkering with the Yaka rise in revolt, fielding an army of cyborg Assimilators and committing atrocities of their own. Jedi including Mace Windu intervene, and the Dominion crushes the Renegades.
sources: The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)

levents.title: The Katana fleet vanishes on its maiden voyage
levents.summary: The Katana fleet, two hundred Dreadnaught cruisers slaved together to run on skeleton crews, sets out on its maiden voyage. A hive virus drives the crews mad, and the linked ships jump blindly into hyperspace and vanish. The smuggler Hoffner finds them in 6 BBY.
levents.conflict: Pellaeon's 'fifty-five years' in Dark Force Rising and The New Essential Chronology's completion date point to about 46 BBY, and Wookieepedia's timeline lists the loss in 45 BBY. Karrde's 'about ten years before the Clone Wars' would put it nearer 32 BBY.

levents.title: Iaco Stark's pirates fight the Republic at Troiken
levents.summary: Iaco Stark's combine of pirates, secretly backed by the Trade Federation and bacta maker Xucphra, strangles the Republic's bacta supply. Talks at Troiken collapse into five battles that kill Jedi Master Tyvokka and Senator Ranulph Tarkin. The war, stoked by Sidious, helps make Valorum Chancellor.
sources: Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War

levents.title: Jedi wipe out the True Mandalorians at Galidraan
levents.summary: Galidraan's governor, sheltering Death Watch, hires Jango Fett's Mandalorians to crush rebels, then tells the Jedi they are murdering dissidents. Dooku's task force attacks; eleven Jedi and every Mandalorian but Jango die, and Jango is sold into slavery. The deceit shakes Dooku's faith in the Republic.
sources: Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons
Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)

levents.title: Obi-Wan leaves the Order for Melida/Daan's Young
levents.summary: Sent with Qui-Gon to rescue Jedi Tahl from the warring Melida and Daan, thirteen-year-old Obi-Wan sides with the Young, an army of war orphans, and quits the Order. They topple the Elders in fourteen days; after his friend Cerasi is killed, Obi-Wan asks to return.
sources: Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead

levents.title: Plagueis and Sidious tip the Force toward darkness
levents.summary: Plagueis and Sidious enter a joint trance and push the Force toward the dark side, even trying to will a being into existence through the galaxy's midi-chlorians. A decade later Plagueis suspects the Force answered by conceiving Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One.

levents.title: The Great ReSynchronization resets the calendar
levents.summary: To reconcile the tangle of dating systems across the Republic, the Republic Measures & Standards Bureau adopts a reformed Galactic Standard Calendar with 35 BBY as year zero. Late Republic records count from it: the Stark Hyperspace War falls in 9 BrS, nine years before.
sources: A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded

levents.title: The Yinchorri rise and raid the Jedi Temple
levents.summary: Egged on by Sidious through the rogue Vilmarh Grahrk, the Yinchorri seize the Golden Nyss Shipyards, overrun Mayvitch 7 and dump two murdered Jedi on Valorum's doorstep. Twelve Jedi strike at the Yinchorri worlds as commandos raid the Temple; the Republic wins and disarms them.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War

levents.title: Maul wipes out Black Sun's leadership
levents.summary: Sidious sends Maul to throw Black Sun into chaos, in part to repay the syndicate's attempt on Plagueis's life. Maul kills Vigos on Coruscant and Dac, then storms the fortress on Ralltiir where the rest have gathered, slaughtering every Vigo and drowning Underlord Alexi Garyn.

levents.title: Sidious murders Plagueis on election night
levents.summary: On the night the Senate elects Palpatine Supreme Chancellor, Sidious kills his master as the Muun sleeps. Plagueis the Wise, who spent decades hunting the secret of cheating death, dies with his work unfinished, and Sidious becomes the sole Dark Lord of the Sith.

levents.title: Yuuzhan Vong scouts besiege Zonama Sekot
levents.summary: Yuuzhan Vong scouts, invaders from beyond the galaxy whom the settlers call Far Outsiders, try to colonize the living world Zonama Sekot, whose biosphere kills the organisms they bring. Two years of siege end when the Jedi Vergere agrees to leave with them.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way

levents.title: Dooku quits the Jedi Order after Naboo
levents.summary: Shaken by Galidraan and embittered by Qui-Gon Jinn's death on Naboo, Dooku resigns from the Order without explanation, the twentieth Master to walk away; the Archives add his bust to those of the Lost Twenty. He reclaims his title as Count of Serenno.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)
Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)
The New Essential Guide to Characters

levents.title: Zonama Sekot escapes Tarkin into the Unknown Regions
levents.summary: Seeking Vergere's fate, Obi-Wan and Anakin find Zonama Sekot growing living starships. Tarkin and Raith Sienar strike with Trade Federation forces to seize it, but the planet jumps into hyperspace. Tarkin saves face by giving Palpatine Sienar's plans for a giant battle station.

levents.title: Shimrra seizes the Yuuzhan Vong throne
levents.summary: News of Zonama Sekot shakes Supreme Overlord Quoreal, who wants the Yuuzhan Vong to seek another galaxy. Backed by the most aggressive domains, the Intendant Shimrra Jamaane has him killed and takes his place, committing the Vong to the invasion that comes decades later.
sources: The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force
The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy

levents.title: Outbound Flight is destroyed in the Unknown Regions
levents.summary: Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth leads Outbound Flight, six Dreadnaughts of colonists and Jedi bound for the Unknown Regions. At Sidious's request the Chiss commander Thrawn cripples it; Sidious's agent Kinman Doriana deals the final blow, and the wreck falls onto a planetoid where survivors hold on.

levents.title: Yaddle dies absorbing a chemical weapon
levents.note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists her death under 25 BBY; her own article gives 26 BBY.
levents.summary: On a peacekeeping mission to lawless Mawan with Obi-Wan and Anakin, Yaddle uses the Force to pull a deadly chemical weapon released by Granta Omega, Xanatos's son, into her own body, dying to save the city's people. Shaak Ti takes her seat on the Council.

levents.title: Jedi keep Ansion in the Republic
levents.summary: The Commerce Guild schemes to pull Ansion out of the Republic, and with it dozens of treaty-bound worlds. Luminara Unduli and Obi-Wan, with their Padawans Barriss Offee and Anakin, cross its plains to end the feud between city-dwellers and nomadic Alwari, and Ansion stays.

levents.title: The Jedi stop Dooku's Dark Reaper
levents.summary: A Separatist attack on remote Rhen Var opens Dooku's plan to rebuild the Dark Reaper, an ancient Sith weapon that feeds on the life energy of its victims. Mace Windu, Obi-Wan and Anakin fight across Rhen Var, Raxus Prime and Thule to destroy it.
sources: Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)

levents.title: The Republic storms the Banking Clan's Muunilinst
levents.summary: Obi-Wan and Anakin strike Muunilinst, home of the Banking Clan and its droid foundries. ARC troopers crack Harnaidan's defenses, Obi-Wan defeats the bounty hunter Durge, and Dooku's assassin Asajj Ventress lures Anakin to a duel on Yavin 4. The Republic takes the planet.

levents.title: Mace Windu seeks his fallen Padawan
levents.summary: Mace Windu returns to his jungle homeworld for his former Padawan Depa Billaba, sent to aid a Korun uprising against the Separatists that has turned savage. He finds the jungle's darkness has claimed her; she attacks him, and their struggle leaves her in a coma.

levents.title: General Grievous makes his debut at Hypori
levents.summary: Acting on Daakman Barrek's intelligence, a Republic force raids Hypori's droid foundries and walks into a trap. The Separatists' new Supreme Commander, the cyborg General Grievous, kills Barrek and other Jedi; only Ki-Adi-Mundi, Shaak Ti, Aayla Secura and K'Kruhk survive, pulled out by ARC troopers.

levents.title: The Republic is ground down on Jabiim
levents.summary: The Republic backs Jabiim's loyalists against Separatist-armed nationalists in a campaign fought through endless rain and mud. Obi-Wan is presumed dead, Anakin obeys Palpatine's order to evacuate while a band of Padawans dies holding the line, and the abandoned loyalists curse the Republic.
sources: Star Wars: Republic: The Battle of Jabiim

levents.title: Ventress fakes her death at Boz Pity
levents.note: Wookieepedia dates the battle 19.43 BBY, two years and seven months after the Battle of Geonosis.
levents.summary: Hunting Asajj Ventress, Obi-Wan uncovers a Separatist stronghold at Boz Pity, and a Jedi-led fleet under Mace Windu defeats Dooku and Grievous there. Gravely wounded, Ventress feigns death with Sith meditation, then has her medical transport carry her away from the war and Dooku.

levents.title: Palpatine puts Moffs over the sectors
levents.summary: Palpatine decrees that governors of his choosing will oversee every planet and sector, creating the office of Moff, nominally for the war effort. The move sidelines the Senate, spurs the Petition of 2000 and gives the coming Empire its regional chain of command.
sources: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)

levents.title: The Empire crushes the Nosaurians of New Plympto
levents.summary: Betrayed by his clones at Order 66, Jedi General Dass Jennir returns to New Plympto and leads its Nosaurian rebels, his former enemies, against the Empire. After a month of guerrilla war, the 501st breaks their last stand at Half-Axe Pass, killing nearly all of them.

levents.title: The Caamas Firestorm
levents.summary: Seeing the free-thinking, Republic-loyal Caamasi as a threat, Palpatine has Bothan agents switch off Caamas's planetary shields, and Star Destroyers set the world ablaze. Only some two hundred Caamasi there survive; the Empire blames stray Separatist bombs, and the Bothans' role stays hidden for decades.
sources: Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows

levents.title: Palpatine makes Byss his secret throne world
levents.summary: Soon after the Clone Wars, Palpatine claims Byss, a hidden Deep Core paradise, as his secret throne world. Slaves raise his citadel, and he feeds on the Force energy of settlers lured there, turning Byss into a dark side nexus where his spare clone bodies wait.

levents.title: Two Jedi sabotage the Eye of Palpatine
levents.summary: Palpatine builds the Eye of Palpatine, a battlemoon disguised as an asteroid, to wipe out Jedi children sheltered by Master Plett on Belsavis. Jedi Knights Geith Eris and Callista Ming sabotage it; Callista traps her spirit in its computer to stop it, and the children escape.

levents.title: The 501st takes Naboo and kills its queen
levents.summary: Queen Apailana breaks with the Empire and shelters fugitive Jedi on Naboo. Vader sends the 501st Legion, which crushes the Royal Security Forces, kills the Jedi and assassinates the young queen; the Empire puts the compliant Kylantha on the throne.

levents.title: A'Sharad Hett takes the road to Darth Krayt
levents.summary: The Order 66 survivor A'Sharad Hett leads Tusken raids on Tatooine until Obi-Wan defeats him near the Lars homestead and makes him swear to leave. Hett turns bounty hunter, then on Korriban learns the Sith ways from the spirit of XoXaan; he will become Darth Krayt.
sources: The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi

levents.title: The 501st crushes a clone uprising on Kamino
levents.summary: Resenting Imperial control, Kaminoan Clone Masters grow an army of Jango Fett clones to turn against the Empire. Guided by Boba Fett, who knows Tipoca City from boyhood, the 501st wipes out the rebel clones and their makers. The Empire turns to other templates and recruits.

levents.title: The Second Great Droid Revolution
levents.summary: The cyborg Archa Sabis uploads a virus that turns Coruscant's police cruisers and construction droids against their owners. The Empire quickly crushes the short-lived revolt and turns the public's fear of droids to its own advantage.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Droids

levents.title: Palpatine learns to outlive his own body
levents.summary: From the Tedryn Holocron, taken from the captured Jedi archivist Ashka Boda, Palpatine learns how to move his spirit into a cloned body. He stocks secret storehouses such as Mount Tantiss on Wayland with treasures and cloning gear, killing the architect of its maze.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)
levents.conflict: Wookieepedia's timeline sets the discovery and Mount Tantiss's completion in 8 BBY, but the Dark Empire endnotes say Palpatine held the holocron for thirty years, which puts its capture near the start of the Jedi Purge in 19 BBY.

levents.title: Vader's bombardment kills Xizor's family on Falleen
levents.summary: A flesh-eating bacterium escapes Vader's bioweapons lab on Falleen. Vader has the lab and everything within forty kilometers bombarded from orbit, killing 200,000 Falleen, among them the royal family of Prince Xizor, who has just taken control of Black Sun. Xizor quietly vows revenge.
sources: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)
Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption

levents.title: Han Solo saves Chewbacca and loses his commission
levents.summary: Top of his class at the Imperial Academy, Lieutenant Han Solo refuses an order to skin a wounded Wookiee slave, Chewbacca, then stops an officer from whipping him. Han is court-martialed and cashiered; Chewbacca swears him a life debt, and the two turn smuggler.
sources: Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook

levents.title: Lando Calrissian defeats the sorcerer Rokur Gepta
levents.summary: Rokur Gepta, a Croke illusionist who killed his fellow Sorcerers of Tund and poisoned their world, blames Lando Calrissian for losing him the Mindharp of Sharu and hunts him. In the ThonBoka nebula, Lando saves the space-dwelling Oswaft from Gepta and the Empire, and kills him.
sources: Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka
Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu
Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon

levents.title: Vader's secret apprentice hunts the last Jedi
levents.note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists the hunt under 2 BBY; the articles on Kazdan Paratus and Shaak Ti date their deaths to 3 BBY.
levents.summary: Taken after Vader killed his Jedi father on Kashyyyk, Galen Marek grows up as Vader's secret apprentice, Starkiller. He kills Jedi survivors, Kazdan Paratus on Raxus Prime and Shaak Ti on Felucia, then gathers the Empire's enemies for a supposed plot against the Emperor.

levents.title: Palpatine names twelve Grand Admirals
levents.summary: At the New Year Fete Week celebrations, Palpatine unexpectedly names twelve Grand Admirals, a new rank above even the Grand Moffs that answers only to him. Months before Endor one of them, Demetrius Zaarin, attempts a coup and is replaced by the Chiss Thrawn.

levents.title: Han Solo wins the Millennium Falcon from Lando
levents.summary: In the final round of a sabacc tournament on Cloud City, Lando Calrissian stakes any ship on his Nar Shaddaa sales lot, forgetting that his own Millennium Falcon is parked there. Han Solo wins and claims the Falcon on the technicality.

levents.title: Han Solo breaks open the Stars' End prison
levents.summary: Helping a band searching for relatives who vanished into the Corporate Sector Authority's secret prison, Han loses Chewbacca to its police. He traces the prison, Stars' End, to Mytus VII, frees the prisoners from stasis, and leaves the crippled tower blasted into a suborbital arc.
sources: Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook

levents.title: The Corellian Treaty founds the Rebel Alliance
levents.summary: When Vader seizes the dissidents Galen Marek gathered on Corellia, Marek follows them to the Death Star and dies holding off the Emperor while they escape. Mon Mothma, Bail Organa and Garm Bel Iblis sign the Corellian Treaty, founding the Rebel Alliance under Marek's family crest.

levents.title: Grand Moff Trachta plots against the Sith
levents.summary: Grand Moff Trachta and fellow officers plot to kill Palpatine and Vader with a hundred clone stormtroopers bred to obey Trachta alone, and take the Empire for themselves. The plotters turn on each other, the Sith cut down the rest, and only the assassin Gauer survives.
sources: The Official Star Wars Fact File 122

levents.title: A Starkiller clone leads the rebels to Kamino
levents.summary: Hoping to recreate his lost apprentice, Vader grows clones of Galen Marek on Kamino. One escapes, frees Rahm Kota and leads a rebel fleet back to Kamino, where the Alliance wrecks Timira City's cloning labs and takes Vader prisoner, its first major victory. He soon escapes.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II
Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)

levents.title: Tarkin hides a weapons lab inside the Maw
levents.note: Wookieepedia dates the Installation's construction only to between 19 and 0 BBY; its timeline sets Daala's posting in 0 BBY, just before the Battle of Yavin.
levents.summary: Tarkin builds a hidden weapons laboratory inside the Maw, a cluster of black holes, staffed by prodigies such as Qwi Xux, taken as children from Omwat. It designs the Death Star's prototype, and Admiral Daala's Star Destroyers guard it, cut off, long after the Empire falls.

levents.title: The Death Star's first shot destroys Despayre
levents.note: Days before the Battle of Yavin; placed just before year zero on the archive's axis.
levents.summary: With the Death Star's construction site above the prison world Despayre found by the Alliance, Tarkin moves the nearly finished station, first testing its superlaser on the only planet in range. Despayre and every prisoner on it are destroyed, days before the Battle of Yavin.

levents.title: Rebels seize the Death Star plans at Toprawa
levents.note: Days before the Battle of Yavin; placed just before year zero on the archive's axis.
levents.summary: Rebels raid a convoy above Toprawa for Death Star plans, add pieces taken on the surface and by Kyle Katarn on Danuta, and seize a relay to beam them to Leia's Tantive IV. Bria Tharen's Red Hand Squadron dies holding it, and the Empire razes Toprawa.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
Star Wars: The National Public Radio Dramatization

levents.title: Vader blockades the rebels at Yavin
levents.note: Wookieepedia dates the blockade from 0 to 0.5 ABY, ending six months after the Battle of Yavin.
levents.summary: After Yavin, Vader blockades the Yavin system and pins the Alliance down for six months. When the rebels break out, Admiral Griff leaps into hyperspace after them and emerges on top of Vader's waiting flagship, the Executor; three Star Destroyers are lost and the rebels escape.

levents.title: Kyle Katarn destroys the Dark Trooper Project
levents.summary: General Rom Mohc wins backing for his dark troopers, armored battle droids that wipe out the rebel base on Talay in minutes. Rebel agent Kyle Katarn, a former Imperial officer, tracks the program and destroys its factory ship, the Arc Hammer, killing Mohc.

levents.title: Crix Madine defects after the Dentaal plague
levents.note: Dated by Wookieepedia's timeline; the Crix Madine article gives no year for the defection.
levents.summary: Crix Madine, who founded the Empire's storm commandos, obeys an order to unleash the Candorian plague on Dentaal, then defects to the Rebel Alliance in disgust, losing his fiancée in the escape. He becomes one of the Alliance's leading commanders of special operations.
sources: Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide

levents.title: The Bounty Hunter Wars break the Guild
levents.note: Wookieepedia's timeline lists the Guild's split under 0 ABY; the Bounty Hunter Wars article dates the war's start to 1 ABY.
levents.summary: At Prince Xizor's urging, Palpatine sends Boba Fett to wreck the Bounty Hunters' Guild from inside. Fett joins under its aging leader Cradossk; the Guild splits into the True Guild and the Guild Reform Committee, whose hunters turn on each other until the Guild is finished.

levents.title: Luke and Leia find the Kaiburr crystal
levents.summary: Stranded on swampy Mimban, Luke and Leia join the self-styled seer Halla in hunting the Kaiburr crystal, which magnifies the Force. In its temple Vader cuts Leia down, but Luke severs Vader's arm and the Dark Lord falls into a well; the crystal heals them.
sources: The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader

levents.title: Shira Brie is reborn as the Sith Lumiya
levents.note: The shootdown follows the Battle of Hoth; Vader presents Lumiya to Palpatine a few months before Endor, in 4 ABY.
levents.summary: Planted in the Alliance as a pilot, the Imperial spy Shira Brie is shot down by Luke acting on a Force warning. Vader rebuilds her with cybernetics and trains her as Lumiya, Dark Lady of the Sith; in 4 ABY Palpatine makes her an Emperor's Hand.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Characters

levents.title: Bothans die for the new Death Star's plans
levents.summary: Rebels seize a computer core holding the second Death Star's plans from the freighter Suprosa and hide it with Bothan spies on Kothlis. Bounty hunters raid the safehouse and take Luke, many Bothans die, and Crix Madine's commandos pull the data from a crashed Star Destroyer.
sources: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)
Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader

levents.title: Vader kills Xizor and Black Sun falls apart
levents.summary: Black Sun's Prince Xizor plots to kill Luke and take Vader's place, and holds Leia captive. Rebels break her out and blow up his Coruscant palace; Xizor flees to his skyhook, which Vader's Executor blasts apart with him aboard. Black Sun falls into chaos.
sources: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)
Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)
The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire

levents.title: The Emperor's Hand Mara Jade stalks Luke
levents.summary: Raised from childhood as Palpatine's secret assassin, the Emperor's Hand Mara Jade waits in Jabba's palace disguised as the dancer Arica to kill Luke, but never gets the chance. As Palpatine dies at Endor, she hears his last command: kill Luke Skywalker.
sources: Sleight of Hand: The Tale of Mara Jade
Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand

levents.title: Warlords tear the leaderless Empire apart
levents.summary: With Palpatine dead, the Empire loses its center. Advisors, moffs and admirals such as Isard, Zsinj, Krennel and Teradoc carve out rival realms and fight each other as often as the New Republic, until Daala and Pellaeon force the survivors together in 12 ABY.

levents.title: Nagai and Tof invaders strike after Endor
levents.summary: Nagai raiders from a satellite galaxy, allied with the Sith Lady Lumiya, strike the Alliance days after Endor. When their old oppressors, the Tof, follow them in, the Nagai switch sides, and Republic, Mandalorian and Imperial forces drive the Tof from Saijo.
sources: The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs

levents.title: The Declaration of a New Republic is signed
levents.summary: A month after Endor, with the Nagai War raging, Mon Mothma issues the Declaration of a New Republic, turning the interim Alliance of Free Planets into a government under a Chief of State and a Provisional Council. Leia, Borsk Fey'lya, Ackbar and six other delegates sign it.
sources: The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs

levents.title: IG-88's droid revolution dies with the Death Star
levents.summary: The IG-88 assassin droids, having killed their makers and seized the factory world Mechis III, plot to turn the galaxy's droids against organic life. Their leader IG-88A uploads his mind into the second Death Star's computer and dies with it at Endor before the revolt begins.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88
The New Essential Guide to Droids

levents.title: A'Sharad Hett emerges from Korriban's tombs
levents.summary: Chasing a bounty onto Korriban, the exiled Jedi A'Sharad Hett studies the dark side under the spirit of the ancient Sith Lady XoXaan. He emerges to find Palpatine and Vader already dead and, denied his revenge, heads into the Unknown Regions.

levents.title: Rebels and Imperials unite against the Ssi-ruuk
levents.summary: Imperial Bakura begs for help against the Ssi-ruuk, who power their droid fighters with captives' life energy. An Alliance force under Luke, Han and Leia fights beside the Imperials; when Governor Nereus betrays the truce, his commander Pter Thanas defects and Bakura joins the Alliance.

levents.title: Ysanne Isard seizes control of Imperial Center
levents.summary: Intelligence Director Ysanne Isard undermines Grand Vizier Sate Pestage, who has governed since Palpatine's death, until he flees and the warlord Delak Krennel kills him at Ciutric. Isard has the Ruling Council's leaders picked off and rules Coruscant as empress in all but name.
sources: Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement
Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade
The New Essential Guide to Characters
levents.conflict: Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement has Krennel kill Pestage on Ciutric IV in 5 ABY, while The New Essential Guide to Characters places him alive on Byss until 11 ABY; Wookieepedia lists both deaths.

levents.title: Luke defeats Lord Shadowspawn at Mindor
levents.summary: General Luke Skywalker leads a task force against Lord Shadowspawn, whose shadow stormtroopers raid the Inner Rim from Mindor. Behind the mask is Cronal, who means to take Luke's body. Luke destroys him, but thousands of Cronal's mind-bound troops die with him.
sources: Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor

levents.title: Wedge Antilles rebuilds Rogue Squadron
levents.summary: Admiral Ackbar has Wedge Antilles rebuild Rogue Squadron from scratch with the best pilots he can find, among them the Corellian ex-security officer Corran Horn. After a costly first strike at Borleias, the new Rogues spearhead the push toward Coruscant.

levents.title: Han Solo hunts the warlord Zsinj
levents.summary: General Han Solo leads a fleet against Zsinj, the strongest of the warlords, whose Super Star Destroyer Iron Fist raids the Outer Rim. Wraith Squadron and the Rogues join the chase, which ends over Dathomir when Han fires missiles into Zsinj's bridge.

levents.title: The New Republic takes Coruscant
levents.summary: Rogue Squadron slips onto Coruscant and brings down its shield by boiling a reservoir with an orbital mirror, raising a storm that wrecks the power grid. Ackbar's forces take the capital, but Isard has already released the Krytos virus, which kills only non-Humans.

levents.title: Jagged Fel is born on Nirauan
levents.summary: Jagged Fel is born in the Unknown Regions to the Imperial ace Soontir Fel and Syal Antilles, Wedge's sister. Raised among the Chiss, he becomes a star pilot, marries Jaina Solo, and in time takes the throne of the Fel Empire.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Characters

levents.title: Rogue Squadron wages the Bacta War
levents.summary: Isard flees Coruscant and takes over Thyferra and its bacta. When the New Republic will not act, the Rogues resign and fight her privately, raiding convoys until they capture her Super Star Destroyer Lusankya. Isard seems to die escaping; the Rogues are quietly reinstated.

levents.title: Han and Leia marry after Dathomir
levents.summary: When Prince Isolder offers Leia marriage and the Hapes Consortium's wealth, Han wins the planet Dathomir at sabacc and carries her off there. Luke and Isolder follow, the Nightsisters and Zsinj are beaten, and Han and Leia marry on Coruscant six weeks later.
levents.wp: Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends

levents.title: Grand Admiral Thrawn nearly topples the Republic
levents.summary: Grand Admiral Thrawn returns from the Unknown Regions to lead the Imperial fleet. With the mad Jedi clone Joruus C'baoth, Force-blocking ysalamiri and clone troops grown on Wayland, he wins battle after battle and besieges Coruscant with cloaked asteroids.

levents.title: Leia turns the Noghri against the Empire
levents.summary: On Honoghr, Leia proves to the Noghri, the Empire's commando-assassins, that Imperial droids sent to heal their poisoned world have kept the land barren on purpose. The clans renounce their oath to the Empire and pledge themselves to Leia, Vader's daughter.

levents.title: Thrawn wins the race for the Katana fleet
levents.summary: Both sides race for the Katana fleet, two hundred Old Republic Dreadnaughts lost in deep space for decades. Karrde's smugglers, Bel Iblis and Mara Jade help the Republic win the fight, but only fifteen ships remain: Thrawn has taken the rest and crewed them with clones.

levents.title: Jacen and Jaina Solo are born
levents.summary: Leia gives birth to twins on Coruscant in the last days of the Thrawn campaign, and Imperial agents sent to seize them for C'baoth fail. Jaina will become the Sword of the Jedi; Jacen will fall to the dark side as Darth Caedus.

levents.title: Thrawn is killed by his bodyguard at Bilbringi
levents.summary: Thrawn is winning the fight over the Bilbringi shipyards when Rukh, his Noghri bodyguard, stabs him for the Empire's betrayal of his people. Pellaeon pulls the fleet back. On Wayland, Luke and Mara kill Joruus C'baoth and the cloning center falls.

levents.title: The Empire retakes Coruscant, then turns on itself
levents.summary: Imperial fleets pour out of the Deep Core, secretly steered by a reborn Palpatine, and force the New Republic to abandon Coruscant. With the capital taken, the Imperial factions turn on each other, and their fighting leaves much of the planet in ruins.

levents.title: Palpatine returns in a clone body
levents.summary: Reborn in a clone body on Byss, Palpatine launches the Dark Empire's offensive. Luke joins him to destroy him from within and truly falls, while World Devastators ravage Mon Calamari. Leia draws Luke back, and together they turn Palpatine's Force storm against him.

levents.title: Anakin Solo is born
levents.summary: Leia gives birth to her third child, a son named for his grandfather, at the New Republic's refuge on Nespis VIII as the war with the Dark Empire goes badly. Palpatine soon wants the infant's body for his own.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Characters

levents.title: Palpatine dies for the last time
levents.summary: His clone bodies sabotaged, a failing Palpatine attacks the Jedi on Onderon to take the infant Anakin Solo as a host. The Jedi Empatojayos Brand traps his spirit within himself and dies holding it, and R2-D2 sends the Eclipse II crashing into the Galaxy Gun, destroying Byss.

levents.title: Kir Kanos hunts the Emperor's betrayers
levents.summary: Carnor Jax, a Royal Guard who helped poison Palpatine's clones, claims the throne. Kir Kanos, the last loyal guardsman, kills him on Yinchorr, then hunts the Interim Ruling Council and executes Xandel Carivus, the last man to call himself Emperor.
sources: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 6
The New Essential Guide to Characters

levents.title: Luke founds the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4
levents.summary: Luke gathers Force-sensitives from across the galaxy, among them Gantoris, Streen, Kam Solusar, Tionne and Kyp Durron, and opens an academy in the Massassi temple on Yavin 4. It trains the New Jedi Order's Knights for fifteen years.

levents.title: Admiral Daala breaks out of the Maw
levents.summary: Escaping Kessel's spice mines, Han, Chewbacca and young Kyp Durron stumble into the Maw Installation, a hidden weapons lab where Admiral Daala has waited since Tarkin's day. They flee with the scientist Qwi Xux and the Sun Crusher, and Daala's fleet breaks out.

levents.title: Kyp Durron destroys Carida with the Sun Crusher
levents.summary: Under the sway of Exar Kun's spirit, the Jedi student Kyp Durron takes the Sun Crusher and fires into the sun of Carida, home of the Imperial military academy. The star explodes and destroys the planet with most of its people, Kyp's brother Zeth among them.

levents.title: Luke's students banish Exar Kun's spirit
levents.summary: The spirit of Exar Kun, trapped in Yavin 4's temples since the Great Sith War, preys on Luke's first students, killing Gantoris, turning Kyp and leaving Luke in a coma. The others join their strength with Luke's spirit and the ghost of Vodo-Siosk Baas and destroy Kun.

levents.title: Leia Organa Solo becomes Chief of State
levents.summary: Mon Mothma, slowly failing after the Caridan ambassador Furgan poisons her, resigns as Chief of State and guides the council to choose Leia Organa Solo. Leia leads the New Republic, with short breaks, for most of the next twelve years.

levents.title: Daala gasses the warlords at Tsoss Beacon
levents.summary: Admiral Daala and Pellaeon lock the thirteen strongest Deep Core warlords in a room on Tsoss Beacon to settle their feuds. When three hours of bickering produce nothing, Daala kills them all with nerve gas and takes their fleets as the United Warlord Fleets.

levents.title: Durga the Hutt's Darksaber is crushed
levents.summary: Durga the Hutt hires Bevel Lemelisk, designer of the Death Star, to build a stripped-down superlaser in the Hoth asteroid field. Cheaply built, the Darksaber is a wreck: Crix Madine dies trying to sabotage it, and when its weapon fails, asteroids crush it with Durga aboard.
sources: The New Essential Guide to Characters

levents.title: Kyle Katarn stops Desann's Reborn
levents.summary: Kyle Katarn takes up the Force again to stop Desann, a Dark Jedi expelled from Luke's academy, and Admiral Galak Fyyar, who use Force-charged crystals to make Reborn warriors. Their strike on the Yavin 4 academy fails, and Kyle kills Desann in the temple.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast

levents.title: Pellaeon gathers the Empire into the Imperial Remnant
levents.summary: Daala's united fleet attacks Yavin 4 and is driven off. Beaten, she hands command to Pellaeon, who pulls the survivors out of the Deep Core, seizes fortified Outer Rim sectors and puts them under a Council of Moffs. The Imperial Remnant is born and the warlord era ends.

levents.title: Seti Ashgad unleashes the Death Seed plague
levents.summary: On the prison world Nam Chorios, the exiled politician Seti Ashgad plots with Moff Getelles to spread the Death Seed plague through the Meridian sector ahead of an Imperial invasion. Leia and Luke foil him, and Daala's ships help rout Getelles's fleet.

levents.title: Disciples of Ragnos try to raise Marka Ragnos
levents.summary: Tavion Axmis, once Desann's apprentice, builds a Sith cult that drains Force energy from ancient sites to resurrect the Dark Lord Marka Ragnos. Kyle Katarn's student Jaden Korr tracks the cult across the galaxy; on Korriban it is broken before Ragnos can return.
sources: Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy
Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast

levents.title: The Yevetha purge the Koornacht Cluster
levents.summary: Nil Spaar's Yevetha turn a captured Imperial fleet on their neighbors and exterminate every other people in the Koornacht Cluster. With Han a prisoner and the Senate against her, Leia declares war; at N'zoth hidden Imperial crews retake their old ships and the Yevethan fleet is destroyed.

levents.title: Kueller's droid bombs strike the Senate
levents.summary: Kueller, a fallen student of Luke's who rules Almania, kills nearly everyone on its moon Pydyr and hides bombs in droids from Brakiss's factory, one blast gutting the Senate chamber. Leia defies the Senate to bring a fleet to Almania and shoots Kueller dead.

levents.title: Ackbar crushes the Remnant at Anx Minor
levents.summary: Pellaeon and Daala launch one last Imperial offensive. Over Anx Minor, deep in Imperial space, Admiral Ackbar's fleet mauls Pellaeon's Star Destroyers, and the Remnant is pushed back to eight backwater Outer Rim sectors, no longer a real threat to the Republic.
levents.conflict: Wookieepedia's Legends timeline lists the battle under 18 ABY; the Battle of Anx Minor article, following The Essential Guide to Warfare, dates it to 17 ABY, two years before the peace.

levents.title: Rebels seize Centerpoint Station in the Corellian system
levents.summary: During a trade summit, Han's cousin Thrackan Sal-Solo declares himself Diktat of Corellia while the Sacorrian Triad uses Centerpoint Station, an ancient relic that can blow up stars, to seal the system. A Bakuran fleet breaks through, the Solo children help, and Thrackan is arrested.

levents.title: The Caamas Document splits the New Republic
levents.summary: A damaged Imperial record found on Wayland shows that Bothans helped sabotage Caamas's shields before the Empire burned it. Old grudges flare and the New Republic edges toward civil war, while Moff Disra stokes the fire with a con man posing as Thrawn.

levents.title: Empire and Republic sign peace aboard Chimaera
levents.summary: Convinced the Empire cannot win, Supreme Commander Pellaeon exposes Disra's fake Thrawn and sues for peace. He and Chief of State Ponc Gavrisom sign a treaty aboard the Chimaera, with Mon Mothma looking on, ending the Galactic Civil War after more than two decades.

levents.title: Luke Skywalker marries Mara Jade
levents.summary: Three months after the Caamas crisis, Luke marries Mara Jade, once the Emperor's Hand, on Coruscant: first privately among the Jedi, then at a public ceremony that a band of ex-Moffs fails to disrupt. Talon Karrde gives the bride away.
levents.wp: Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade
levents.conflict: The Essential Chronology, which the wedding's Wookieepedia article follows, sets it three months after the Caamas crisis in 19 ABY; Wookieepedia's Legends timeline lists it under 20 ABY.

levents.title: Luke and Mara find Outbound Flight's wreck
levents.summary: Luke and Mara join a Chiss expedition to Outbound Flight, the Old Republic's Jedi colony ship that Thrawn stopped fifty years earlier. They find the survivors' descendants living in the wreck, beat off Vagaari raiders posing as refugees, and see the colonists resettled in the Empire of the Hand.

levents.title: Boba Fett becomes Mandalore
levents.summary: On Shogun, the Mandalorian leader Fenn Shysa is mortally wounded saving Boba Fett and asks him to take his place. Fett ends Shysa's suffering and becomes Mandalore, closing a forty-five-year career as a bounty hunter.
sources: So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars
levents.conflict: Galaxy at War dates Fenn Shysa's death to 21 ABY; So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars gives 23 ABY for Fett's succession, which Wookieepedia follows.

levents.title: The Shadow Academy assaults Yavin 4
levents.summary: Brakiss, once Luke's student, trains Dark Jedi at the Shadow Academy for the Second Imperium, whose returned Emperor is only a hologram. Its recruits, among them the Solo twins' friend Zekk, attack Yavin 4; the assault fails, Brakiss dies and Zekk returns to the light.
sources: Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Under Siege

levents.title: Nolaa Tarkona's Diversity Alliance targets Humans
levents.summary: The Twi'lek Nolaa Tarkona builds the Diversity Alliance, an alien-supremacist movement fed by bitterness at Imperial persecution, and seeks the Emperor's hidden plagues to wipe out Humans. The Solo twins and their friends expose her, and she dies of a disease aimed at her own species.
sources: Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur
Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague

levents.title: Mon Mothma dies in her sleep
levents.summary: Mon Mothma, a founder of the Rebel Alliance and the New Republic's first Chief of State, dies quietly in her sleep on the eve of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion, never having recovered from Furgan's poisoning. A New Republic Star Destroyer is named for her.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Star by Star

levents.title: The Yuuzhan Vong invade the galaxy
levents.summary: The Yuuzhan Vong, extragalactic zealots who loathe machines, wield living technology and cannot be sensed through the Force, strike at the galaxy's rim after decades of scouting. Over five years they overrun much of the galaxy; the war kills more than 365 trillion beings before it ends at Coruscant.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime
The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force

levents.title: Chewbacca dies as a moon falls on Sernpidal
levents.summary: A Yuuzhan Vong creature drags the moon Dobido down onto Sernpidal. Chewbacca helps Han ferry thousands of refugees off the world, then saves Anakin Solo from the rising winds but is swept out of reach. Anakin has to lift off without him, and the moon strikes.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime

levents.title: The Historical Council makes Yavin year zero
levents.summary: The New Republic Historical Council publishes its chronicle of galactic history and formally sets the Battle of Yavin as year zero, the reckoning of years before and after Yavin used by later historians. A revised edition follows after the Yuuzhan Vong War.

levents.title: The Yuuzhan Vong poison Ithor
levents.summary: With Pellaeon leading a joint New Republic and Imperial fleet, the defenders hold Ithor, and Corran Horn kills the Vong commander Shedao Shai in a duel for the planet. The Vong seed Ithor with a bioweapon anyway, killing its sacred forests, and the HoloNet blames Corran.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin
The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial

levents.title: Duro falls, and the Vong demand the Jedi
levents.summary: The Yuuzhan Vong take Duro, a Core World where the New Republic is resettling refugees, and drag its orbital cities down onto the surface. Jacen saves Leia from Warmaster Tsavong Lah, who then offers to halt the invasion if the galaxy hands over its Jedi.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Balance Point

levents.title: The Yuuzhan Vong overrun the Yavin 4 academy
levents.summary: With the New Republic unwilling to protect the Jedi, the collaborationist Peace Brigade and the Yuuzhan Vong descend on Yavin 4. Karrde's smugglers evacuate most of the students; Anakin Solo goes back for the rest and rescues Tahiri Veila from Vong shapers. The Praxeum is destroyed.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest

levents.title: Ben Skywalker is born aboard the Errant Venture
levents.summary: Mara Jade Skywalker, who has fought off a Yuuzhan Vong-bred disease for more than a year, gives birth to a healthy son aboard Booster Terrik's Star Destroyer, where the Jedi are hiding from an arrest warrant. Luke and Mara name him Ben, after Obi-Wan Kenobi.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth
The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime

levents.title: Darth Krayt founds the One Sith on Korriban
levents.note: The One Sith article says only that Krayt's order existed by 27 ABY, when its agents Lomi Plo and Welk were already active.
levents.summary: Freed from Yuuzhan Vong captivity, where Vergere taught him to draw strength from pain, A'Sharad Hett returns to Korriban as Darth Krayt. He founds the One Sith, trading Bane's Rule of Two for a Rule of One: many Sith under one Dark Lord, hidden for a century.
levents.conflict: Wookieepedia's Legends timeline dates the founding c. 30 ABY; the One Sith article places it before 27 ABY.

levents.title: Anakin Solo dies killing the voxyn queen
levents.summary: Anakin Solo leads a strike team of young Jedi onto a Yuuzhan Vong worldship above Myrkr to kill the queen of the voxyn, beasts bred to hunt Jedi. They destroy her, but six of the team die, Anakin among them, and Jacen is left behind as a captive.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Star by Star

levents.title: Coruscant falls to the Yuuzhan Vong
levents.summary: The Yuuzhan Vong take Coruscant, ramming captured refugee ships into its shields until they fail. Chief of State Borsk Fey'lya refuses to flee and dies setting off a bomb that kills some 25,000 Vong. The invaders remake the capital as Yuuzhan'tar, and the New Republic splinters.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Star by Star
The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey

levents.title: The Bothans declare ar'krai on the Vong
levents.summary: After Fey'lya's death on Coruscant, the Bothans declare ar'krai against the Yuuzhan Vong, only the third time in their history: every fit Bothan must serve until the enemy is wiped out to the last being. Bothan hardliners are still hunting the Vong a decade after the war ends.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way

levents.title: Tenel Ka becomes Queen Mother of Hapes
levents.summary: After her mother, Teneniel Djo, is murdered in a plot involving her grandmother Ta'a Chume, the young Jedi Tenel Ka is crowned Queen Mother of the Hapes Consortium. She arrests Ta'a Chume, commits Hapes to the war, and hands a hidden new Hapan fleet to Jagged Fel.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey

levents.title: Vergere remakes Jacen Solo in captivity
levents.summary: Taken at Myrkr, Jacen is tortured in the Embrace of Pain on Yuuzhan'tar. His keeper Vergere, a Jedi who vanished half a century earlier, teaches him that the Force has no light or dark side, only what its users make of it. He escapes a year later, changed.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way

levents.title: Ackbar's trap breaks the Vong at Ebaq 9
levents.summary: Following Admiral Ackbar's last battle plan, the New Republic lures Warmaster Tsavong Lah to the moon Ebaq 9 with a fake fortress and traps his fleet. Vergere dies crashing her ship to save Jacen, and Jaina kills Tsavong Lah. The victory turns the tide of the war.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way

levents.title: The New Republic becomes the Galactic Alliance
levents.summary: After the victory at Ebaq 9, Chief of State Cal Omas reorganizes the battered New Republic into the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, a leaner federal union built to survive the war. Luke forms a new Jedi Council, and Jedi Masters join an advisory council to the new government.
sources: The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way
The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant

levents.title: Admiral Ackbar dies of old age
levents.summary: Admiral Ackbar, the Mon Calamari who led the Rebel fleet at Endor and planned the Ebaq 9 trap from retirement, dies of old age on his homeworld, tended by his friend Winter, shortly before the war's final battle. Memorials are held on Mon Calamari and on reclaimed Coruscant.
sources: The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force

levents.title: The Alliance retakes Coruscant and ends the war
levents.summary: With the living world Zonama Sekot at their side, Alliance, Chiss and Mandalorian fleets retake Coruscant. Luke kills Supreme Overlord Shimrra, and Jacen kills Onimi, the Shamed One who had secretly ruled through him. The surviving Yuuzhan Vong surrender and settle on Zonama Sekot, ending the war.
sources: The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force

levents.title: The Jedi build a new academy on Ossus
levents.summary: With Yavin 4 lost, Luke accepts Kam Solusar's proposal to rebuild the Jedi academy on Ossus, the ancient library world scorched in the Great Sith War. Run by Kam and Tionne Solusar, it becomes the Order's school and refuge for more than a century.
sources: Dark Nest I: The Joiner King

levents.title: Young Jedi are drawn into the Killik hive
levents.summary: A Force call from Raynar Thul, thought dead at Myrkr, draws the strike team's survivors to the Killiks, an insect hive people spreading along the Chiss border. They become Joiners of the Colony, secretly steered by Lomi Plo's Dark Nest, and Chiss and Killiks edge toward war.
sources: Dark Nest I: The Joiner King
Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen

levents.title: R2-D2 shows Luke his parents' last days
levents.summary: Recordings locked in R2-D2's memory give Luke his first sight of his mother, Padmé Amidala. A year later the droid shows him darker ones: Anakin leading the attack on the Jedi Temple, and choking Padmé on Mustafar. Luke learns at last how his mother died.
sources: Dark Nest I: The Joiner King
Dark Nest III: The Swarm War

levents.title: Allana is born to Tenel Ka and Jacen
levents.summary: Queen Mother Tenel Ka gives birth to Allana, heir to the Hapes Consortium, and keeps the father's identity secret to protect her: he is Jacen Solo. After Jacen's fall, the girl is raised by her grandparents Han and Leia under the name Amelia.
sources: Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen

levents.title: Luke takes the title of Grand Master
levents.summary: At the Jedi's first full convocation on Ossus, Luke takes the title of Grand Master and pledges the Order to serve the Galactic Alliance, telling every Jedi to put the Order first or leave it. Tenel Ka and Danni Quee step down; the rest accept his rule.
sources: Dark Nest III: The Swarm War
levents.conflict: The Conclave on Ossus article dates it to 35 ABY; Wookieepedia's Grand Master article and its Legends timeline put Luke's elevation in 36 ABY, during the Swarm War.

levents.title: Luke kills Lomi Plo, ending the Swarm War
levents.summary: Chiss attacks on the Killik Colony become open war, with Pellaeon's Alliance fleet siding with the Chiss and some young Jedi fighting for the Killiks. Luke kills Lomi Plo and frees Raynar Thul from the hive, breaking the Dark Nest's hold, and the war ends at Tenupe.
sources: Dark Nest III: The Swarm War

levents.title: Corellia's secession starts a second galactic civil war
levents.summary: Corellia rejects the Galactic Alliance's limits on local fleets and its taxes for postwar rebuilding, and an Alliance show of force in the Corellian system turns into open war. Bothawui, Commenor, Fondor and others join the rebels in a Confederation, and the galaxy is at war with itself again.

levents.title: Jacen Solo takes Lumiya as his Sith teacher
levents.summary: Convinced that only a strong hand can stop the chaos he has foreseen, Jacen Solo accepts the Sith Lady Lumiya as his teacher and takes his young cousin Ben Skywalker as his own apprentice. Cal Omas gives him command of the new Galactic Alliance Guard, a secret police force.

levents.title: Jacen and Niathal depose Cal Omas
levents.summary: When Chief of State Cal Omas secretly offers the Corellians peace in return for removing Jacen and Admiral Cha Niathal, Jacen uses a legal loophole to arrest him. He and Niathal declare themselves joint Chiefs of State and promise elections after the war; Jacen privately plans to rule alone.

levents.title: Jacen kills Mara and becomes Darth Caedus
levents.summary: Hunting whoever is corrupting her nephew, Mara Jade Skywalker confronts Jacen on Kavan, and he kills her with a poisoned dart. The sacrifice completes his fall, and he takes the name Darth Caedus. Luke, believing Lumiya the killer, cuts her down on Terephon.
sources: Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)

levents.title: Caedus burns Kashyyyk and the Jedi break away
levents.summary: Caedus brings the Fifth Fleet to Kashyyyk to punish the Wookiees for sheltering Jedi and sets its forests ablaze. Jedi, Wookiee and Confederation forces maul his fleet, Tenel Ka pulls Hapes out of the Alliance, and Luke forms the Jedi Coalition to bring Caedus down.
levents.wp: Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)

levents.title: Centerpoint Station is destroyed
levents.summary: As the Alliance moves to turn Centerpoint Station against the Confederation, Jedi rescue Caedus's daughter Allana from his flagship and the engineer Toval Seyah rigs the station's weapon to fire into itself. Its destruction also weakens the prison holding the dark entity Abeloth.
levents.wp: Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)

levents.title: Tahiri Veila kills Pellaeon at Fondor
levents.summary: Caedus attacks Fondor and refuses to accept its surrender, splitting the Alliance: Admiral Niathal sets up an Alliance-in-exile. When Gilad Pellaeon will not back him, Caedus's new apprentice Tahiri Veila murders the old admiral, and Daala's fleet and Boba Fett's Mandalorians join the Jedi against him.

levents.title: The Lost Tribe of Sith leaves Kesh
levents.summary: Marooned on Kesh for five thousand years, the Lost Tribe of Sith gets off-world when a Sith meditation sphere called Ship finds it. Its lords hunt Luke, ally uneasily with him against Abeloth, and plant agents in the Alliance government; the young Sith Vestara Khai falls in with Ben.

levents.title: Jaina Solo kills Darth Caedus, ending the war
levents.summary: Jaina Solo, trained by Boba Fett to fight her twin, duels Caedus aboard his Star Destroyer near Uroro Station and kills him. Luke persuades the Imperial Remnant to switch sides under Jagged Fel, the Confederation surrenders, and Natasi Daala becomes Chief of State of the reunited Alliance.

levents.title: Daala's government exiles Luke Skywalker
levents.summary: Chief of State Daala has Luke tried for failing to stop Jacen Solo's fall. He pleads guilty and is exiled from Coruscant and the Order for ten years; Kenth Hamner becomes acting Grand Master, and Luke and Ben set out to retrace Jacen's journey into the dark side.
levents.wp: The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker

levents.title: Young Jedi Knights fall to a strange madness
levents.summary: One by one, young Jedi Knights such as Valin Horn go mad, each convinced that the people closest to them have been replaced by impostors. The cause is Abeloth, reaching out from her prison in the Maw, but Daala's government blames the Order and freezes captured Knights in carbonite.

levents.title: The Jedi depose Chief of State Daala
levents.summary: Slave revolts, secretly stoked by the Freedom Flight network, spread across the galaxy, and Daala answers with brutal force while her quarrel with the Jedi deepens. The Order strikes with Plan Delta, Corran Horn's coup: Daala is arrested, a triumvirate takes her place, and Luke's exile is lifted.

levents.title: The Jedi retake Coruscant from Abeloth
levents.summary: Abeloth, wearing the body of Chief of State Rokari Kem, rules Coruscant through the Lost Tribe. The Jedi retake the capital in weeks of fighting that wrack it with quakes and eruptions, and Ben Skywalker and Vestara Khai destroy Abeloth's last body. The Senate then expels the Jedi.
levents.wp: Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)

levents.title: Jagged Fel marries Jaina Solo
levents.summary: Weeks after Abeloth's defeat, Jagged Fel, who has handed leadership of the Imperial Remnant to Vitor Reige, marries the newly made Jedi Master Jaina Solo aboard the Hapan Battle Dragon Dragon Queen II, joining the Solo family to the future Fel dynasty.
levents.wp: Wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo

levents.title: The Qreph brothers' bid for the economy fails
levents.summary: The Columi brothers Marvid and Craitheus Qreph try to seize the galaxy's industries through Galactic Exploitation Technologies, starting in the Chiloon Rift mines. Han, Leia and Luke defeat them at a strange Force monolith, where Luke comes to see light and dark as one Force. Luke then retires.

levents.title: The Fel dynasty restores the Empire
levents.summary: Back at the head of the Imperial Remnant, Jagged Fel spreads its influence peacefully through his Victory Without War program and in time takes the vacant title of Emperor. His heirs rule the Fel Empire from Bastion with a Council of Moffs and a Force order, the Imperial Knights.
levents.conflict: Wookieepedia's Legends timeline dates the Fel Empire's founding c. 45 ABY, citing Crucible; the Fel Empire article says only that it arose between 45 and 127 ABY, Jag taking the throne many years after he returned to lead the Remnant.

levents.title: O'Pali's book recasts Thrawn as a patriot
levents.summary: The Imperial polemicist Lenang O'Pali publishes Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered, recasting Grand Admiral Thrawn as a principled patriot who meant to build an Empire strong enough to face the Yuuzhan Vong, and calling the Empire's fall a disaster that left the galaxy defenseless when the invaders came.

levents.title: The Scythe-class battle cruiser enters service
levents.summary: The Mon Calamari Shipyards' MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser, a mass-produced, standardized design with a blade-like prow, goes into service. A sharp break from the one-of-a-kind Mon Cal cruisers of old, it becomes the Galactic Alliance fleet's main warship.

levents.title: R2-D2 tells the Skywalker story to the Whills
levents.summary: More than a century after the Clone Wars, the astromech R2-D2 recounts the Skywalker family's story through the Clone Wars and the Galactic Civil War to a Keeper of the Whills, who records it in the Journal of the Whills.
sources: The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith

levents.title: The One Sith sabotage the Ossus Project
levents.summary: Kol Skywalker and the Yuuzhan Vong shaper Nei Rin use Vong terraforming to revive barren Ossus, and the project spreads to a hundred war-scarred worlds. The One Sith later sabotage it with a virus that withers plants and deforms people, and the galaxy blames the Vong and the Jedi.

levents.title: The Fel Empire and Sith crush the Alliance
levents.summary: Blaming the Vong for the Ossus Project's failure, the Moffs invoke the Treaty of Anaxes and the Fel Empire goes to war with the Galactic Alliance, over Emperor Roan Fel's doubts. The One Sith secretly join the Empire, Alliance worlds defect, and in 130 ABY the Alliance surrenders after Caamas.

levents.title: The Sith massacre the Jedi on Ossus
levents.summary: Two days after Coruscant falls, the Jedi refuse Emperor Fel's call to submit, and Darth Nihl leads Sith and Imperial forces against their academy on Ossus. Kol Skywalker, head of the Jedi Council, is killed; his son Cade and Wolf Sazen escape, and the survivors go into hiding.

levents.title: Darth Krayt seizes the Imperial throne
levents.summary: Before the Moff Council on Coruscant, Darth Krayt claims his reward: his Sith cut down Emperor Roan Fel and his guards, and Krayt declares himself Emperor. The victim is a double; the real Fel escapes to Bastion to lead an Empire-in-exile, and a second Imperial civil war begins.

levents.title: Gar Stazi keeps the Alliance fleet fighting
levents.summary: Admiral Gar Stazi refuses the surrender and takes part of the Alliance fleet into hiding. For seven years his Galactic Alliance Remnant strikes at Imperial space from secret bases, keeping resistance alive and making itself a top target for Krayt.

levents.title: Cade Skywalker is dragged back into the war
levents.summary: Seven years after Ossus, Kol's son Cade is a bounty hunter who has turned his back on the Jedi and dulls his Force visions with death sticks. When the Sith learn of his rare power to heal, even to revive the dying, Krayt captures him and tempts him; Cade nearly falls, but escapes.

levents.title: The Sith poison Dac and its people
levents.summary: When the Mon Calamari keep aiding Stazi's fleet, Krayt orders their extermination. Sith forces massacre New Coral City and the scientist Vul Isen poisons Dac's oceans. Stazi's fleet, the Jedi and a flotilla of private ships evacuate the survivors, but Dac is left a dead world.

levents.title: Krayt falls on Had Abbadon and rises again
levents.summary: Jedi, Imperial Knights and Cade, joined by the ancient Jedi Celeste Morne, ambush Darth Krayt on Had Abbadon. Wounded, Krayt is finished off by his own lieutenant, Darth Wyyrlok, who hides the body and rules as regent. Krayt revives on Korriban, healed, and in 138 ABY kills Wyyrlok.

levents.title: Krayt's forces overrun the Hidden Temple
levents.summary: Krayt, back in command, sends his fleet against the Jedi's Hidden Temple on Taivas. Cade's uncle Nat Skywalker and Master T'ra Saa die covering the retreat, but the Jedi and their Alliance and Imperial allies escape together and turn to strike at Coruscant.

levents.title: Cade Skywalker kills Darth Krayt at Coruscant
levents.summary: The Jedi, Stazi's Alliance Remnant and Roan Fel's Empire-in-exile strike Coruscant together.
