He guides Din Djarin to the infant Grogu, helps rebuild the Razor Crest after Jawas strip it, and patiently reprograms IG-11 as a caretaker. Racing Grogu to safety on Nevarro, he is shot down by scout troopers.

posts.text: Buys his freedom after long Imperial servitude
Vapor farmer living alone on Arvala-7
Guides Din Djarin to Grogu; helps restore the Razor Crest
Reprograms IG-11 as a caretaker droid
Killed by scout troopers while carrying Grogu

personnel.name: Paz Vizsla
personnel.affiliation: Mandalorians (Children of the Watch, House Vizsla)
personnel.summary: A hulking Mandalorian zealot of the Watch who hauls a heavy repeating blaster, Paz Vizsla distrusts anyone who deals with the Empire and resents Din Djarin for holding the Darksaber his ancestor forged. He duels Din for it and loses, later helps retake Mandalore, and dies alone holding off Moff Gideon's Praetorian Guards so his people can escape.

posts.text: Heavy infantry warrior of the Nevarro covert
Helps rescue Din Djarin from the Guild on Nevarro
Challenges Din for the Darksaber and loses
Raises his foundling son Ragnar in the Tribe
Dies covering the Mandalorians' retreat on Mandalore

personnel.name: Rush Clovis
personnel.affiliation: InterGalactic Banking Clan → Galactic Senate → Confederacy of Independent Systems (secretly)
personnel.summary: Raised among Muun bankers on Scipio, Rush Clovis wants the Banking Clan to be honest but gets tangled in Separatist money and is thrown out of the Senate when Padmé Amidala exposes him. He resurfaces to root out corruption, is installed at the head of the banks as a pawn, and falls to his death when Dooku's forces storm Scipio.

posts.text: Senator representing Scipio, then the banks
Exposed dealing with the Separatists; loses his seat
Returns to expose crooked leaders of the banks
Installed as the Banking Clan's new head
Lets go of Anakin's grip and falls on Scipio

personnel.name: Marrok
personnel.affiliation: Jedi Order → Galactic Empire (Inquisitorius) → Morgan Elsbeth's mercenaries
personnel.summary: A Jedi turned Inquisitor, the masked First Brother kneels to Vader at the fortress on Nur and later joins the hunt for Maul on Janix. Years after the Empire falls he resurfaces as a hired blade for Morgan Elsbeth, until Ahsoka Tano cuts through his armor on Seatos and he dissolves into green mist.

posts.text: Trained as a Jedi before the purge
First Brother of the Inquisitorius, sworn to Darth Vader
Hunts Maul on Janix beside the Eleventh Brother
Mercenary for Morgan Elsbeth, hunting the map to Peridea
Killed by Ahsoka Tano on Seatos

personnel.name: Indara
personnel.affiliation: Jedi Order (Brendok four)
personnel.summary: A composed Jedi Master, Indara survives a harsh apprenticeship and a mining disaster, regains her nerve traveling with Vernestra Rwoh, and takes Torbin as her Padawan. In 148 BBY she leads the Jedi who confront a coven of witches on Brendok, a clash that ends in fire and death. Sixteen years later the surviving twin, Mae, kills her on Ueda.

posts.text: Knighted after a strained apprenticeship
Survives the Farlingan Collapse; retreats to the Archives
Travels with Vernestra Rwoh chasing lightsaber nullifiers
Jedi Master teaching the Padawan Torbin
Leads the Jedi mission to Brendok
Keeps the peace from Point Ueda
Killed by Mae Aniseya in a noodle shop on Ueda

personnel.name: Jecki Lon
personnel.affiliation: Jedi Order (Khofar Jedi task force)
personnel.summary: A serious, self-possessed Padawan of Master Sol, part Theelin and part human, Jecki joins his team hunting the killer of Jedi Master Indara, helps catch the fugitive Osha and cracks the apothecary that sold the poison used on Torbin. On Khofar she duels the masked Sith Qimir and holds her own for a time before he kills her.

posts.text: Apprentice to Master Sol
Travels with Sol and Elishe on a mission to Siline
Joins Sol's hunt for Indara's killer
Unmasks the Olega apothecary behind Torbin's poison
Killed by Qimir after dueling him on Khofar

personnel.name: Yord Fandar
personnel.affiliation: Jedi Order (Khofar Jedi task force)
personnel.summary: An earnest, rule-minded Jedi from Alderaan, Yord earns his knighthood after a long apprenticeship and is sent to arrest his old friend Osha when Master Indara is murdered. He stands by her as the truth comes out, joins Sol's hunt on Khofar, and turns back to fight the masked Sith Qimir, who breaks his neck.

posts.text: Padawan of the Pantoran Master Elishe
Knighted; takes Tasi Lowa as his Padawan
Arrests Osha Aniseya for Indara's murder
Briefs and guides the Jedi team on Khofar
Killed by Qimir on Khofar

personnel.name: Torbin
personnel.affiliation: Jedi Order (Brendok four)
personnel.summary: A boy from Bonadan handed to the Jedi by his poor parents, Torbin becomes Indara's restless Padawan and is on Brendok when the Jedi clash with a coven of witches. Haunted by that day, he reaches the rank of Master, then takes a vow of silence on Olega. When Mae finds him years later, he accepts her poison as atonement.

posts.text: Given to the Jedi Order as a child
Apprentice to Master Indara
Impatient member of the Jedi team on Brendok
Knighted, then raised to Jedi Master
Keeps the Barash Vow in the Olega temple
Drinks the poison Mae brings him

personnel.name: Kelnacca
personnel.affiliation: Jedi Order (Brendok four)
personnel.summary: A Wookiee Jedi Master whose life spans more than two centuries of the Order, Kelnacca takes on a Padawan after Starlight Beacon falls, fights the Nihil and helps shield Kashyyyk's sacred trees from the blight. After the disaster on Brendok he turns inward and withdraws into Khofar's forests, where Mae's Sith master, Qimir, kills him.

posts.text: Takes Yarzion Vell as his Padawan after Starlight Beacon falls
Helps guard Kashyyyk's sacred trees from the blight
Finishes the training of Vell's Padawan, Ordea
Member of the Jedi team on Brendok
Posted to Khofar; retreats into its forests
Killed on Khofar by Qimir

sources: The High Republic: Into the Light

personnel.name: Neeku Vozo
personnel.affiliation: Team Fireball → Resistance (Team Colossus)
personnel.summary: A literal-minded Kadas'sa'Nikto from a family of bantha herders, Neeku works as a mechanic in Jarek Yeager's shop on the Colossus and becomes the first friend of the undercover spy Kaz Xiono. He adopts a baby sea monster, helps drive the First Order off the station, serves as its chief engineer in flight, and forgives Tam when she comes home.

posts.text: Mechanic in Jarek Yeager's repair shop
Befriends the undercover spy Kaz Xiono
Adopts Bibo, a baby rokkna
Floods the station's halls to sweep out stormtroopers
Chief engineer as the Colossus flees the First Order
Helps win the fight with the Thunderer; forgives Tam

personnel.name: Torra Doza
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Resistance (Team Colossus) → Citizens' Fleet
personnel.summary: The daughter of the Colossus's captain and a rebel pilot mother, Torra is the youngest and boldest of the station's Ace pilots. Kidnapped by pirates in a First Order scheme, she turns on the occupiers, helps Kaz free her father and the station, and defends the Colossus through its flight. At Exegol she flies her racer with the citizen fleet.

posts.text: Youngest Ace Squadron pilot, flying the Blue Ace
Races and then befriends the newcomer Kaz Xiono
Kidnapped by pirates in a First Order ploy
Helps free her father and retake the Colossus
Flies missions as the station hides from the First Order
Fights the Thunderer over Barabesh
Flies her racer at the Battle of Exegol

personnel.name: Jarek Yeager
personnel.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic → Team Fireball → Resistance (Team Colossus) → Citizens' Fleet
personnel.summary: A rebel pilot turned star racer, Jarek Yeager quits racing after his brother's reckless crash kills his wife and daughter, and settles on the Colossus fixing starships. Poe Dameron leaves the spy Kaz Xiono in his care, and the gruff mechanic becomes a father figure to Team Fireball, leads the station's resistance to the First Order, and flies at Exegol.

posts.text: Rebel pilot sent to probe the Iron Blockade
Racer whose wife and daughter die in his brother's crash
Opens a Colossus garage and forms Team Fireball
Shelters the Resistance spy Kaz Xiono
Leads the station's uprising against the First Order
Trains the Aces and rescues Tam from the Thunderer
Flies his racer at the Battle of Exegol

personnel.name: Big Bongo
personnel.summary: A huge joopa lurking beneath the salt crust of Seelos, Big Bongo is the obsession of the retired clone Gregor. When the Spectres visit, Gregor uses Zeb Orrelios as bait; the beast swallows the Lasat whole before Rex kills it with the walker's cannon. The clones haul its carcass on their AT-TE, and Zeb later wears its image.

posts.text: Giant joopa beneath the salt flats of Seelos
Swallows Zeb Orrelios during Gregor's hunt
Killed by the cannon of Rex's AT-TE
Carcass carried on the clones' walker until the Imperial assault
Its image decorates Zeb's flight suit

sources: Star Wars Rebels: Visual Guide: Epic Battles

personnel.name: Imanuel Doza
personnel.affiliation: Galactic Empire → Colossus (station operator) → Resistance (Team Colossus) → Citizens' Fleet
personnel.summary: An Imperial captain who deserts near the Battle of Endor at the urging of the rebel pilot he later marries, Imanuel Doza runs the Colossus refueling station and guards his daughter Torra fiercely. He lets the First Order in for protection, then defies them and is jailed; once freed, he steers the fugitive station into the Resistance's fight.

posts.text: Imperial captain who deserts around the Battle of Endor
Captain and operator of the Colossus
Accepts First Order protection after Torra's kidnapping
Jailed by Commander Pyre; freed by Kaz and Torra
Leads the fugitive Colossus into the Resistance
Rallies the station against the Thunderer
Joins the citizen fleet at the Battle of Exegol

personnel.name: Tamara Ryvora
personnel.affiliation: Team Fireball → First Order (TIE squadron) → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A racer's daughter from Kuat who loses her ship and ends up a mechanic in Jarek Yeager's garage, Tam is prickly, proud and hardworking. Feeling betrayed by the secrets Kaz and Yeager keep, she joins the First Order and becomes a TIE pilot, but its bombardment of Aeos Prime turns her back, and she escapes home to the Colossus.

posts.text: Racer who loses her ship and turns mechanic
Team Fireball mechanic rebuilding the racer Fireball
Leaves with the First Order, angry at her friends' lies
TIE pilot DT-533, promoted to squadron commander
Defects after the massacre on Aeos Prime
Returns to the Colossus and is forgiven

personnel.name: R1-J5
personnel.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic → Team Fireball → Resistance (Team Colossus)
personnel.summary: An old R1-series astromech nicknamed Bucket, R1-J5 rides as Jarek Yeager's co-pilot through his racing years and follows him into retirement on the Colossus. He grumbles his way through Team Fireball's repairs, puts up with the newcomer Kaz, stands with the station against the First Order, and pilots the Fireball alone when the station takes on the Thunderer.

posts.text: Co-pilot on Jarek Yeager's racer
Team Fireball droid in Yeager's Colossus garage
Keeps a wary eye on newcomer Kaz Xiono
Joins the station's resistance to the First Order
Flies the Fireball solo against the Thunderer

personnel.name: Freya Fenris
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus → Citizens' Fleet
personnel.summary: A proud, sharp-tongued racer from Yir Tangee, Freya Fenris flies the Red Ace in the Colossus's Ace Squadron, racing for sport and defending the station from pirates. Grounded by the First Order occupation, she flies again once the Colossus escapes, is briefly captured by First Order Raiders on Ashas Ree, and later joins the citizen fleet at Exegol.

posts.text: Ace Squadron pilot flying the Red Ace
Defends the Colossus from Warbird pirate raids
Grounded during the First Order occupation
Escorts the station as it breaks away from Castilon
Captured by First Order Raiders on Ashas Ree
Flies with the citizen fleet over Exegol

personnel.name: Wullf Yularen
personnel.affiliation: Galactic Republic (Navy) → Galactic Empire (Imperial Security Bureau)
personnel.summary: A stiff, rule-bound officer who returns from retirement when the Clone Wars begin, Wullf Yularen commands Anakin Skywalker's fleet from the Malevolence hunt to Ryloth and learns to trust the reckless Jedi. Under the Empire he trades his admiral's stripes for a colonel's post in Imperial security, chasing rebels, and dies aboard the Death Star at Yavin.

posts.text: Former Judicial fleet officer and Senate intelligence agent
Admiral commanding Anakin Skywalker's fleet
Survives the Separatist plot against Carida's Valor starbase
Imperial admiral, then an ISB colonel
ISB liaison to Naval Intelligence
Senior ISB officer facing the Aldhani heist
Helps Thrawn hunt the rebel spy Fulcrum
Dies aboard the Death Star at Yavin

sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

personnel.name: Hype Fazon
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus → Citizens' Fleet
personnel.summary: A showboating Rodian racer trained on a Hutt's track, Hype Fazon leads the Colossus's Ace Squadron as Ace One in the flashy Green Ace and rarely loses. Behind the swagger he takes defense seriously. Jailed by the First Order, he flies the stolen transport that frees Aunt Z's group, returns for the station's escape, and later flies at Exegol.

posts.text: Leader of Ace Squadron, flying the Green Ace
Reigning champion of the Colossus races
Leads the Aces against pirates and the rokkna
Flies a stolen transport out with Aunt Z's group
Returns to help the Colossus escape Castilon
Joins the citizen fleet at the Battle of Exegol

personnel.name: Griff Halloran
personnel.affiliation: Galactic Empire (Imperial Starfighter Corps) → Ace Squadron → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A former Imperial TIE pilot who deserts with his commander Imanuel Doza around the time of Endor, Griff Halloran repays that loyalty by flying defense for Doza's Colossus in Ace Squadron. Gruff and old-school, he still flies Imperial colors on his cobbled-together Black Ace, guarding the station against pirates and, later, the First Order.

posts.text: Imperial pilot serving under Imanuel Doza
Deserts the Empire alongside Doza
Ace Squadron pilot flying the Black Ace
Defends the Colossus from pirates and the rokkna
Flies again once the station escapes the First Order

personnel.name: Bo Keevil
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus → Citizens' Fleet
personnel.summary: A Kel Dor who flies the Yellow Ace in the Colossus's Ace Squadron, Bo Keevil races, escorts shipments and defends the station from Kragan Gorr's pirates. A sea monster's tentacle knocks him out of the sky during the Bibo incident. Grounded under the First Order, he helps the station escape into hyperspace, and later flies at Exegol.

posts.text: Ace Squadron pilot flying the Yellow Ace
Fights off Kragan Gorr's pirate raids
Crashes when the rokkna strikes his racer
Grounded during the First Order occupation
Escorts the Colossus as it jumps to hyperspace
Joins the citizen fleet at the Battle of Exegol

personnel.name: Dasha Sigweed
personnel.summary: A performer known only from a run of Aurebesh posters, Dasha Sigweed is advertised across Coruscant's lower levels during the Clone Wars, from a slum massage parlor to the latrine of the clones' bar, 79's. Fifteen years later the same poster hangs aboard the rebel ship Ghost. The name nods to the real DJs Sasha and John Digweed.

posts.text: Advertised on posters across Coruscant's underworld
Poster hangs in the 79's cantina
The same poster hangs aboard the Ghost

sources: Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion

personnel.name: Rangthang
personnel.affiliation: Hutt Clan
personnel.summary: A four-armed Vonomi DJ who works for the Hutt Clan, Rangthang is at the decks when Obi-Wan Kenobi and Quinlan Vos come hunting Ziro the Hutt. His 'DJ Rangthang' poster turns up across the Clone Wars galaxy, from Trueping's cantina on Coruscant to Abafar, and fifteen years on it decorates the walls of the rebel ship Ghost.

posts.text: DJ serving the Hutt Clan
Plays as Kenobi and Vos search for Ziro
His poster hangs from Coruscant to Abafar
The poster adorns the Ghost fifteen years later

sources: Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion

personnel.name: CB-23
personnel.affiliation: Resistance → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A red-and-blue BB-series astromech in the Resistance, CB-23 flies with Poe Dameron in BB-8's absence, then takes BB-8's place beside the spy Kaz Xiono on the Colossus. She helps free the station's leaders from the First Order, keeps Kaz company through the flight, and knocks out the Thunderer's shields in the final battle, surviving a beating from Pyre.

posts.text: Resistance astromech flying with Poe Dameron
Locates Synara San aboard a derelict freighter
Takes BB-8's place at Kaz Xiono's side
Helps free Yeager and Doza and retake the station
Disables the Thunderer's shields in the final battle

personnel.name: Saesee Tiin
personnel.affiliation: Jedi Order (High Council) → Galactic Republic
personnel.summary: An Iktotchi Jedi Master and ace pilot who admits he was a stubborn Padawan under Omo Bouri, Saesee Tiin holds a Council seat by 40 BBY and loves tinkering with the Order's ships. He fights at Geonosis and Lola Sayu, then joins Mace Windu's attempt to arrest Palpatine and is among the first Jedi Sidious kills.

posts.text: Jedi Master on the High Council
Oversees work on the Order's ships and vehicles
Fights at Geonosis in the war's opening battle
Flies in the mission to free Even Piell
Killed by Sidious in the Chancellor's office

Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

personnel.name: R4-G77
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A floating astromech plastered with sponsor logos, R4-G77 rides as co-pilot in Hype Fazon's Green Ace and shares in nearly all of his race wins. Taken in for a motivator check at Flix and Orka's salvage shop, he fights off the owners and wrecks the place. He stays in the cockpit through the Colossus's flight from the First Order.

posts.text: Hype Fazon's co-pilot in the Green Ace
Shares in nearly every Colossus race win
Trashes the Office of Acquisitions during a checkup
Flies with the Aces as the Colossus flees

personnel.name: Gonky
personnel.affiliation: Clone Force 99 → Alliance to Restore the Republic
personnel.summary: A faulty GNK power droid that never fully charges, Gonky serves the Bad Batch on their ship as game table, gym weight and the young clone Omega's bed; she assures him they are all defective. Wrecker saves him when the Marauder is blown apart on Pabu, and years later he leaves with a grown Omega to join the Rebellion.

posts.text: Power droid serving the Bad Batch on the Marauder
Wrecker's lifting weight and Omega's makeshift cot
His signal leads the Batch to their stolen ship
Saved by Wrecker as CX-2 destroys the Marauder on Pabu
Leaves Pabu with Omega to join the Rebel Alliance

sources: Point of No Return (The Bad Batch)

personnel.name: Mouthless alien
personnel.affiliation: Team Colossus
personnel.summary: An unnamed resident of the Colossus from a species with no mouths, this green-skinned regular lives inside a suit that feeds him nutrients and spends much of his time lounging in Aunt Z's bar. A familiar background face, he rides out the station's pirate raids and occupation and stays aboard through its flight across the galaxy.

posts.text: Colossus resident sustained by a feeding suit
Fixture at Aunt Z's Tavern
Lives through the First Order occupation
Stays aboard as the Colossus flees and settles on Aeos Prime

personnel.name: Max Rebo
personnel.affiliation: Max Rebo Band (Jabba's court) → Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary
personnel.summary: A blue Ortolan who plays his red ball jett organ with his feet, Max Rebo leads his band through years of gigs for Jabba the Hutt. He walks away from the sail barge's explosion over the Carkoon pit and, years later, from the Pyke bombing of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa, where he is the house musician.

posts.text: His name, spelled Max Reebo, appears on gig posters
Leads the Max Rebo Band in Jabba's palace
Survives the Khetanna's destruction at Carkoon
Plays at Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa
Survives the Pyke bombing of the Sanctuary

Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land

personnel.name: R23-X9
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A custom astromech built for Torra Doza and painted to match her advanced Blue Ace racer, R23-X9 looks like an R-series unit but is far more specialized. It rides with Torra through races, pirate fights and patrols, and stays with her as the Colossus breaks away from Castilon and flees across the galaxy.

posts.text: Custom co-pilot droid in Torra Doza's Blue Ace
Rides through the Colossus races and pirate fights
Flies in the escape from Castilon
Serves with the Aces during the station's flight

personnel.name: 4D-M1N
personnel.affiliation: Colossus (Doza Tower) → Resistance (Team Colossus)
personnel.summary: A prim command droid who runs Captain Imanuel Doza's office in Doza Tower, 4D-M1N greets visitors, relays orders and keeps an eye on the captain's daughter, Torra. When Commander Pyre arrests Doza, she reveals hidden blasters and fights back until Pyre shoots her down. Rebuilt after the escape, she runs the station's bridge in flight.

posts.text: Assistant to Captain Doza in Doza Tower
Minds Torra during the First Order's visits
Shot down by Pyre while defending Doza
Rebuilt to serve on the command deck
Tries to raise the Resistance at D'Qar

personnel.name: Mas Amedda
personnel.affiliation: Galactic Republic (Senate) → Galactic Empire (Grand Vizier) → Coruscant provisional government
personnel.summary: A horned Chagrian who runs Senate sessions as Vice Chair, Mas Amedda backs whoever holds power and learns Palpatine's Sith secret. As the Emperor's Grand Vizier he runs the imperial bureaucracy for two decades. After Endor he is left a powerless figurehead on Coruscant, signs the Empire's surrender, and is kept on to front a provisional government.

posts.text: Vice Chair, running sessions of the Senate
Switches his loyalty from Valorum to Palpatine
The Emperor's Grand Vizier
Figurehead leader of the Empire on Coruscant
Signs the Galactic Concordance ending the war
Heads Coruscant's provisional government under Republic watch

sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith

personnel.name: SC-X2
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A heavily reinforced astromech that rolls on a track, SC-X2 belongs to the Kel Dor pilot Bo Keevil and works out the figures whenever the Yellow Ace reshapes its wings. It carries spare breath-mask parts for its pilot's needs and stays aboard through the Colossus's races, fights and flight.

posts.text: Bo Keevil's co-pilot in the Yellow Ace
Calculates the racer's wing reconfigurations
Carries emergency breath-mask parts for Keevil
Flies with the Aces as the Colossus escapes

personnel.name: T3-K10
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: An astromech from Duwani Mechanical Products whose modern shell revives an old maintenance-droid look, T3-K10 co-pilots Freya Fenris's customized Red Ace and handles rapid navigation. It rides with Freya through the Colossus races and fights, and is captured alongside her by First Order Raiders on Ashas Ree.

posts.text: Freya Fenris's co-pilot in the Red Ace
Navigates for Freya in races and pirate fights
Flies in the escape from Castilon
Captured with Freya on Ashas Ree

personnel.name: Aunt Z
personnel.affiliation: Aunt Z's Tavern → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A tough Gilliand from Crul who runs the busiest tavern on the Colossus and its betting book, Aunt Z hands out drinks, odds and advice. Jailed for speaking against the First Order, she breaks out with Kaz's help and returns for the station's escape. When the First Order comes again, her speech rallies the residents, who become Team Colossus.

posts.text: Owner of Aunt Z's Tavern and the race betting pool
Jailed for defying the First Order; breaks out
Returns from Takodana to aid the escape
Nearly quits the station when supplies run dry
Rallies the residents to fight; names Team Colossus

personnel.name: Glem
personnel.affiliation: Colossus (loading docks)
personnel.summary: A Rodian dockworker on the Colossus, Glem hauls cargo, bets on the races and gets swept into more than one tavern brawl. He tips off Kaz about pirates striking during triple-dark storms, unknowingly dumps a crate with Kaz inside into the sea, and is nearly arrested by stormtroopers over missing papers. He stays with the station when it escapes.

posts.text: Loading-dock worker on the Colossus
Warns Kaz about pirates and the triple dark
Unwittingly drops a crate holding Kaz into the sea
Stopped by stormtroopers over his missing ID
Rides with the Colossus after its escape

personnel.name: Big Al
personnel.affiliation: Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A gray-haired, heavily mustached fixture of Aunt Z's bar, Big Al is a fixture of Colossus life who would rather drink than brawl: when a holo-darts dispute turns into a bar fight, he keeps drinking. He bets fifty credits that Kaz will fall off Doza Tower, and sticks with the station through its occupation and flight.

posts.text: Fixture of Aunt Z's bar
Sits out the holo-darts brawl, still drinking
Bets that Kaz will fall from Doza Tower
Stays aboard as the Colossus flees Castilon

personnel.name: Garma
personnel.affiliation: Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A blue-skinned, yellow-eyed Arcona, Garma is one of the familiar faces around the Colossus's market and Aunt Z's tavern. She lives through the pirate raids and the First Order occupation and travels with the station when it breaks free. In an unused cut of the first season's finale, Kaz was to shove her clear of a wall of floodwater.

posts.text: Arcona resident of the Colossus
Lives through the pirate raids and the occupation
Travels with the station into exile
Aboard for the pirates' mutiny and the final battle

personnel.name: Narb
personnel.affiliation: Grevel's betting ring; Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A Snivvian heavy who works for the Aleena bookie Grevel, Narb spends his days beside his brother Nod in the tavern, the market and the race crowds. He brawls, chases Kaz over unpaid debts, and tries to hold up Flix and Orka's salvage shop, only to drop through their trapdoor. He is still aboard when the station flees.

Joins the brawl at Aunt Z's Tavern
Chases Kaz through the market with Nod
Drops through a trapdoor while robbing a salvage shop
Stays aboard as the Colossus flees

personnel.name: R5-G9
personnel.affiliation: Ace Squadron → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: Like the Black Ace it rides in, R5-G9 is assembled from retired Imperial droid parts and scrap, among them a worn R2 unit. It serves as co-pilot to the former TIE pilot Griff Halloran through Ace Squadron's races and patrols, and stays with him as the Colossus escapes Castilon and flees the First Order.

posts.text: Griff Halloran's co-pilot in the Black Ace
Flies Ace Squadron's races and patrols
Rides in the escape from Castilon
Serves with the Aces during the station's flight

personnel.name: Pyre
personnel.affiliation: First Order (Stormtrooper Corps)
personnel.summary: A chrome-armored stormtrooper commander, Pyre schemes with pirates to frighten Captain Doza into accepting First Order protection, then runs the occupation of the Colossus with an iron grip. After the station slips away he hunts it across the galaxy with Agent Tierny, and dies when Team Colossus destroys the Thunderer over Barabesh.

posts.text: Stormtrooper commander of the First Order
Plots with pirates to pressure Captain Doza
Hunts two runaway children from Tehar
Commands the occupation of the Colossus
Chases the fleeing station with Agent Tierny
Killed as the Thunderer explodes at Barabesh

personnel.name: Synara San
personnel.affiliation: Warbird gang → Team Colossus
personnel.summary: A Mirialan street kid rescued by the pirate Kragan Gorr, Synara joins his Warbird gang and is planted on the Colossus as a spy posing as a salvager. Friendship with Tam and Kaz pulls her the other way: she helps the station escape, sides with it when the pirates mutiny, and flies Gorr's shuttle against the Thunderer.
